item.title: What is spc floor? What are the advantages of Spc floor?
item.source: What is spc floor? What are the advantages of Spc floor?
item.description:
With the advent of new materials, floor decoration is no longer tile. In the world of wooden floors, more and more people try new products, but they also get their unanimous praise. What flooring materials are worth buying? SPC floor is environmentally friendly and wear-resistant, and has the texture of wooden floor, which is equivalent to the ceiling of the floor industry. What are the benefits of SPC flooring? let me tell you! What is SPC Flooring? SPC floor is composed of calcium powder, resin powder and polyvinyl chloride, and then formed under high temperature and high pressure. It does not need to be glued and does not generate formaldehyde, which is especially environmentally friendly. Among them, polyvinyl chloride plastic is a plastic product with a very wear-resistant surface, good elasticity, long service life, and no special maintenance in the later stage. The wooden floor we are talking about is made of MDF and glue, so the formaldehyde content is high, and the paving is not environmentally friendly.


The advantages of SPC flooring.


Wood floors are very different from SPC floors, precisely because of the difference in the structure of the latter. There are five layers of SPC floor, including UV coating to improve the surface‘s stain resistance; wear layer to make the floor durable; there is also color film layer, imitating the texture of wood floor; SPC substrate layer and quiet layer ensure the floor‘s durability. Environmental friendly. It is precisely because of these five structures that SPC floors have greater advantages than wooden floors and are more suitable for current home decoration.


1. Environmental protection and no pollution. The materials used in the SPC floor itself are non-polluting, and the polyvinyl chloride is degradable, so the production process is very environmentally friendly. There is no need to use glue even in the paving process, and it is installed directly through the lock of the SPC substrate layer. The process is simple and no formaldehyde is released.


2. Outstanding wear resistance. SPC floor has a special wear layer to avoid black marks when furniture is moved, suitable for dining room, living room and bedroom. Generally speaking, SPC floors are not afraid of scratches from sharp objects and suppression of heavy objects, and their appearance is still online.


3. Easy to clean, no maintenance required. There are no pores on the surface of the UV coating, which determines the good waterproof performance of the SPC floor. Even if the floor is mopped with a wet mop, there will be no water seepage, which is an incomparable advantage of wooden floors. We don‘t need to spend a fortune for maintenance in the future, as long as it is installed on the ground, there will be no problem in seven or eight years, especially suitable for lazy people like us.


4. High cost performance. When we buy wooden floor, the average market price is 200~400 yuan/square meter, and the price of SPC floor is relatively low, so the cost performance is very high. Wooden floors and SPC floors have the same appearance and texture. In order to save money, be sure to buy SPC floors!


Founded in 2001, the company is a modern enterprise specializing in R&D, production and sales and modern high-tech material products. The main products are bamboo flooring products, bamboo furniture, bamboo decorative materials, bamboo outdoor products, SPC (Stone Crystal Flooring), SPC decorative materials, new top-wall fusion products, bamboo-plastic composite flooring and other eight categories of famous products. It is a global supplier of China‘s top Hsinchu products and modern high-tech materials. At present, Yongyu products are sold to 50 overseas countries and regions, with an annual export area of ??nearly 20 million square meters.


How to maintain pvc floor


If you install PVC flooring at home, it is not only beautiful and stylish, but also very comfortable to the touch of your feet. Therefore, it is very popular. However, in order to prolong the service life of PVC floor, how should we maintain it in our daily life?


1. Cleaning: In areas with limited operations, you can choose to use a dry drag or vacuum to remove dust and grime from the floor. The PVC floor can also be cleaned by dragging it slightly wet. When cleaning, it should be noted that the floor should not have water accumulation.


2. To remove stains: Spray the diluted neutral cleaner on the floor, then brush the stain with a nylon cleaning pad, and finally wipe with clean water.


3. It is forbidden to soak the floor in open water, otherwise it will seriously affect the service life of the floor. Use a water suction machine to suck up the sewage in time.

item.title: Several advantages and installation matters of outdoor high-resistant bamboo decking
item.source: Several advantages and installation matters of outdoor high-resistant bamboo decking
item.description:
In our cognitive concept, the floor is generally indoor. I believe that what you see in places may be very few. Maybe in some villas, some other tourist spots or other places. It may be more common at home, and may be less common in residential areas. So if it is this kind of outdoor high-resistant bamboo decking, what should I pay attention to? Or when we choose him, how should we choose? Its advantages are that it can withstand changing outdoor weather, strong temperature difference, ultraviolet radiation, high temperature resistance, corrosion resistance, termite resistance and other functional characteristics.


The advantage of outdoor high-resistant bamboo decking is that when it is outdoors, it may rain often, and then it may be windy or snowy. If we have this kind of weather, it must be of very good quality to withstand these, bad weather, or these storms out there. So it must be very corrosive and waterproof. Because if it‘s not good, then it will get very wet, it will get moldy when it is very young, the place will rot, and then its quality will be destroyed, and the aesthetics may also be destroyed. If it is in some villas or going to scenic spots, this kind of place will definitely be damaged after it is destroyed.


The second benefit of outdoor high-resistance bamboo decking is that it is mildew-proof and moth-proof. Because they are usually outdoors, most of them are in some places with particularly good environments, where there are many trees, grasses and flowers. But if the environment is good, its green plants are independent. If the floor is not particularly anti-counterfeiting or moth-proof, it can be easily damaged by these bugs.


In fact, outdoor high-resistant bamboo decking has many advantages, such as strong aesthetics, or more durable, not easy to deform, and can also prevent electricity. It is a green and environmentally friendly product, and everyone can use it with confidence.


1. Green protection: Bamboo is an environmentally friendly and rapidly renewable resource. Regular wood takes 60 years to reach the lifespan of solid wood, while bamboo can regenerate 12 times in the same amount of time. Originating from nature, the finished product still retains the fresh and natural feel of bamboo, with a beautiful and special texture.


2. Hard and wear-resistant: According to the relevant hardness test results, the hardness of outdoor high-resistance bamboo decking is stronger than that of Jaramu, and also higher than most common tree species.


3. Healthy and pollution-free: The production process of outdoor high-resistance bamboo decking uses a harmless water-based surface layer as a protective layer, which does not cause any pollution to the environment.


4. Low expansion rate and low deformation: The production process of outdoor high-resistance bamboo decking includes slicing and compaction of bamboo capillary pores, which is not easy to deform and has high stability.


5. Scratch resistance: outdoor high-resistance bamboo decking made by Seiko, multi-layer high-quality foreign high-quality paint. Durable high quality paint low gloss polishing system provides a scratch safe aluminium oxide protective layer.


6. Easy to install: Outdoor high-resistant bamboo decking has its special installation structure, traditional flat buckle decking and lock buckle decking, no glue and nails are needed, and the installation is simple and fast.

item.title: Bamboo floor market expansion is limited by four factors
item.source: Bamboo floor market expansion is limited by four factors
item.description:
The area and output of bamboo resources in my country are the largest in the world; about 90% of the bamboo with the best performance and the highest utilization value in the world is distributed in my country. As an emerging industry, bamboo flooring has a relatively short development time in China and the market is not mature. However, in the whole floor market, the market share of bamboo floor is very small, the whole market share is less than 5%, and the sales volume has not increased. However, the weak status of the bamboo floor market is not because the product quality is not good, but the industry itself has fatal flaws. These most critical and fatal problems limit the development of the bamboo flooring industry and also limit the expansion of the bamboo flooring market. Therefore, the bamboo floor market has been standing still and fell into a dilemma of the market.


Market profit margin problem, gross profit is too low to expand


Profit margins are critical to an industry and the key to assessing whether an industry can rise and grow. The gross profit rate of ordinary industries is generally more than 40%, the gross profit of wood flooring industry is more than 30%, and the gross profit rate of domestic bamboo flooring is only 20%. As soon as an enterprise enters the market, according to the general logistics cost of 5-8%, the cost of marketing is 8-10%, and the sales cost and the year-end counter-profit of the dealer are 15-20%. Basically, the company will lose money in promotion. Moreover, the gross profit margin must reach the level of ordinary industries, or even higher than the level of ordinary industries, in order to be suitable for the market to expand. However, the current enterprises are from foreign trade to domestic sales, and their habit is to operate with low gross profit. It turns out that their 20-point gross profit is not suitable for building stores and advertising. Therefore, many companies did not do it after the end, and they dared not advertise. Although there is demand, in the face of low gross profit margins, it is difficult for bamboo flooring companies to expand, so it is difficult for the entire bamboo flooring market to grow.


To make the bamboo floor market bigger, the gross profit structure of the industry must be changed. If bamboo flooring companies want to change the status quo of the industry, they should introduce a high-margin business model. By improving the high sales gross profit of the category, it makes up for the lack of gross profit margin, thereby increasing the profit margin of the entire industry. For example, the Commesen heavy bamboo flooring in the industry has basically solved this problem now. Its gross profit generally reaches more than 40% when designing product prices, and 30% on distribution. This effectively resolves the problem of low gross profit margin of bamboo flooring, thus ensuring the full interests of the enterprise itself and stakeholders.


The original material grade problem, bamboo is innate


Cheap bamboo is a symbol of high style and bright festivals. Bamboo culture has had a huge impact on our country and is exclusive to Chinese culture. Although bamboo has a high national sentiment, but because of its endless growth, it can be seen everywhere in our country and has never become a precious thing in the hearts of Chinese people. The common view held by the public in our country about bamboo is that bamboo itself is cheap, and it would be unacceptable if they were suddenly told how expensive bamboo is. Therefore, when consumers buy bamboo, the sense of quality is not enough. Unlike wood, it has a high-quality and high-value sense, and the tree species is still scarce. And bamboo is cheap and real, and it grows fast and many times. It has never been scarce, so it is almost inferior to solid wood.


Charcoal and diamond are the same carbon, but they are arranged in different ways and have different values. For bamboo, it has many excellent characteristics, high toughness and hardness, and there must be room for value improvement. There is a big difference between heavy bamboo flooring and ordinary bamboo flooring, so the value of heavy bamboo flooring is high, so bamboo flooring can also be conceptually marketed. When Kang Maison promoted bamboo flooring, he made substantial innovations, and proposed the concept of "bamboo spring bars" from the source and processing of bamboo materials. Bamboo spring tendons are made by extracting 100% bamboo tendons as raw materials, which greatly enhances the value and preciousness of bamboo materials and solves the problem of bamboo grades. At the same time, Kangmaison heavy bamboo floor has been upgraded with bamboo culture in the later period, thus enhancing the cultural connotation of bamboo floor and basically resolving this problem, which is a good example.


Consumption guidance problem, lack of mainstream media attention and leading brand promotion


After so many years of development of bamboo flooring, the industry technology has become very mature, but the bamboo flooring market has always been in a too young and immature state, and has not developed and grown. The reason for this market situation is the lack of attention and promotion in the bamboo flooring market. Most of the domestic mainstream media do not pay attention to bamboo flooring, but focus on the three mainstream decorative panels, especially solid wood flooring. Although many domestic enterprises are making bamboo flooring, it is difficult to see the advertisements of bamboo flooring, and there is no powerful leading brand, so there is a lack of promotion. Bamboo flooring has never entered the mainstream market, and sales rely on some people with traditional spirit and feelings. It was not until recent years that some bamboo flooring brands began to do some simple promotion. In general, the bamboo flooring market lacks the effective guidance of the media to consumers, and the lack of strong leading brands to transmit information to the audience.


In order to gain the attention of consumers in the bamboo flooring market, it is necessary to inform the audience of information in order to induce purchases and expand the market. At the same time, it is necessary to carry out strong promotion and market education in order to enhance the social influence of bamboo flooring. This is the cooperation between enterprises and mainstream media to promote the development of the bamboo flooring market and educate consumers. If enterprises continue to promote and the media focus on bamboo flooring to guide consumption trends, then in China and even the world, this category will achieve long-term development.


Bamboo floor has a good market prospect, which is in line with the call of the era of low carbon and environmental protection, and is the mainstream trend of consumption in the future. Compared with other floors, bamboo floors have obvious advantages, and cater to consumers‘ pursuit of health and environmental protection. In the face of the ever-increasing competition in the market, the bamboo flooring market has great opportunities for development. Therefore, in order to make the bamboo floor market stronger and bigger, its own fatal flaws have yet to be resolved, in order to ensure the rapid and sound development of the market.


Product suitability issues, limited scope


Bamboo flooring in my country emerged in the 1980s. Due to factors such as technology and equipment, the industry technology is not mature enough, so there are some rigid problems in bamboo flooring. The early bamboo floor is easy to deform, and the service life is short, and it is prone to insects. It is not suitable for use in heating rooms, resulting in an embarrassing consumption situation of bamboo floors. At the beginning of the bamboo floor entering the market, it was mainly sold in the south, and the market in the north could not be sold at all. Because bamboo flooring needs a certain moisture content, and the climate in the north is too dry, it is easy to cause cracking of bamboo flooring, so even northerners who like bamboo flooring dare not buy it, which further restricts the use of bamboo flooring.


However, after the appearance of Strand woven bamboo products, the product problem was basically completed and the applicability problem was solved. The density of Strand woven bamboo flooring is as high as 1200kg/m3, which is more than 1.6 times that of ordinary bamboo and wood flooring. It has high hardness, high strength and high impact toughness. Therefore, it has the characteristics of high density, high strength, impact resistance and wear resistance. At the same time, it has the advantages of water absorption resistance and no deformation. According to the measurement, the thickness expansion rate of water absorption in 24 hours is only 0.4%, which is far better than the European standard of ≤2.0%. Strand woven bamboo flooring overcomes the shortcomings of ordinary bamboo flooring, and also has more superior performance, and the scope of application is not limited.

item.title: The future development of bamboo flooring industry
item.source: The future development of bamboo flooring industry
item.description:
In fact, with the gradual rise of healthy home life, the energy saving and environmental protection of building materials products are also more and more concerned by consumers. In recent years, bamboo flooring has gradually entered our field of vision, and its good environmental performance is one of the important characteristics of its firm foothold in the market. The future floor market will also develop around the word environmental protection, and bamboo flooring will also become the trend of products. So what is the reason for the embarrassing situation that bamboo flooring is prosperous in domestic production, but consumption is not strong?


Industry embarrassment: the market is full of fragrance outside the wall, lacking the right to speak and pricing


Bamboo flooring has not been in the Chinese market for a long time. It started in the 1980s. The technology has progressed rapidly, the development momentum is strong, and the technology is becoming more and more mature. Large enterprises are equipped with tenoning machines imported from Germany. The imported paint line adopts paints and adhesives imported from Europe, with high processing precision and stable product quality.


More popular with international consumers. In the past few years, the large bamboo floor production enterprises have mainly exported, and the export volume has increased year by year, and exported to Europe, the United States, Canada and Southeast Asian countries, accounting for more than 80% of the industry. It is more popular in cities in the northeastern region of China, and its sales volume is rising rapidly. Beijing and other cities also show a steady upward trend, so its market prospects are considerable.


As the domestic bamboo flooring industry has always been export-oriented, enterprises have always relied on the international market, and thus lacked attention to the domestic market, which not only led to the fragrance of bamboo flooring inside the wall, but also caused the market pricing power of China‘s bamboo flooring industry to be developed by Europe and the United States. State control. In addition, although China is the country with the largest bamboo planting area, the production machinery and core accessories are imported from abroad.


China is only an assembly workshop and raw material production base in the international market, which leads to the lack of international voice in the domestic bamboo flooring industry, and the market is attached to the international market, so the development of the industry is subject to the international market. For example, Anji, as a domestic bamboo town, does not have a company or brand with international influence. Basically, it is OEM for others.


Product embarrassment: sandwich biscuits lack appeal and lose the core competitiveness of the category


Bamboo itself is a relatively environmentally friendly material, and its bamboo is also a relatively rich resource in my country. The domestic bamboo forest area reaches more than 5 million hectares. The area and output of bamboo resources rank first in the world, and the performance is the best in the world. , About 90% of the bamboo forests with the highest utilization value are distributed in the southern provinces of my country. However, my country has been facing the contradiction of the shortage of wood for a long time. The use of bamboo instead of wood has provided a good development opportunity for the development, utilization and processing of rich bamboo materials.


However, because domestic bamboo flooring products are between the laminate flooring and solid wood flooring markets, the low-end market is squeezed by laminate flooring and ceramic tiles, and the high-end market is suppressed by solid wood flooring and solid wood composite flooring. In the first floor, bamboo flooring is used as a product from foreign trade to domestic sales.


Not only lack of market promotion, but also the core value of the category, so that the market cannot form a trend. In addition, the early quality of bamboo flooring was not stable, so that most flooring consumers could not form a good category awareness of bamboo flooring, and it was difficult for ordinary people to make up their minds to buy a new category in the market.


The embarrassing situation of not going up and down has led domestic bamboo flooring companies to blindly follow mature categories to market when operating in the domestic market, and operate the market by means of price manipulation. As a result, investment in brand building and market promotion has been neglected.


Market embarrassment: there are many brands without leading companies, no consumption atmosphere and no guidance


The area and output of domestic bamboo resources rank first in the world, and about 90% of the bamboo with the best performance and the highest utilization value in the world is distributed in China. Bamboo plants belong to the subfamily Bamboo of the Poaceae family, and are woody plants. It has the characteristics of a successful afforestation, and the underground stems can be whipped out of bamboo shoots, bamboos, and selective cutting every year, and the characteristics of sustainable use without destroying the ecological environment.


At present, there are more than 100 large-scale bamboo flooring enterprises in my country, mainly located in Zhejiang, Hunan, Fujian, Jiangsu, Jiangxi, Anhui and other bamboo-producing provinces. There are many small enterprises in the bamboo flooring industry, and most of them have not yet formed mature Unlike in the solid wood flooring industry, where nature leads the Baroque to follow, and the laminate flooring industry is led by icons, bamboo flooring has no leading enterprises in China, because there is no leading enterprise guidance, the industry lacks development momentum, and there is no market consumption atmosphere. And guidance, which has led to the domestic development of the bamboo flooring industry has been in a downturn.


Under the current more brutal market conditions, "appendix" companies that do not have strong industry viability themselves will have a tendency to be "washed out" at an accelerated rate. This is the bamboo with considerable product, capital and resource strength. A great opportunity for flooring companies to strengthen their brands. Of course, the premise is that our bamboo flooring companies cannot wait for opportunities and take the initiative to win "brand opportunities". In the future, the market for bamboo flooring will be high-end, and heavy bamboo flooring will be the future development trend.


Embarrassing profits: operating brands with low gross profit, lack of brand promotion expenses


In my country‘s wood flooring consumption structure, the proportion of laminate flooring in total sales is on the rise. From 2000 to 2006, its proportion has increased from 51% to 61%; followed by solid wood composite flooring, its proportion has increased from 3% to 61%. 17%; solid wood flooring has decreased in the past two years due to the shortage of wood resources and the national protection policy for forest resources.


In 2015 and 2016, the sales volume dropped to 26% and 19% year-on-year respectively, and its proportion also dropped from 42% in 2005 to about 18% in 2016; %, but the growth rate is relatively high, with a year-on-year increase of 60% in 2016, which is 10 times the sales volume in 2005. At present, the average gross profit margin of my country‘s wood flooring industry is around 18%-30%. Among them, the gross profit margin of strong brands is about 30%. Because bamboo flooring is subject to foreign trade, its price and gross profit are only less than 25%, and enterprises have no promotion expenses when operating in the domestic market. The status quo of low gross profit makes it difficult to support the promotion and promotion of corporate branding. This is also the key to the failure of many foreign trade to domestic sales. There is no brand awareness and no brand promotion expense rate, which makes the rapid development of bamboo flooring exhausted.


Under the trend of home life that is incompatible with the trend of low-carbon environmental protection, the demand and extravagance for wood will become a life that is not in harmony with the world trend. All people of insight are abandoning the consumption of wasteful forests and starting to choose green and environmentally friendly renewable resources to fulfill their social responsibilities. Bamboo floor products are a good substitute product, which not only meets the needs of the society for the protection of the natural environment, but also satisfies people‘s pursuit of life taste, and also stimulates the cultural appeal in the bones of the Orientals. Therefore, it will naturally lead the future world furniture consumption trend.

item.title: Bamboo is lower carbon and more economical than wood
item.source: Bamboo is lower carbon and more economical than wood
item.description:
What are the advantages of bamboo compared to wood? Bamboo has a fast growth cycle and a short time to maturity, so will the cost of bamboo and wood be relatively reduced? Consumers will be very concerned about price when purchasing, whether to spend more money, where to buy, and how cost-effective it is. Selection is often made from comparison. From the quality of materials and the application of physical properties, compare bamboo and oak. Bamboo is close to oak in density, strength, color and performance, but the price is still much lower than that of oak. Bamboo is a cost-effective material.


Bamboo is a relatively environmentally friendly resource, and bamboo and wood have characteristics that both wood and wood do not have, such as faster growth. Bamboo can do some things that wood can‘t do. I once saw a chair designed by a foreign designer in the office of General Manager Lin. It is the same as the wooden chair. It is made of wooden strips. After sitting down, the wooden strips Is elastic, as the body is stretchy, very comfortable. Even doing a project requires that the echo of the material reflected in the concert hall can be heard. This kind of requirement cannot be achieved by wood, and it is difficult for wood to meet this requirement. In international public buildings, low-carbon decoration is promoted, and the concept of low-carbon environmental protection is advocated. Promote bamboo decoration activities nationwide.


In fact, Chinese people use wood more traditionally. In the past, bamboo and household-related products included sofas and chairs made of bamboo. The earliest contact with bamboo products was bamboo flooring. Ten years ago, China Interior Decoration Association Pushing. Compared with wood, the market of bamboo board and bamboo furniture has many advantages. The biggest advantage is that it is suitable for modern people‘s requirements for green environmental protection, low-carbon energy saving, especially after the Copenhagen Conference in 2009, the whole world knows a word,  low carbon.


How is low carbon reflected in our decoration industry and how is it reflected in the home furnishing industry? It is low-carbon for ordinary people to save water and electricity. In fact, there is a larger part that can achieve low-carbon and environmental protection, that is, home decoration. This is only lower than the investment in buying a house and a car, and some are more than the investment in buying a car. From 2009 to the present, the most important thing to do is to promote the use of bamboo instead of wood for processing and decoration. Interior decoration, urban building decoration.

item.title: Bamboo Flooring: A "Potential Stock" in the Flooring Industry
item.source: Bamboo Flooring: A "Potential Stock" in the Flooring Industry

Bamboo flooring has not been in the Chinese market for a long time. Bamboo itself is a relatively environmentally friendly material, and its bamboo is also a relatively rich resource in China. The area of ??bamboo forest in my country reaches more than 5 million hectares. The area and output of bamboo resources It ranks first in the world, and about 90% of the moso bamboo forests with the best performance and highest utilization value in the world are distributed in the southern provinces of my country. However, my country has been facing the contradiction of the shortage of wood for a long time. Substituting bamboo for wood has provided a good development opportunity for the development and utilization of rich bamboo materials and processing them into bamboo floors.


At present, there are more than 100 large-scale bamboo flooring enterprises in my country, mainly located in Zhejiang, Hunan, Fujian, Jiangsu, Jiangxi, Anhui and other bamboo-producing provinces. Large-scale enterprises are equipped with tenoning machines imported from Germany and imported from Italy. , The paint line imported from Taiwan uses paints and adhesives imported from Europe, etc., with high processing precision and stable product quality. In the past few years, the large bamboo flooring manufacturers have mainly exported, and the export volume has increased year by year. They are exported to Europe, the United States, Canada and Southeast Asian countries. They are more popular in cities in the northeast of China, and their sales volume is rising rapidly. Beijing and other Regional cities are also showing a steady upward trend, so their market prospects are promising. Compared with laminate flooring, the color difference is small, because the growth radius of bamboo is much smaller than that of trees, it is not seriously affected by sunlight, and there is no obvious difference between yin and yang surfaces, and because the bamboo floor has rich bamboo patterns, and the color is well-proportioned; High surface hardness is also an advantage of bamboo flooring. Because the bamboo floor is a thick plant fiber structure, its natural hardness is more than double that of wood, and it is not easy to deform. The theoretical service life is 20 years. In terms of stability, the shrinkage and expansion rate of bamboo flooring is smaller than that of solid wood flooring.


Compared with the price of solid wood flooring: the solid wood flooring on the market is often two or three hundred yuan per square meter, and the high is four or five hundred yuan. The price of pure solid wood flooring is much higher than the price of bamboo flooring. Bamboo floor style [latest news price apartment type comments] elegant, the price is cheaper than solid wood floor, to meet consumers‘ high-end and affordable psychology when purchasing floor. Compared with the solid wood composite floor, it is more environmentally friendly: bamboo is reproduced by the underground bamboo whip, and the bamboo shoots grow into bamboo every year, and it grows endlessly. After the growth period and the stable period of bamboo, the quality of bamboo will decline and become brittle year by year, so it must be selected every year. Bamboo flooring is made of 5-6 year old bamboo with the best material, which will not affect the growth environment. Therefore, it is an environmentally friendly and environmentally friendly product.

item.title: Selection Tips for Bamboo Flooring and PVC Flooring
item.source: Selection Tips for Bamboo Flooring and PVC Flooring
item.description:
Bamboo floor is a combination of solid wood floor and floor tiles. Bamboo floor is made of natural high-quality bamboo as raw material, and is made of high temperature and high pressure after painting and drying. It has the natural texture of bamboo, fresh and elegant, giving people a feeling of returning to nature, elegant and refined, and the bamboo floor has both the natural beauty of the original wood floor and the durability of the ceramic floor tile.


(1) The texture of bamboo flooring is delicate and smooth, moisture-proof, moisture-proof and corrosion-proof, and has strong toughness and elasticity. Compared with solid wood flooring, it has small color difference, high hardness, strong toughness and elasticity, and is warm in winter and cool in summer.


(2) The growth cycle of bamboo is shorter than that of solid wood, and it is a very environmentally friendly building material. However, compared with solid wood floors, bamboo and wood floors have a single texture of raw materials, and their styles have certain limitations.


(3) Bamboo floors vary in price due to different materials and processing methods, generally 90-300 yuan/m2, suitable for families who choose simple, ordinary mid-range decoration.


Buying skills of bamboo floor


(1) Appearance: Observe whether there are bubbles on the surface paint of the bamboo floor, whether it is fresh and bright, and whether the bamboo joints are too black; beautiful.


(2) Color: The color of the natural bamboo floor should be golden yellow and the whole body is translucent; the carbonized bamboo floor should be bronze or brown with uniform color. Except for the antique floor, the color tone of the bamboo floor should be uniform, but a slight color difference that does not affect the decorative effect is allowed.


(3) Sealing method: Pay attention to whether the bamboo floor is lacquered on six sides. Since the bamboo floor is a green natural product with capillary pores on the surface, it will be deformed due to moisture absorption, so it is necessary to seal all the surrounding areas, the bottom surface and the surface.


(4) Age: The age of bamboo is not as old as possible. The best bamboo age is 4 to 6 years. Bamboos under 4 years old are not mature, and the bamboo is too tender; bamboos over 9 years old belong to old moso bamboo, and the skin is too thick and brittle to use. You can pick up a piece of bamboo floor and observe it. If it feels lighter in your hand, it means that the bamboo is used; if the texture is blurred, it means that the bamboo is not fresh and it is an older bamboo.


(5) BACK. Check whether there are cracks around, whether there are any traces of ash, and whether it is clean and tidy. Check whether there is bamboo green and bamboo yellow remaining on the back and whether it is clean and tidy. After purchasing, don‘t forget to check the goods to see if there is any gap between the sample and the real thing.


PVC flooring can greatly reduce the budget and is the best choice for short-term residences. PVC floor, also known as plastic floor, is produced with polyvinyl chloride and copolymer resin as the main raw materials. It is a new type of lightweight floor decoration material that is very popular in the world today. Many people have the impression that PVC flooring is not environmentally friendly. In fact, this idea is wrong. The qualified PVC floors are all green and environmentally friendly materials. Compared with other types of floors, the price of PVC floors is very low. Using it to decorate the floor can greatly reduce the budget. It is very suitable for short-term residences or simple decoration. There are many colors, and the wood grain type is more classy.


(1) PVC floor has high water absorption and low strength, and it is easy to break.


(2) PVC floor has a wide variety of colors, such as solid color, carpet pattern, stone pattern, wood floor pattern, etc., and can even be customized.


(3) The texture of the PVC floor is realistic and beautiful, with colorful accessories and decorative strips, which can combine to create a beautiful decorative effect.


(4) PVC floor has poor air permeability and is not resistant to sunlight, so it is not suitable for use in sunny balconies and wet bathrooms in the home.


Buying skills of PVC floor


(1) Appearance: There should be no cracks, fractures and delaminations on the surface. Slight wrinkles and bubbles are allowed, and slight pattern deformation is allowed.


(2) Thickness: When purchasing PVC floor, be sure to pay attention to the thickness, the thicker the floor is usually the better the quality. Under normal circumstances, choose a plastic floor with a thickness of 2.0mm to 3.0mm and a wear-resistant layer of 0.2mm to 0.3mm.


(3) Odor: close to the floor and smell the obvious pungent odor. If so, it proves that the raw materials are not environmentally friendly enough. Good products do not have obvious pungent odor. Even if there is some plastic smell, it will soon be able to spread.


(4) Brand: It is difficult to judge the quality of PVC raw materials with the naked eye, and the products made of recycled materials are worse than the original materials in terms of environmental protection and durability. Choosing brand products can avoid harming health by buying recycled materials.

item.title: How about bamboo and wood floors? How to choose the right flooring?
item.source: How about bamboo and wood floors? How to choose the right flooring?
item.description:
Bamboo wood floor is a new type of decorative material and also a kind of composite floor. Bamboo wood flooring performs relatively well in terms of decorative performance and product performance, and more importantly, it is cost-effective, so it stands out among many flooring materials. Although the demand for bamboo and wood floors is getting higher and higher, there are still many people who do not have a deeper understanding and cognition of bamboo and wood floors. Don‘t worry, next, the editor will take you to understand the relevant knowledge about bamboo and wood flooring, I hope the following articles will be helpful to you!


1. What is Bamboo Wood Flooring?


Bamboo wood floor, also a kind of composite floor, is mainly a floor made of bamboo and wood. After more than 20 procedures such as inspection of original bamboo, cutting, punching, cutting and planing, it is made. The panels and bottom plates of the bamboo floor are made of bamboo, and the core material in the middle is made of wood such as fir, camphor and so on. There are two kinds of bamboo floors on the market, one is a more natural color, the color of this kind of bamboo floor is even and has the natural texture of bamboo, and the other is that the bamboo floor is artificially painted, it can choose various kinds. The same color, but the texture of the bamboo is not very clear. Bamboo floors are mainly used for floor decoration and wall decoration of decoration.


2. What are the advantages of bamboo and wood flooring?


1. The appearance of bamboo and wood flooring is relatively natural, and the texture is also very delicate. Not only does it have advantages in appearance, but its performance is also very excellent. The surface is very hard, so it is durable. The core of the bamboo floor is wood as the raw material, so it has excellent stability and is not easy to deform.


2. Bamboo floor has a very excellent feature, that is, "warm in winter and cool in summer", the main factor is that the board surface and back board are made of bamboo.


3. The installation of bamboo and wood floors is very simple, because it can be directly paved without installing wooden keels, which reduces labor costs and costs. Moreover, the material price of bamboo flooring will be lower than that of solid wood flooring.


3. What are the disadvantages of bamboo and wood flooring?


1. Bamboo and wood floors are made of adhesives. Sometimes the adhesives are not glued well and fall off easily, which will easily lead to delamination.


2. Bamboo and wood flooring is not waterproof because the core material is wood, and it is easy to expand after encountering water, and its shrinkage performance is poor. If it is in a humid environment for a long time, it is easy to mold.


3. Bamboo and wood floors cannot be used for floor heating, because bamboo and wood floors will change according to changes in temperature.


Fourth, how to choose bamboo flooring?


1. Moisture content: The humidity in each area is different, so when purchasing wooden floors, you need to choose bamboo floors according to the humidity of the area, because bamboo floors are easily tarnished or deformed due to the influence of time, so you need to pay attention. Whether the moisture content of the bamboo floor is suitable for the local area.


2. Bonding technology: Bamboo floor is a composite floor made of bonding, so we need to pay attention to whether the bonding process meets the standard when purchasing, otherwise it will be easy to delaminate later.


3. Appearance: Bamboo floor is easy to deform and expand when it encounters water or humid air, so we need to pay attention to whether each surface of the bamboo floor is covered with paint to avoid moisture.


Bamboo flooring is a relatively cost-effective material in terms of decoration and the product itself, but it is easy to deform when it is wet, so we need to take waterproof and moisture-proof measures first to avoid deformation and other phenomena during later use.

item.title: Forest Products Carbon Footprint Technical Route Seminar Held in Beijing
item.source: Forest Products Carbon Footprint Technical Route Seminar Held in Beijing
item.description:
On the afternoon of May 10th, the Seminar on Technical Route Research on Carbon Footprint of Forest Products held an online meeting in Beijing. This meeting was hosted by the National Carbon Footprint Innovation Alliance (in preparation), undertaken by Beijing Green Forest Certification Co., Ltd., from Zhongnan Forestry Experts and leaders from University of Science and Technology, China Forest Products Industry Association, China Academy of Forestry and International Bamboo and Rattan Center attended the meeting and delivered important speeches at the meeting.


Achieving carbon peaking and carbon neutrality is an extensive and profound economic and social systemic change. It is necessary to incorporate carbon peaking and carbon neutrality into the overall layout of ecological civilization construction. Ex-carbon peak, goal of carbon neutrality by 2060. "Achieving the "dual carbon" goal is a major strategic deployment of the Party Central Committee, and it is also a solemn commitment to combating climate change with world significance. From the perspective of the international situation, the EU carbon tariff has been passed at the EU Council on March 15, 2022. , it is likely that companies that export products to the EU will soon provide the carbon footprint of their products and impose carbon tariffs.


The government work report of the NPC and CPPCC in 2021 clearly stated that we must do a good job in the work of "carbon peaking" and "carbon neutrality". The time is short and the challenges are enormous. As a forest products industry enterprise in my country, energy saving, emission reduction, quality improvement and consumption reduction are the development priorities of my country‘s forest products industry. The key work for the next development of the industry and enterprises.


Dr. Shi Lei from the International Bamboo and Rattan Center shared the theme of "Theory and Practice of Bamboo Forest Carbon Footprint". He first made a comparative analysis of domestic and foreign carbon markets. At present, my country‘s carbon trading market still has a large room for improvement compared with foreign countries. At the same time, among the domestic certification and verification agencies, the carbon footprint and carbon verification of the forestry manufacturing industry are still blank. He enumerated the practice of bamboo in carbon sequestration and increased sequestration, and developed and promulgated two industry standards for carbon measurement of bamboo forests and bamboo products. The carbon sink value of bamboo industry has a significant impact, fully improving the carbon sink capacity of bamboo forests.


Wu Shengfu, general manager of Beijing Green Forest Certification Co., Ltd. and secretary general of the National Carbon Footprint Innovation Alliance (in preparation), gave a detailed introduction to the current work of the Carbon Footprint National Innovation Alliance. He said that the alliance is currently conducting a number of research projects. At the same time, forest products industrial enterprises, such as advanced enterprises such as wood-based panels, wooden floors, wooden doors, and wooden furniture, have taken the lead in carrying out carbon footprint certification with Beijing Green Forest Certification Co., Ltd.


Carbon Footprint National Innovation Alliance (under preparation) is convening experts and alliance members to jointly formulate the following product carbon footprint standards; particleboard/density board carbon footprint standard, plywood carbon footprint standard, blockboard carbon footprint standard, wood floor carbon footprint standard, bamboo floor Carbon Footprint Standard, Panel Furniture Carbon Footprint Standard, Cabinet Carbon Footprint Standard, Wooden Door Carbon Footprint Standard, Wooden Furniture Carbon Footprint Standard, Small Wood Products Carbon Footprint Standard, Wooden Toys Carbon Footprint Standard, Outdoor Furniture Carbon Footprint Standard, Paper and Paper Products Carbon footprint standard, wood structure building carbon footprint standard, etc.

item.title: How to choose the right flooring - wood, bamboo, engineered or laminate
item.source: How to choose the right flooring - wood, bamboo, engineered or laminate
item.description:
Wooden floor is divided into: solid wood floor, laminate floor, solid wood composite floor, bamboo flooring.


1. Solid wood floor


Solid wood floor is a ground decoration material formed after drying and processing of wood. It has the characteristics of natural pattern, comfortable foot feeling and safe use. It is an ideal material for floor decoration such as bedrooms, living rooms and study rooms. The decorative style of solid wood returns to simplicity and the texture is natural. Today, when the forest coverage rate is declining, and environmental protection is vigorously advocated, solid wood flooring is even more precious.


The sound produced by the solid wood floor is not necessarily the floor itself, but may also be caused by the high moisture content of the wood keel and deformation. The choice of solid wood floor is to pursue its real and natural feeling, and the solid wood floor can be repaired and painted many times. The average moisture content of solid wood floors is best controlled at about 12%, and it is not good to be too dry or too wet.


2. Laminate flooring


The surface of laminate flooring is determined by the shape of the upper platen during the hot pressing process. The shape of the board is different, the surface is different, and its characteristics are also different. Laminate flooring is favored by more and more consumers due to its many advantages such as wear resistance, beautiful appearance, environmental protection, moisture resistance, flame retardant, moth resistance, convenient installation, easy cleaning and care, economical and practical, etc. With the continuous improvement of the quality of laminate flooring , The products are more artistic, personalized, more real, beautiful, lighter, more environmentally friendly, and the surface treatment technology is more advanced and diversified, which can better meet the needs of different markets.


3. Engineered wood parquet


Solid wood multi-layer floor, also known as solid wood engineered floor, is based on solid wood floor, through technological processing, the wood is decomposed and then combined into a new generation of solid wood floor, so that the world‘s precious and rare tree species can be fully and reasonably utilized, A small amount of precious tree species produces a large number of precious wood floors, so that the green forest resources can be used scientifically.


The solid wood multi-layer floor is made of multi-layer solid wood sheets, which are combined in a criss-cross manner, using adhesive, and hot-pressed into a board and then processed. The internal stress of the product has been balanced to a certain extent, which solves the problem of single-layer solid wood The floor is prone to moisture deformation, shrinkage and cracking, and is more suitable for geothermal floors. The thickness of the solid wood multi-layer surface board is generally 0.3mm-2mm, of which the three-layer solid wood can be up to 4mm.


4. Bamboo wood floor


Bamboo floor is divided into multi-layer glued bamboo floor and single-layer side-split bamboo floor. Bamboo floor has a natural and fresh appearance, delicate and smooth texture, moisture-proof, moisture-proof, anti-corrosion, strong toughness, elasticity and hard surface.


Bamboo wood engineered floor is a composite regeneration product of bamboo and wood. Its panels and bottom plates are made of bamboo, and the core layers are mostly fir, camphor and other woods. Bamboo wood composite floor has the advantages of bamboo floor. This floor core material uses wood as raw material, with good stability, strong and durable, good foot feel, warm in winter and cool in summer.

item.title: Wood flooring production process and advantages and disadvantages
item.source: Wood flooring production process and advantages and disadvantages
item.description:
Hardwood Floors: If you‘re on a budget, you might as well choose solid wood floors.


Solid wood flooring is processed from logs, so it has the advantages of natural texture, environmental protection and health. In addition, solid wood flooring also has the advantages of warm in winter and cool in summer, good touch, good elasticity, good sound insulation, sound absorption, insulation performance, and refurbishment.


However, solid wood flooring retains the characteristics of wood to the greatest extent, so it inevitably has shortcomings such as non-wear resistance, easy deformation, fear of acid and alkali. Taking all aspects into consideration, solid wood floors are suitable for laying places such as bedrooms, living rooms, study rooms, etc. of ordinary residences.


Laminate Flooring: If you have a limited budget, it is recommended that you choose Laminate Flooring, which is one of the most popular wood floors on the market.


The laminate floor is composed of a wear-resistant layer, a decorative layer, a high-density substrate layer, and a balance (moisture-proof) layer. Laminate flooring is not only affordable, rich in colors, but also has the advantages of good wear resistance, good acid and alkali resistance, easy maintenance, good anti-skid performance, wear resistance, antibacterial and so on. However, the laminate floor has a bad foot feel and can be repaired. Laminate flooring is suitable for ground decoration in ordinary houses and public places.


Bamboo Flooring


The floor made of bamboo can reduce the use of wood and protect the environment. Bamboo floors are fresh and elegant, with comfortable feet and good wear resistance, but Chinese families are not very accepting of bamboo floors. It may be related to the fact that the bamboo floor is afraid of scratches and is prone to delamination in the sun.


The above is some small knowledge about the floor, because the materials and characteristics are different, the effect of application in the home will be different, everyone should choose according to the style of the home and their own preferences, in order to effectively enhance the appearance of the home

item.title: The total annual sales of flooring products in 2020 is about 903 million square meters
item.source: The total annual sales of flooring products in 2020 is about 903 million square meters
item.description:
According to the incomplete statistics of China Forestry Products Industry Association, in 2020, the total annual sales volume of flooring products of enterprises of a certain scale in China will be about 903 million square meters, a year-on-year increase of 1.35%. Among them, the wood and bamboo flooring is about 412 million square meters, the stone wood plastic (shijing) floor is about 417 million square meters, and the wood plastic floor is about 74 million square meters.


1. Wood and Bamboo Flooring


In 2020, the total sales of wood and bamboo flooring in China is about 411.7 million square meters, a year-on-year decrease of about 3.04%, including the sales of laminate flooring of 199 million square meters, a year-on-year decrease of 7.96%; the sales of solid wood composite floors of 138 million square meters, a year-on-year increase of 8.66%; the sales of solid wood floors of 4100 10,000 square meters, a year-on-year decrease of 12.02%; bamboo flooring sales of 28.6 million square meters, a year-on-year decrease of 5.30%; other floor sales of 5.1 million square meters, a year-on-year increase of 10.87%.


2. Stone wood plastic floor (Shijing floor)


The total sales volume of stone-wood-plastic floor (Shijing floor) is about 417 million square meters, a year-on-year increase of 5.30%. The export volume of stone crystal flooring accounts for about 95.00% of the total.


3. wood plastic floor


The sales volume of wood-plastic floors was about 74 million square meters, a year-on-year increase of 5.71%. Exports of wood-plastic flooring account for about 60% of the total. Outdoor wood-plastic flooring accounts for about 95% of the total.


In 2020, the wood and bamboo flooring industry presents the following characteristics:


1. The domestic market is affected by the epidemic, and the sales of wood and bamboo flooring have declined;


2. The differentiation of domestic sales channels has become more and more significant, and the sales volume of engineering channels has continued to grow, driving the sales growth of parquet; retail channels The decrease in sales led to a decrease in the sales of solid wood flooring and laminate flooring.


3. The epidemic has little impact on the export volume of flooring, and the sales volume of Shijing flooring and wood-plastic flooring increased slightly.

item.title: Learn 4 steps to extend the service life of bamboo flooring and wood floors
item.source: Learn 4 steps to extend the service life of bamboo flooring and wood floors
item.description:
With the continuous development trend of social economy, people‘s consumption concept is also undergoing extraordinary changes. Everyone is slowly using bamboo flooring for interior decoration, but many customers do not understand how to maintain bamboo flooring. I will share with you the maintenance methods of bamboo flooring.


1. Maintain ventilation and dryness


Always ensure ventilation and dryness, so that the bamboo flooring and wood floor compounds can evaporate as much as possible, and often open windows and room doors to allow air convection, so that the room has a comfortable and clean natural environment.


2. Prevent damage to the surface of the bamboo wooden floor


The lacquer of the bamboo flooring and wood floor is a very core decorative design and protective layer, so it is necessary to minimize the collision of hard blocks, friction of metal materials, scratches of equipment, etc. In addition, it is also necessary to handle furniture when loading, unloading and exercising, and the feet of the furniture are also Put vulcanized rubber skin, etc.


3. Prevent sun exposure and precipitation from getting wet


If sunlight and precipitation immediately enter the bamboo flooring and wood floor of the house from the window, it will damage the bamboo and wood floor. The sun will not only accelerate the embrittlement of the car paint and glue, but also continue to cause the ground to crack. If it is wet by rain, it will cause the bamboo flooring and wood floor to swell and deform, and even make the ground grow mildew.


4. Frequent cleaning


In daily use, the road surface should be kept clean and hygienic, and the wooden floor should be cleaned. In fact, you should first use a broom to clean up the dust and impurities, and then use a dry towel to scrub. If you accidentally spill a chemical substance with water content on the road, you should wipe it off with a dry towel immediately. If you can, apply a layer of wax every once in a while to maintain the wood floors.

item.title: What are the disadvantages of solid wood flooring besides being expensive?
item.source: What are the disadvantages of solid wood flooring besides being expensive?
item.description:
Nowadays, many people prefer solid wood decoration materials, especially the choice of flooring. Most people think that solid wood flooring is the best among all floors, because solid wood flooring is environmentally friendly, and the renovated house is both beautiful and practical. There are many types of floors on the market. When buying floors, you must not blindly follow the trend. Although solid wood floors have many advantages, they may not be suitable for your own use.


Solid wood floors are made of natural materials. Solid wood floors do not use glue and do not emit a lot of formaldehyde. Therefore, solid wood floors are more environmentally friendly than other types of floors sold on the market. The pattern on the surface of the solid wood floor is very natural, and it is very comfortable to step on the solid wood floor. This kind of floor can be described as warm in winter and cool in summer, but the solid wood floor also has some shortcomings. The first is that its cost performance is very low.


The price of solid wood floors is particularly expensive, but wood floors are very easily corroded by some chemical substances during use. If the home is dark and humid, the solid wood floors will be deformed. Maintenance, otherwise the solid wood floor will definitely not be able to be used for a long time. Families living in the south must not choose solid wood floors.


The laminate floor is made of four layers of materials. The advantage of the laminate floor is that it can effectively isolate the moisture on the ground, and the emission of water vapor will not cause too much harm to it, because the laminate floor can prevent moisture. It is anti-expansion and can meet the heating function of geothermal, so its practicability is relatively high. The disadvantage of laminate flooring is that the comfort is relatively poor, and the production materials are not very environmentally friendly, and will emit some substances that are harmful to the human body. When using laminate flooring, although there is no need to maintain the wooden floor, if there is water stains on the floor, it must be wiped immediately, otherwise problems such as expansion will occur after a long time.


Solid wood engineered floor is similar to solid wood floor. This kind of floor has three layers. Its advantage is that the heat preservation is very good, and the effect of installation is also very good. The aesthetics of solid wood engineered floor and solid wood floor are comparable, but solid wood engineered floor The environmental protection is relatively poor, and it is afraid of wear and tear.


The bamboo floor is made of natural bamboo, and there are more than 20 production processes. This kind of floor is used by some large office buildings. maintainance.

item.title: Why do People consider Bamboo Flooring Over Other Floorings?
item.source: Why do People consider Bamboo Flooring Over Other Floorings?
item.description:
Bamboo is a sustainable, environmentally friendly flooring option that can be easily recycled. The natural variation of the bamboo plant and its ability to grow will make sure that any piece looks beautiful regardless of what style or design you have in mind. There are many reasons people think bamboo flooring is better than other types of flooring. This type of material is resistant to rotting, so it lasts for decades without needing any replacement. 


Bamboo can be easily cleaned, so it is an excellent choice for homes with pets or small children. Bamboo flooring is available in three different levels of hardness: soft, medium, and complex. The smooth variety is similar to carpeting, while the complex array is comparable to a solid hardwood floor. Bamboo has no grain, so it will not cup or warp over time, making bamboo incredibly durable. Natural bamboo is good for the environment, which is especially beneficial for those worried about carbon emissions. Bamboo is a tropical grass that can grow up to 4 feet each month.


1.Comfort and Style


Bamboo flooring offers a luxurious feel because it is rich in lignin. In addition, this type of flooring provides excellent thermal insulation, so it keeps the house warm during winter and cools during summer. Unlike other wood floors, there are no knots or grain patterns to be found in bamboo. It means that you can use bamboo in any house area, including the bathroom or kitchen. Bamboo flooring is available in a wide range of colors and styles. However, bamboo flooring is not recommended for rooms frequently used, such as the kitchen or bathroom. 


2.Dura-Beads


Unlike other types of hardwood flooring, bamboo flooring has something special. The materials used to make the beads are made from fibers woven together from different parts of the bamboo plant to create a material that is hard yet soft and flexible at the same time. These beads do not come off quickly since they act as the glue between the fiber layers. It is a fantastic characteristic that makes this type of flooring blend in so well with the overall color scheme of your home interior.


3.Easy Installation


This type of bamboo flooring might seem daunting initially, but it is straightforward to install. As long as you have the right tools, you can do it independently without having professional help. However, if you feel that you need a little assistance installing bamboo flooring, any professional should be able to do this for a reasonable price.


4.Harmless to People and Pets


Unlike most hardwood options out there, bamboo is friendly to almost everyone and everything in your home. It is entirely harmless to people, whether they are adults or babies. It is also environmentally friendly, and this makes it safe for pets. Finally, unlike other flooring options that can cause allergies, bamboo does not cause any respiratory hazards.


5.Durable Roofing Shingles


The hardest thing about installing bamboo flooring is ensuring that you have the right tools to get the job done right. You will need a small hammer, chisel, and a razor-sharp utility knife to correctly complete your bamboo installation project. Bamboo flooring can be installed on any solid surface. To get the right color and shade, you will want to add three different types of bamboo flooring to your home. There are mats made from black, red, and green varieties of bamboo. The best way to figure out which type you need is by looking at the color bands on the mats themselves.


6.Aesthetically Pleasing Look


These flooring plans tend to look good in all kinds of decors. They are available in various colors and designs, so you can choose whichever one goes with your unique style and taste. Choose from the traditional look that goes with an Asian or European style, or choose something a little different such as black and white or even taupe, to create interesting patterns on your walls and floors. 


The bamboo flooring can be an excellent choice for an eco-friendly, stylish, and comfortable alternative to hardwood floors. It will blend in anywhere around your home, including the entryway, kitchen, bathroom, and even bedroom. However, it is not recommended for kitchens or bathrooms since it gets dirty quickly.

item.title: Why Bamboo Flooring Is The Right Decision For Your House?
item.source: Why Bamboo Flooring Is The Right Decision For Your House?
item.description:
Spotting bamboo flooring today is not rare. In fact, many people today are choosing this over the traditional hardwood floors. Since this plant is able to regenerate itself, it can be a better replacement for the traditionally used wood. A hardwood tree takes up to or even more than 30 years to regenerate by itself. 


However, bamboo can do the same in only about five years. The toughness and eco-friendliness are other reasons why you need to install this flooring. The beauty a bamboo floor adds to your house is also unmatchable.  


Why Is Bamboo A Good Choice For Flooring?


Unique Beauty


The first advantage of having bamboo flooring done in your home is its unique style. The traditional hardwood floors are no longer wanted since people are more inclined towards beauty. Moreover, it is material that is not bound to time. Thus, it never goes out of style. If you have this flooring done, it will remain as attractive as it was on the very first day, even after a decade. 


Versatility


Floor and decor need to go hand in hand. Thus, you have to keep both of them matched to give your place an aesthetic look. Bamboo flooring comes in different styles and colors, which increases the chances of finding the right match for your place. 


Even if you have finished the décor, you will be able to get a suitable flooring design. But for the hardwood, the chances are pretty low. Additionally, there is no limitation of having a single type of design for the floor of the whole house. You can install the flooring according to the room. 


Unmatchable Durability


Bamboo is one of the strongest materials you can get for flooring. It is highly durable, which makes it a desirable option. When compared to oak, it is twice as hard. Because of its strength, bamboo has been used as a flooring material for both domestic and commercial purposes. Even the manufacturers are ready to take a warranty of at least 24 years. 


Much Affordable Option 


It is undeniable that flooring can cost a lot of money. Especially if you go for a material that is already expensive, you must be ready to splurge a good amount. And if the flooring is to be done on the whole house, add up the labor and material cost. 


But what if there is a material that does not cost much and will last longer? Bamboo is precisely that. It is one of the most affordable options you can take. You can get bamboo with premium lengths and width by paying half the amount of the traditional hardwoods. So, now living green is not as costly as it used to be.


Wide Availability


Previously finding bamboo was not as easy it is today. Especially after the green movement, you can easily find it in your locality. Since the material is readily available, you can get the flooring. With the increasing demand for bamboo flooring, many places ensure adequate supply. 


Easy Installation


The installation process of flooring can be tiring as well. But in the case of bamboo flooring, it is not an issue anymore. Instead, there are three ways of fitting it. The first method is fitting it on the subfloor by using glue. In this way, the flooring will stick with the subfloor. Another way of doing the same is by screwing or nailing it down. If you are worried about glue wearing off, this method will keep the subfloor and flooring attached. You can also have it floated over an underlay.  Today‘s bamboo flooring has a click fitting system on them, making the whole installation process easier. 


Hygienic 


The rational hardwood harbors dirt that can lead to allergies. Thus, hardwood is not the right choice for people allergic to dust or dirt particles. On the other hand, bamboo flooring does not let the dust particle sick to it, making it the right choice for allergic people. This type of flooring is resistant to mold and mildew. Hence, you do not have to worry about spending your whole day cleaning it up.


Summing Up! Having bamboo flooring in your house can be a great decision. Not only will your house look more beautiful, but you will be able to save a couple of bucks.
