item.title: What are the Pros and Cons of Bamboo Flooring?
item.source: What are the Pros and Cons of Bamboo Flooring?
item.description:
While planning to make any kind of changes in your house, the most important thing that you need to consider is the flooring that you will choose. The choice of flooring can impact the interiors of a place as it completes the look of interiors. As compared to the past years, there are now a variety of options that you will find in flooring, you can select the one that goes well with the look of your house and your budget as well.


In today time, most people have become considerate about the use of the flooring that does not harm the environment in any manner. You will find people who are minimalistic, thus they ensure that they do not buy anything that can increase their carbon footprints. The online platform gives you the option to explore various designs and styles that are available in flooring.


Bamboo Flooring


Bamboo flooring has been there for a long time now, but only recently, it has become a popular choice for people who wish to add new flooring to their house. While bamboo flooring has gained popularity because of the go green reason, but it is not something that everyone likes. It is necessary for you to understand all the aspects before you invest in this flooring option.


What are the benefits of Bamboo Flooring?


The best part about bamboo as the material is that it is renewable. There are many varieties that you can grow it per foot in a day. With such a great growth rate, it is easy to understand that how renewable bamboo is as compared to other materials such as the hardwood trees that can take almost 120 years to gain maturity.


Many people are not aware of the fact that bamboo is very strong, it is harder than all other materials that are used for flooring purposes. There are some species of it that are as hard as the red oak tree.  Bamboo, as a flooring material is always considered higher than maple.


The excellent part about bamboo is that it has a great resistance to moisture, this is one of the reasons why people prefer to use it. As bamboo is grown more in tropical places, thus it is also resistant to any kind of spills. As compared to the common belief, it is also an excellent alternative for the bathroom and kitchen area.  These are the places where traditional hardwoods can be tough to use.


Once the installation of bamboo flooring is complete, then it is also easy to take care of the material. If you want the bamboo flooring to look new for a long time and you don’t want any kind of dust and dirt on it, then vacuuming and sweeping is all you need to do.


Bamboo is easily available for the purpose of flooring and other purposes as well.  You can find a good bamboo flooring dealer/manufacturer that can offer you the best quality flooring options as per your specific needs and budget.  You can also find many designing and styling options in flooring which can help you choose the best one for your house.


Why Bamboo flooring is not the right option for you?


Just like any product, bamboo also has pros and cons, thus it is essential to discuss the negative aspects that are linked to it: Most of the bamboo that is imported in different countries, it is produced in China. This is where the eco-friendly choice of people goes for a toss as it has to be shipped from a different country. However, the harvesting of bamboo has also started in other countries so that people can easily buy it without spending a lot of money on shipping. 


You have to be careful while choosing a dealer if you wish to use the flooring for a long time. There are many manufacturers/dealers that you can find on the internet, but this does not mean that all of them will offer quality products. 


Many people end up buying cheap quality bamboo, which makes them face trouble in the future. Thus, it is essential to assess the quality and price of the product that you are planning to buy.

item.title: How to choose the best Bamboo Flooring?
item.source: How to choose the best Bamboo Flooring?
item.description:
If you are planning to make any kind of changes in the flooring of your house; then there are many aspects that you should remember. As compared to the past years, there are now a variety of options that you can find in bamboo flooring. The reason why bamboo has become a common material to use in different products is that it comes with good quality and it is good for the environment as well.  This is why you will find many people who choose bamboo to change the flooring of their home and office.


As compared to hardwood, bamboo grows easily as it takes only 5-6 years as compared to 25-30 years that trees take to grow. As most people understand the fact that how cutting trees are damaging the environment, thus the harvest of bamboo is encouraged more as it helps in saving trees that are otherwise chopped to get wood for various purposes.


While other flooring options may confuse you, Bamboo is a great choice to make. It also demands limited resources and time, all you need to do is find a good and experienced carpenter who can work on the flooring as not bamboo flooring are not the same, thus you need to be particular about any choice you make. 


By doing some research on the internet, you can find some of the best professionals that deal in bamboo flooring.


Here are some of the tips that will help you find the best option in bamboo flooring:


The kind of flooring you want


You can find 2 types of floorboards in bamboo including strand woven and traditional.  The traditional bamboo flooring generally comes in 2 kinds of grain directions including vertical and horizontal. It could be solid or engineered; it is almost 25% harder than the maple and oak flooring. It is still easy to be gouged or scratched.  This is why many people complain when they install traditional flooring boards.


This is why a better option is to choose strand-woven bamboo as it is made with the use of safe adhesives that are environment friendly as well.  This flooring option is durable and strong thus you can easily use it for many long years without worrying about the wear and tear that can happen to it. 


As compared to the traditional bamboo, it is not easy to scratch this flooring.


The hardness of flooring


It is an important aspect to consider that how hard the flooring is. A measurement scale for hardness is used which is known as the Janka Hardness scale, you can measure the thickness of flooring on it. If you have children or pets at your place, then the thickness rating of the flooring should be more than 2300. You can also ask for samples to understand that which flooring option will be the best as per the needs of your house. 


Is the manufacturing of flooring environment-friendly?


If the flooring is strand-wove or engineered, then the chances are that it has been processed to increase the effectiveness of it.  You should look for the bamboo flooring that is made without any kind of non-off gassing adhesives and the one that is formaldehyde-free. 


Your purpose in buying the flooring


You should also be specific of the purpose for which you need the flooring; do you need for commercial or residential purpose?  Do you want to buy an option that can easily deal with the high-traffic situation? Is moisture a concern for you?  Answering all such questions will help you select the best option for flooring that will go well with your requirements. 


Do you wish to buy matching accessories?


If you want the interiors of your house to look outstanding, then adding some bamboo accessories is an excellent choice to make. You can easily add stairs, matching baseboard, flooring vents, stair nosing, and base shoe. 


Is it under your budget?


It is important to consider the budget aspect before you choose any particular option in flooring for your house or office. 


Warranty of the flooring


Any flooring that you buy from a good manufacturer comes with a warranty. Look forward to buying the one that matches your needs.

item.title: Get to know where and why you should use bamboo flooring
item.source: Get to know where and why you should use bamboo flooring
item.description:
Bamboo flooring is an excellent choice and it is a stylish and the most sophisticated style to add. Not only is it hard wearing, but it is also very sustainable and eco-friendly flooring. Bamboo flooring comes with eco-friendly properties. It is a fast-growing grass, making it more sustainable than hardwood. A bamboo plant reaches maturity in about 5 years as compared to the hardwood tree that takes at least 25 years.  Bamboo self-regenerate and it continues to grow. Bamboo grows without the need for chemicals.


To make sure you are getting a truly eco-friendly bamboo floor, look for 100% FSC. This means that the whole process from the bamboo forest to the retailer have undergone checks to ensure that they are not contributing to the destruction of the forest and ecosystem.


Why You Should Choose Bamboo Flooring


Bamboo flooring is a popular choice who wants a new material to replace what already exists in their home. Some types of wood flooring can be inappropriate when it comes to certain conditions such as higher levels of humidity. Bamboo offers several advantages over traditional flooring.


Here are the reasons to choose bamboo flooring


Durable


Bamboo offers superior durability to withstand a great deal of use. While this makes bamboo the ideal flooring material for a home‘s entryway, these same properties also make it a great choice for flooring


Environmentally Friendly


Bamboo is a natural product and is highly renewable. It is environmentally friendly. Rather than being an actual tree, bamboo is a grass that regrows after being monitored and harvested using strict standards. It doesn‘t require the use of chemicals in order to clean or maintain it. Due to its ease of renewability, it is sustainable without using harsh chemicals, bamboo is better for the environment. 


Various Colour Options


Bamboo is just like other flooring materials. It is available in array of attractive colours and finishes. This helps homeowners to choose different colour schemes to match the various rooms of their home.


Cozy Feeling


Bamboo provides a cozy feeling in a home. It adds warmth, depth, and richness to the room that can be difficult to obtain by using other flooring materials. The way bamboo looks provides a unique visual appeal that allows homeowners to feel relaxed. 


Affordable Flooring Option


Some flooring can be challenging on the budget. Bamboo flooring is affordable and provides the rich and warm looks for their homes at a price that is friendly to their budget. 


Look Beautiful


Among flooring options to traditional hardwood floors, the bamboo floor is hard to resist. This natural material is patterned with streaks and renders it unique and appealing.


Where can I use bamboo flooring?


You can install bamboo flooring in rooms but the only exception to this would be rooms with excess water, like bathrooms. Bamboo flooring does not dent or scratch easily. As a floor, it can become a part of any place that receives maximum public like corridors and living rooms in homes. Bamboo flooring also serves in offices, schools, studios, hotel lobbies, auditoriums, conference halls, and restaurants.


Bamboo flooring is a versatile option. It can be used in any usual rooms, like bedrooms, living spaces, kitchens, and studies.  It provides dimensional stability and you can use it in rooms where temperatures and humidity change.  Furthermore, you get to choose from a range of bamboo flooring that is compatible with under floor heating.  


Bamboo is a fast-renewing resource and it gets completely ready in 5 to 6 years. New stalks regrow from the very plant. Bamboo flooring costs less than a traditional wood and even more affordable in contrast with an exotic varieties. It is extremely strong, a quality bamboo floor that can last decades with care and minimum awareness to grit, high heels, and pets‘ nails.


Bamboo is the best flooring choice offering the beauty and elegance of a natural product. It is a cost effective and inexpensive alternative to hardwood. Bamboo flooring is hygienic, easy to clean, and great flooring for people having allergies. You can get them in different colours, styles, surface finishes, patterns, and plank sizes. Bamboo floorings are much durable and solid and therefore they last for a long time.

item.title: Points to be considered in buying the bamboo flooring
item.source: Points to be considered in buying the bamboo flooring
item.description:
Bamboo flooring is in vogue nowadays which has made the people more fascinated towards the benefits of bamboo flooring. Whatever we buy from the market, it is important to keep some information about the product so that one cannot deceive us in selling duplicate product to us. It is also significant to observe that what is the requirement of the area where we want to install the bamboo flooring? Let’s focus in detail about certain things which is important to consider while buying the bamboo flooring:


Area where bamboo flooring is required: Bamboo flooring is suitable for any kind of place due to its durability and versatility. It is mandatory to see where the bamboo are going to be installed. Bamboo flooring looks fantastic in the living room, kitchen, lobby, bedrooms, and corridors but not suitable for bathrooms. Bathrooms are water resistant still this is the area where water is spilled all the time. Therefore, bamboo flooring will not be a wise decision. Instead any other suitable alternative which is water resistant can be used.


The level of the subfloor: Before laying bamboos on the floor, it is relevant to check the level of the room. If the bamboos are placed on the existing flooring then it is important to ensure that the subfloor is flat, dry and has uniformity in levelling of the room. The method of installation varies due to the kind of subfloor in your property. Thus, it is advised to consult the professionals of floor fitter before the installation of the bamboo flooring.


Traffic expected in the room: Bamboo flooring looks beautiful wherever you use it. It is durable and has good strength to bear. The different variety has different kinds of resistance power therefore strand woven bamboo flooring is the best one for the place where the traffic is high. Like offices, commercial properties and so on.


Check the budget to install bamboo flooring: The immense variety available in the market fluctuates the pricing of the bamboo flooring. The constructions of the plank, the polishing and varnishing, the fitting system are the cause of change in the cost of the bamboo flooring. The flooring which has a click fitting system and an anti-slip lacquer is more expensive than other kinds of bamboo flooring.


Type of flooring finish is desired: In all other kinds of flooring, there are two categories of the finishing of the floor depending upon the final choice of the owner. Similarly, bamboo flooring has two kinds of finishing. One is a satin matt lacquer which is more shiny and glossy and the other one is anti-slip lacquer which has matt finish and does not shine like satin matt lacquers. The anti-slip lacquer is suitable for the places which have high traffic because all kinds of visitors old or young visit the places.


Matching accessories: the accessories which are easily available for the kind of flooring is good to install otherwise it is futile to waste a lot of time and money for the things which are not easily available.


Accessories for the flooring are: 


Flush reducers
Skirting
Pipe covers
Beadings
Stair nosing

Thresholds


Check the benefits of bamboo flooring: it is very important to check the advantages of the bamboo flooring before going for this. The analysis can be done to compare the different kinds of flooring. Sometimes, it is also important to see the need and requirement of the customer to install a particular kind of flooring. The analyses to be done to find out which kind of flooring fulfills the demand of the customers with maximum benefits. The benefits of installing bamboo flooring are:


Vast variety available

Eco-friendly with high resistance power

 Easy to install with minimum expenditure

Convenient to maintain its cleanliness


More durable than most hardwood flooring


Style and colour of the bamboo flooring: the style and colour you want is completely dependent upon the three different kinds of bamboo flooring. It is advisable to contact the professional expert to guide you to go for a kind of flooring. The bamboo flooring is also available in natural colour and carbonized effect which has more dark brown tones. The different stains and colour can be added as per the choice to give completely a different and unique shade.

item.title: Know About the Various Types of Bamboo Flooring
item.source: Know About the Various Types of Bamboo Flooring
item.description:
Bamboo is trendy flooring that can elevate the look of the space almost instantly. It has an appearance similar to hardwood but with distinct and different features. Bamboo is a good material for people who like something different and want to make a statement by using a renewable resource. Bamboo works in almost any home style and is best suited for contemporary settings.


When you are trying to decide the appropriate type of bamboo floors for your home you should consider different types of bamboo flooring. Bamboo flooring comes in various types and this installation method may impact convenience and cost. Given are the types of bamboo flooring.


Types of Bamboo Flooring


Grain Types


Bamboo flooring comes in different grain types. Each one carries different characteristics and this will help the buyers to decide which type of bamboo to purchase and install in their property. The grain type depends greatly on the overall look the buyer is trying to achieve.


Horizontal Bamboo


Horizontal bamboo is the planks placed next to one another facing in a horizontal direction. They are attached to each other before being pressurized and finished. They randomly display the knuckles, or growth rings, of the stalk.


Vertical Bamboo


This refers to planks placed next to one another facing in a vertical direction. They all are attached to each other before being pressurized and finished while creating a smooth uniform look.


Strand-Woven Bamboo


Strand-woven is the bamboo planks made from the remaining strands of the stalk that are trimmed away from the long bamboo fillets. These are compressed with an adhesive before being pressurized and finished. They are twice harder than horizontal and vertical bamboo.


Installation Types of Bamboo Flooring


Choosing bamboo flooring based on the installation type first is a wise decision because some installation types are more complicated. A complicated installation can cost more than others. 


There are a few different installation methods for bamboo flooring such as a nail or glue down the process, glue-seam floating installation, and glue less-click installation. By considering the installation type, you will buy the bamboo flooring to finish the job.


Nail Down/Glue Down


Sometimes flooring is very hard, it is impossible to get the nails flush with the flooring with a standard hammer. Use of special and specific tools for the job is required.  This includes an electric hammer or stapler to successfully complete this job correctly. Installation instructions and guidelines depend upon the sub-flooring.  Experienced workers can install this type of bamboo flooring in the best way.


Floating: Glue-Seam


This installation requires an underlayment to protect the bamboo from the sub-flooring material. You need a moisture barrier as well. It is important to layout the flooring before adding any glue adhesive. This is because of how quickly the adhesive dries, it is difficult to separate the flooring planks and correct any mistakes after just a few seconds. The best is to layout the complete floor design and go back in sections with the glue.


Floating: Glue less-Click


It is the simplest bamboo installation method.  This method wont require any glue or nails, so it is easy for floor installation in new homes. The planks simply click together and get into place. Those who are looking to install their own flooring must go for it as it is the best way to do it. There is no concern about whether the floor will come apart if the pieces don’t fit together. The finished product appears much like the other installation methods.


Once installed, you dont have to do too much to keep them clean. There is no need for invasive maintenance projects. With a sweep or vacuum your floors every once in a while to get rid of debris.


Bamboo flooring has got a lot of attention since it was first introduced some decades ago. In most ways, bamboo floors perform in the same way as hardwood. Most importantly, these floors are non-allergenic and some people have chemical sensitivities. If this is you, there are some very good bamboo flooring products that omit these chemicals. Bamboo is fairly priced and most of the major flooring manufacturers are selling it on the Internet because of its high demand.

item.title: The Process of Manufacturing of Bamboo Flooring
item.source: The Process of Manufacturing of Bamboo Flooring
item.description:
Bamboo is the fastest growing grass. It is not manufactured in the industries but its natural habitat is the soil where it is grown. Bamboo floors are manufactured from the bamboo plant. The major production of bamboo plants are done in the different parts of Asia. The vast variety of bamboo plants is grown but Moso bamboo plants are usually used for flooring.


Features of Bamboo flooring


Bamboo flooring has become the choice of many people due to its physical similarities to hardwoods. The bamboo floors are highly recommended due to its strength, cost effective, eco-friendly and its natural resistance to insects and moisture. It is high in demand due to its feature of taking the person closer to nature.


The Manufacturing process of bamboo flooring


As the vast variety of bamboo plants are grown and available too, different kinds of floor are manufactured according to the need and requirement of the people. These bamboo plants are cut to similar lengths and are stained and varnished or sometimes people prefer using it in its natural look.


Bamboo flooring is made by cutting, slicing the mature bamboo pole into strips. The outer rough area of the bamboo plant which has nodes on it, are removed to make its surface smooth. To give different colour or making its colour darker or lighter is completely dependent on the mixture in which it is boiled. The bamboo plant is also boiled in the solution of boric acid or lime to remove the starch and sugar in it. It also undergoes a carbonizing process to give different shade to the flooring.


The manufactured bamboo flooring is made available in planks with vertical or horizontal orientation. It is also being laminated to give the impact of natural shine which takes you in the close proximity of nature. The idea of putting bamboo flooring has numerous advantages over its disadvantages. The lamination gives uniform impact in the flooring.


There are the different types of bamboo flooring which will cover down:


Strand woven bamboo- It is harder than wood flooring. It is woven together which is totally compressed under heat along with pressure in order to form the plank flooring. The beautiful designs and patterns can be created to make it appealing. It is durable and can be used for a longer period of time.


Horizontal bamboo- In this type, bamboo strips are glued together in horizontal form for plank flooring. In this type the grains of the bamboo are evident and it will show wider on the surface of the floor. It is cut into small, thin strips. The layers of lacquer are added to the surface to the surface to protect and finish the floor. The flooring is wider and the grain pattern is more evident.


Vertical bamboo- In this type, bamboo strips are glued together in vertical form for plank flooring. In this type of flooring the bamboo grain is thinner and it is less evident on the floor surface.


Maintenance of the bamboo flooring


It is quite easy to maintain its natural shine for a longer period of time. It does not even demand high repairing and maintenance costs. In fact, it is much easier to clean and mop. It is completely safe for the kids and the people who are suffering due to any kind of allergies. It is recommended to use a dust mop to remove the dirt or grime. Even a mop with hard bristles can also be used to clean the dirt from its crevices.


We can say that the bamboo flooring is not only good for residential purposes but also for official places. It is easy to clean and good for allergy sufferers as they don’t face any kind of dust or dust mites. Due to its natural beauty, it is also used in restaurants and hotels to give you a better feel of connecting with nature. They are also used in resorts which are constructed in the outskirts of the city. The bamboo flooring is a highly recommended concept and people use it intensively in their homes or offices to give a natural look to the space. It is soothing to the eyes and creates an aura of beauty and elegance to provide better working conditions.

They are inexpensive in nature where people will not have to spend extra money to get their flooring done. They tend to be harder and it will prove more durable in nature which will benefit the person for a longer period. They can be looked after easily and it can be installed quickly.  Apart from that they are easy to fix and can be done over an underlay.


We can say that this type of flooring is best for residential one which is easy to clean and best option for allergy sufferers as they don’t face any kind of dust or dust mites. Due to its natural beauty, it is also used in restaurants and hotels to give you a better feel of connecting with nature. They are also used in resorts which are constructed in the outskirts of the city and create a difference in the feel. The bamboo flooring is a highly recommended concept and people use it intensively in their homes or offices to give a natural look to the space. It is soothing to the eyes and creates an aura to work better. It is used to feel closer with nature and feel its relevance in our life.

item.title: Top Questions to Ask before Buying a Bamboo Floor
item.source: Top Questions to Ask before Buying a Bamboo Floor
item.description:
After deciding that you want to install bamboo flooring in your home, there are plenty of things you need to do before. Installing bamboo flooring is not as easy as eating cake, just go to the market, buy the product, install it and you are ready to walk on your new floor. It’s not as easy it looks; you need to ask so many things to yourself and the manufacturer. You can read What to consider while buying bamboo flooring for a house to prepare yourself well. And, for understanding what you should ask the manufacturer, keep reading. 


In addition to the type, style and colour of the bamboo, there are plenty of other things you need to consider and ask before buying bamboo flooring from any buyer. Go through the below-given questions in the checklist we have made for you to help to make a better decision. 


Before you buy: Have a look at the checklist: 


What is the grade of bamboo?


If we are talking about the bamboo grading system, there is no such recognized system exist. Everyone has their own, some check through their experience and some through references. Most of the manufacturers grade bamboo into two categories A & B grade. The dissimilarity between their quality, type and colour makes the difference in their price. Also, durability is another factor in which manufacturers and buyers recognize their best type of bamboo flooring. 


Grade A type of bamboo has no fungus or mould, is steady in colour, and is fully matured at harvesting. Grade B type of bamboo is usually having fungus, may not be steady in colour, and is harvested before maturation. As per the description, grade B bamboo might be weaker as compared to the grade A and need replacement or to repair in the future, even though you are taking care of them at their best. You will get grade A bamboo at a higher cost whereas grade B has a relatively low cost. 


What type of finishing product and how many coats are used on the bamboo floor? 


If you choose quality products and authorized brands for finishing the bamboo floor, this might take six to seven coats that include one more extra coat of aluminium oxide which is considered as the most durable type of coating in the market. Whereas, cheaper brands make it finish in just three coats that have no guarantee for future quality. If you are investing money, make sure you are investing in something good. Do not invest at something non-profitable and durable just for the sake of low cost. 


How much colour variation exists in the product? 


The greater the quality, the lesser or even zero colour variation. Whereas, the cheaper product has more than two colour variation and might get dull after some time. It totally depends on the seller what kind of quality you are getting in your product. Some manufacturers and sellers also provide some boxes of different coloured bamboo flooring. 


Is the bamboo flooring manufactured in a certified factory? 


Check this before buying. If the bamboo flooring factory is certified by ISO 9002, the material would likely be made of grade A type of bamboo which is a properly harvested bamboo with no mould or fungus on it. If not, then bamboo would be grade B type or even less than that. It is better to check the certification of the company and then select the company for bamboo flooring. 


What are the species of bamboo available that are used for flooring? 


Most preferably, Moso is the species out of which most authentic, durable and strong bamboo flooring is made up of. It is used at a great level because of its qualities plus it doesn’t infringe the supply of food of any creature. Harvesting of Moso bamboo can be done repeatedly without interrupting any creature’s food chain or putting the ecosystem into danger. 


What are the values of formaldehyde emission the bamboo flooring adheres to? 


Though formaldehyde is a naturally occurred substance that can be found in both outdoor and indoor air there is still a concern to prevent the commission of this substance. Formaldehyde can cause a threat to the life of human, eco-friendliness of the bamboo. Knowing the value of formaldehyde emission in the bamboo would help you to choose a better product for your house.

item.title: Bamboo Floors: Throughout the House, also in Kitchens and Bathrooms
item.source: Bamboo Floors: Throughout the House, also in Kitchens and Bathrooms
item.description:
It is not always easy to find the ideal solution for the home floor. A lot of people look for an option that can be installed in all rooms including the kitchen and bathroom, and that is also a natural and ecological product. For these people, bamboo flooring, parquets or pallets may be what they‘re looking for. Environmentally friendly, or "green" materials are increasingly appreciated and popular, something that also influences the style they can bring. A bamboo wood flooring, although not exactly a wood, is a durable, economical solution that looks really good in both modern and traditional environments.


What is Bamboo Really?


Bamboo is a fast-growing herb, much more than any tree, so it is a highly renewable resource. That‘s why many owners, concerned about the environment and its ecological footprint, decide to use bamboo for the floor of their home, including kitchen and even outdoor bathrooms. This accelerated growth rate allows to have in 3 years a plant with the optimal size for exploitation, while according to what kind of tree we would be talking about decades. This is one of the reasons that allows the price of bamboo to be significantly lower than that of most woods.


Features and Types of Bamboo Soils


Solid bamboo flooring is manufactured by joining bamboo boards or strips. They have a more natural appearance and can be dyed or varnished of any colour. They are somewhat less resistant to moisture than processed ones. When they start to show signs of wear, simply apply a fine sandpaper and give a new layer of the finish for which you have opted. Installation is usually done by gluing the pallet to the ground or by nailing it on track. These types of installation are more complex and offer greater stability. Soils from bamboo fibres, that go through an industrial process, end up looking very similar to the original and gain some additional characteristics:


Increased moisture resistance.


Easier to maintain.


Increased shock and torque resistance.


They are available in click-system slats that allow anyone to install them easily. It is a type of floating platform that is installed without attaching to the subfloor. It is greatly simplifying, an alternative to a laminate floor or a multilayer platform. This type of bamboo flooring is ideal for use in kitchens and bathrooms. The main drawback is that once it has worn out, after many years of use, it cannot be repaired with a simple sandpaper, and must be replaced.


The Price of Bamboo Pavements


One can find a huge range of variability in prices and qualities as per the design and types. Bamboo flooring manufacturers and importers can provide the services at an affordable price as compared to alternative products like wood flooring, vinyl or laminates. 


What kind of finish does the bamboo floor use and what are its virtues?


Bamboo floors are finished with seven layers of 100% cured solids, UV of urethane, which makes the floors resistant to abrasion, chemicals and stains, fire, indentation and oiling. In addition, bamboo floors with this type of special finishes have another great virtue in electrostatic prevention.


Compared to hardwood floors, what virtues does the bamboo floor have?


Compared to hardwood floors, bamboo floors have many virtues. First of all, the bamboo flooring is a product that contributes to the environment and the bamboo growing season is much shorter than the decades of hardwood forests to mature. Each year, a "mother tree" makes several new stems that grow in their entire length in a few months to mature and give hardness in about five years, so bamboo floors have abundant natural resources. Secondly bamboo floors have higher hardness, so it is more durable than hardwood flooring. The third, bamboo floors can be installed in a very short time being this very conveniently, (as it comes ready and finished there is no need to polish, sand and give additional finishes like woods, which take up a long time until months for installation). Once installed, can be nailed or glued. Except for the above, bamboo floors have better grain and are more elegant and graceful than hardwood floors.

item.title: Tips to Maintain the Shine of Bamboo Flooring for a Long Time
item.source: Tips to Maintain the Shine of Bamboo Flooring for a Long Time
item.description:
Bamboo flooring is a wonderful option available in the market when it comes to natural flooring. This type of floors is not only saving your money investment in high-class floors but are eco-friendly also which means you don’t need any air purifier in your home. Along with environment friendly, this product is easy to maintain that loses its shine only if you don’t take care of it properly. Bamboo is some kind of similar thing to hardwood but is less expensive. This product is durable and manufactured from the plant that doesn’t take much time to grow again which means it is totally renewable. 


Buying and Installing this product in your home is not an easy deal indeed, you need to find the best manufacturer in the market plus getting a good deal at the rate is another challenge. You can make it easy after reading proper information like Your ultimate guide to understanding bamboo flooring or Top questions to ask before buying a bamboo floor. Now, the question arises, how would you maintain and keep it restored after installation? Well! In this blog, we will be sharing some tips and precautions through which you can easily maintain the shine of your bamboo flooring for a long time. 


Bamboo flooring Wax


A wax coat needs periodic buffing using complex, expensive and giant machinery. This would be too much effort to make for most of the people. This is one of the reasons, a wax surface coating is only suggested for a bamboo flooring in obvious applications of commercial. A urethane and proper finish are more suitable for most installations. Once a wax treatment has been applied on the bamboo flooring then no other type of coating would be required on it. 


Regular cleaning 


Small dust particles of sand and another type of bacterial pollutants represent the biggest threat to the beauty of the surface and health of the people living around. These tiny dust particles behave like the shingles of a portion of sandpaper and when people walk over the surface, they are more tend to travel across the house and cause various infections to people living there. 


In order to prevent these small dust particles, travel across the house, you should either vacuum or sweep a bamboo floor constantly. Do not let the coarse material to build upon the floor or they blemish the floor’s surface over time. 


Mats and rugs can also be a reason through which dust particles travel into the house from one corner to another, so to prevent it, make you are cleaning the rugs and mats daily with a mop. You can use cleaning products that are specifically manufactured to clean bamboo floors. 


Water 


As compared to the hardwoods, bamboo is more unaffected to damage caused by water. Though, it is still dangerous to clean the bamboo floor with water. Never clean the bamboo floor with a wet mop or immense water no matter what. It can still cause damage to your floor like it might lose its shine. 


If by mistake, liquid spilt on the bamboo floor, it required to wiped off immediately with cotton cloth so that it leaves no water drop left on the floor. If you are using bamboo cleaning products that are required to work with water then make sure you are using very less amount of water in it or as per the instructions given on the product. You can also use non-greasy products to clean the bamboo floor. For more information, you can confirm it from the experts of bamboo flooring, they will tell you the name of the best products and methods to clean the surface. 


Maintenance through prevention 


In wet milieu, place mats or rugs in front of high dampness places, for example, in front of bath stalls or sinks. Be sure that these rugs don’t have any backing of rubber as it will suffocate the bamboo which eventually led to the discolour. 


Make sure that heavy furniture shouldn’t be dragged over the bamboo floor. You must also put felt pads or thick fabric under the legs of heavy furniture so that it does not cause any divot to the floor. If your furniture contains casters, do not forget to replace with felt supported casters or removed permanently.

item.title: Natural Bamboo Flooring: Care and Cleaning Tips
item.source: Natural Bamboo Flooring: Care and Cleaning Tips
item.description:
Bamboo floors quickly become one of the most sought-after floors, thanks to the beauty it gives to the whole house.  As all other materials used on floors, bamboo flooring must be carefully maintained if they are to enjoy the aesthetics for a long time. With the following guidelines you will get the most out of your bamboo floor.

Cleaning your natural bamboo floor

Bamboo floors, like their wooden counterparts, are too much water and moisture averse. This should be taken into account when cleaning such a floor. For daily cleaning, use either a flat microfiber wiper or a dry dust wiper. If you need to use a vacuum cleaner, you need to keep the attachment soft at the bottom so that the bottom is not scratched. Note that these techniques have omitted the use of water. If food or liquids have been spilled, clean the floor with a slightly moistened soft cloth that must not be pressed onto the floor surface.  Bamboo flooring should not be cleaned with polishes, waxes, oil soaps or solvent cleaners despite dirt. There are floor cleaners specially designed for bamboo floors that you can buy.

Do not expose bamboo soil to direct sunlight

Direct sun rays counteract the quality of your bamboo floor. Prolonged exposure to these rays will fade the natural colour of the bamboo, undermining the overall attractiveness. You should therefore ensure that the rays are kept away by curtains and blinds.

Minimization of humidity in the room

Humidity is another element of the weather that, if not activated, can really damage your bamboo floor. If there is too much moisture, the individual bamboo planks expand, leading to cracks. On the other hand, the low humidity causes the boards to shrink, which means that the floor becomes uneven.

What not to do on the bamboo floor?


Some of the worst enemies for your bamboo floor are scratches and furrows. For this purpose, you should refrain from walking with sharp heels on the floor.  When you move objects across the floor, try to lift them off the ground instead of pushing them (if you need to push them, use a cart with large, smooth wheels).


Recommendations before and after installing your Bamboo Floor:


A site evaluation should be done prior to delivery of the bamboo floors. Please check the following:


The site must be completely closed including doors and windows.
The place should be moisture free.

All concrete, masonry, plastering, plastering and wet work among others must be completed and well dry.

 All textures and paint layers must be completed.

 Make sure the soil is not exposed to extreme moisture conditions.
The iron or plate on which the bamboo floor is to be installed must be as level as possible. This will be determined by the installer.

 The ambient temperature must be at least 180C before and during installation.

 Remove debris from expansion gaps before starting installation.

Review the tables and make sure that the surface is not damaged before starting the installation.


To provide a better service for your use and protect your rights, please follow the following maintenance instructions strictly. Bamboo flooring manufacturers do not assume responsibility for operations that disobey the following rules:


Keep the floor clean and use soft cushioning fabric, a dry or semi-wet cloth, vacuum cleaner, to gently clean the floor every day.

 Avoid watering volumes of water or other liquids. Dry spilled liquids and immediately clean the floor if that happens.

 Keep the place as dry as possible.

 Make sure that the heating, ventilation and air conditioning system is working properly, with normal humidity levels. Relative indoor humidity should be between 40 and 50% throughout the year. In humid climates, carefully monitor doors, windows, and walls so there are no water leaks.

 Keep windows open for ventilation in summer time and often also to adjust the indoor temperature

 Place a piece of plush or mat at the entrance of the place where the bamboo floor is installed to avoid dust and sand. At the same time, the plush should be kept clean.

 Never work on the bamboo floor surface with nails or enter with shoes with metal nails or pointed heel.

 Use special wax or varnish for wood floors according to the condition of service from time to time.

 Before placing furniture on the bamboo floor, use pad guard on the bottom of all the furniture legs.

 Apply a special floor wax to the area where it has been a little scratched.

 Do not allow heavy and sharp things to be put directly on the bamboo floor.

 Do not use cleaning products containing ammonia, acids or spray; as they can damage the finish of the floor and can leave it slippery or sticky.

 Do not clean the floor with washing machines.

Avoid pets, as pets may scratch or scratch the floor.


The bamboo flooring should be kept free of dust and dirt. Regularly sweeping with a soft brush will ensure that dust does not do you any damage. Take extra steps to ensure that dirt and dust on the soles of the shoes do not come into contact with the surface of the bamboo floor, you can do this by placing carpets, both at the entrances to your premises and on the doors leading to each room.

item.title: Solid Bamboo Flooring: The Element of Future
item.source: Solid Bamboo Flooring: The Element of Future
item.description:
Solid bamboo flooring has appeared not many years ago, however, they have natural properties, with elegant finishes, amazing colour and  precise process to make a total beyond than the most traditional hardwood flooring. Thanks to their different shades, they adapt perfectly to classic or more modern atmospheres and any type of room. Its sustainability, maintenance and technical characteristics have made it the material to be taken into account for the development of pavements in the coming years.


Environmentally friendly


The most noteworthy quality of the solid bamboo flooring is its respect for the environment. While it is true that today, renowned brands and manufacturers of wooden pallets meet requirements of sustainability that allow to obtain the wood in the best conditions and destroy the environment as little as possible.


With the solid bamboo flooring, humans will have a leap in quality in terms of ecology. Thanks to its form of production, through bamboo reeds, the impact on nature is almost minimal. You can collect a third of the amount of bamboo that exists today, every year, without its presence being compromised and allowing it to reproduce sustainably to continue the exploitation of it.


In a world where resources are increasingly limited, we are forced to obtain products that can remain for many years for use without compromising the amount of resources that we will continue to consume.  This possibility makes it an exceptional material to achieve a natural, elegant, warm and sustainable place.


Versatility


Another of the strengths of the solid bamboo flooring is its versatility. The high quality of the product, gets a warm and pleasant feeling when you move around the house. In addition, the touch of its sheets, is of extreme softness and will allow you to enjoy the touch of the wood directly on your feet. All this, coupled with its hardness and resistance, make its sustainability not only when it comes to producing it, but also, at the time of maintenance and changing it, taking much longer than you must use to replace another type of solid wood flooring.


The large number of finishes, from natural vertical to softer shades in horizontal orientation, achieve an avant-garde effect on the decoration of spaces. On many occasions, your guests will not be able to distinguish whether it is solid bamboo flooring or a type of mahogany or brown oak. Thanks to their development, customers find everything from narrower and more traditional pallets, to wider pallets, which try to achieve a more current effect with the appearance of the fewest joints on the pavement.


The last of the characteristics that make it an indispensable floor in a current house, is its ability to dilate and contract, much less than in other types of wood, with which, the wood will be more stable and durable and will offer fewer problems in meetings with the skirting or doors of the house, being able to have larger floor cloths.


How to make a difference?


For those who are looking to save some money without giving up the warmth, hardness and naturalness of bamboo, Bamboo Industrial models have a wide range of finishes that will undoubtedly adapt to your furniture or the rest of the decoration of your house. Its economical price also makes it the first choice for those who are thinking of decorating their premises or office with a more sustainable material and thus complying with the relevant environmental quality seals.


If what you are looking for is a leap of quality with lighter colours and shades and a look very similar to the pine or spruce wood platform, the Pure Bamboo flooring range will delight your guests. Its normal or toasted format offers clients the possibility to choose between two totally different styles to decorate their space.


What are the differences between bamboo and wood floors?


Wood has always been one of the traditional materials used when looking to bring a special warmth to the pavement of a house. However, progress has made it possible to achieve the same effect today with other soils that are more environmentally friendly and priced lower. While bamboo regenerates in a short time, trees that are cut down to obtain solid wood take years to grow back.


In addition, although a priori may seem like a hoax, bamboo flooring is much stronger than wood, which results in remaining intact for much longer despite the humidity conditions or daily use of any family. Finally, it cannot be forgotten that wood has a much higher cost than any other material, not only because of its production process, but also because of the difficulty involved in assembly.

item.title: What to Know Before Buying Outdoor Bamboo Flooring?
item.source: What to Know Before Buying Outdoor Bamboo Flooring?
item.description:
When installing an outdoor pavement, one has several options on the market. One of the most beautiful and elegant materials is undoubtedly tropical wood. However, wood has certain drawbacks, such as its high price and the propensity to deform or crack over time, not to mention the impact that its use has on the environment.


Bamboo Decking, The Ecological and Sustainable Alternative to Tropical Wood


Therefore, bamboo is increasingly used as a substitute for tropical wood. Bamboo is a herb, not a tree, of similar characteristics to wood but because of its great growth capacity it is an ecological, natural and sustainable alternative, since its use does not involve deforestation.


Thanks to its rapid growth and its hardness, stability and durability, bamboo has become the best alternative for wooden floors both indoors and outdoors. To enhance its natural conditions during its manufacture the bamboo platform undergoes a process of thermo-tretreation that eliminates the natural sugars it contains and extends its life.


Bamboo is a fast-growing natural material, so the pavements manufactured of this material sustainable and have a low environmental impact. Some brands even guarantee a life cycle with CO2 neutral in some products.


Bamboo flooring is very resistant and durable, with technical properties equal to wood and even better. This makes them ideal for high-traffic areas such as public spaces or commercial premises.


Stability is another interesting property of this material. The low expansion of bamboo pavements makes them perfect for use on outdoor area. They are a healthy choice, as their anti-static and anti-allergic properties are joined by low emissions of volatile organic compounds.


The possibilities of use are very wide, not only are they suitable for interiors but can be used as interior or facade coatings and as exterior floors. The exterior bamboo pallets have a longer durability than tropical woods.


In addition to flooring, bamboo can also be used in other outdoor spaces, such as beams for garden benches, parks or terraces. These beams have unique stability and hardness for spaces. Therefore, bamboo becomes the ideal choice for all kinds of outdoor urban furniture. Meets the highest requirements according to EU standards that determine resistance against inclement weather.


Continuing with the exteriors, Bamboo is also ideal for the cladding of facades, where it can be installed in trapezoidal or machined style and is even fire resistant. The material will give your spaces both vertical and horizontal a warm and natural inspired touch to enjoy the summer away from home, but always in a cosy way.


The Features of the Bamboo Flooring Heated with Garden Airs


The high-density pressed, thermo-treated bamboo flooring in Garden areas is best suited for outdoor floors as it is made of bamboo cane woven fibre that, once selected, is cut, bleached, charred and dried to preserve its durability. 


At the time of pressing it is mixed with natural tails, so the result is an ecological platform, strong, durable and waterproof, ideal for bathrooms, swimming pools and outdoor flooring.


If you are going to buy bamboo platform to install in your garden, bathroom or pool make sure that it has been made with a careful and quality process, since in the market are low cost bamboo pallets that have not undergone these treatments. Ungrateful bamboo tends to disintegrate so its duration will be much shorter.


Finally, the main characteristics of the bamboo flooring:


  • Bamboo is eco-friendly, versatile and provides environmental benefits
  • It is a sustainable tropical species with rapid growth
  • Its density is higher than that of tropical woods
  • It has a very low dilation rate
  • Its maintenance is very simple and comes down as time goes on
  • Its hardness makes it very resistant to wear
  • It‘s the best alternative to tropical wooden pallets
  • Thermo-treated bamboo floors are the ones that deliver the best results


In addition, bamboo deckings have great possibilities at the decorative level. Its characteristics veins make each of the slats made with this material different, which allows to achieve varied surfaces, surprising and above all of great beauty. In short, a natural, sustainable and 100% aesthetic option, which allows the user to introduce nature into any space whether indoors or outdoors.

item.title: What to Consider While Buying Bamboo Flooring for House?
item.source: What to Consider While Buying Bamboo Flooring for House?
item.description:
If you are considering to install bamboo flooring in your space then here are some of the essential things to consider before taking a step forward. Read carefully. 


1. What kind of space is the bamboo flooring going into? 


Bamboo flooring is one the most durable and versatile material which is why its deal for houses and apartments becoming very popular among people. They use bamboo flooring for bedrooms, living rooms and even for hallways. There are two types of good quality of bamboo flooring available one is engineered bamboo flooring and another one is solid bamboo flooring. They both are dimensionally stable so can be used in home space where the temperature and humidity fluctuate, for example, space with log burners, conservatories, utility rooms and kitchens etc. This is good for such spaces because the floor will contract and expand to permit for the climate changes. 


The only space where experts ask not to install bamboo flooring in the bathroom as it may not be good water-resistant. 


2. What are the advantages of bamboo flooring? 


There are countless advantages of bamboo flooring but here are some considerate ones. 


1. Great and hygienic for people who suffer from certain allergies. 
2. Easy to maintain and make clean anytime. 
3. Compatible and best with underfloor heating. 
4. Easy and swift to connect over almost any subfloor. 
5. You can install it any room in your house. 
6. Durable and harder than any hardwood flooring. 
7. Best and cheaper substitute to hardwood flooring with the same ordinary appeal.
8. Sustainable and eco-friendly flooring material. 

9. Bamboo flooring is available in a broad variety of finishes, colours and styles. 


3. If there are any floor matching accessories available in the market? 


If you are obsessed with matching flooring accessories and doubting whether you could get anything that compliments to bamboo flooring then the answer is yes. In the market, there are plenty of bamboo flooring accessories are available to complement the design of the floor. Accessories like thresholds, stair nosing, flush reducers, pipe covers, beading and skirting etc. 


4. Whether the bamboo flooring is eco-friendly or not? 


Bamboo flooring is one of the best materials for your house that comes under budget and is eco-friendly. This product is a totally sustainable substitute for hardwood flooring. Bamboo is not a wood but a type of grass. This indicates that it can grow much faster and develops into a proper tree in maximum five years rather than trees that take more than twenty years to grow and develop into an adult. 


In order to check the eco-friendliness, you should have to check the company which is selling bamboo flooring have FSC certification (Forest Stewardship Council). This indicates that every firm involves in the procedure of manufacture and production of the bamboo flooring have also been given the certification of FSC. While buying bamboo flooring, do not forget to check the company’s FSC certification to check whether you are dealing with an authentic and trustworthy company or not. 


5. What sort of finish in flooring you should have to achieve? 


Bamboo flooring comes into two main authentic finishes: 


1. Anti-slip lacquers 

2. Satin-matt lacquers 


6. What colour and style of bamboo flooring are you desiring to have? 


Bamboo flooring is accessible in three main styles: Strand woven, Vertical and horizontal bamboo. 


Horizontal Bamboo: The layers of bamboo are wedged horizontally to make the board of flooring.


Strand Woven Bamboo: Strands of bamboo are manufactured through intense heat, pressure and weight to make the board of flooring. 


Vertical Bamboo: The layers of bamboo are wedged together plumb to make the board of flooring. 


In addition to these three variant types of structure, bamboo flooring is accessible in either a rustic effect (traditional look), a carbonised effect (dark brown tone), or a natural colour (golden, pale tones). Bamboo is a natural product, grain patterns and shades vary as per the quality and type of bamboo you are buying. If you want to add something unique and different, then adding variant colour stains to the bamboo that includes black, chocolate brown and white can help you at its best.

item.title: Your Ultimate Guide to Understand Bamboo Flooring
item.source: Your Ultimate Guide to Understand Bamboo Flooring
item.description:
Some people believe in upgrading their house every year and some occasionally. Whether you are from the first category or the second one, bamboo flooring can surely be your first choice after you understand it well. Durability, good appearance, low-cost price and eco-friendliness are some of the factors that make it first in the list of hardwoods. Bamboo flooring syndicate the pliability of hardwood flooring with the easy upkeep of laminate.


Like other sorts of flooring available in the market, bamboo flooring has a countless range of benefits. If you are thinking that it would be hard for you to keep the floor clean then do not worry. Bamboo flooring is easy to restore and maintain. In the available options of bamboo wood, you can easily find chemical-free products that help you to maintain the air clean and easy to breathe. In this guide, we will tell some of the benefits of having bamboo flooring in your house. Keep reading to discover some of the advantages of bamboo flooring currently available in the market. This guide will also help you to understand how bamboo floors help you to enhance the value of your house. 


The guide to understanding the bamboo flooring 


Bamboo is not a wood but a type of grass, the stalks and shoots of which are processed to create a floor. It takes only five years to regrow a bamboo whereas trees take more than 50 years to grow into an adult. These grasses can easily grow with any requirement of extra take care. In fact, the procedure of making bamboo flooring from bamboo takes place without terminating the plant itself. After undergoing a certain procedure that includes pressurizing, fusing and boiling bamboo material are formed into planks that look like wood.


An overview of bamboo flooring


If we are talking about imperviousness of Bamboo flooring than it is more water-resistant as compare to the other types of hardwood flooring that makes it an affordable and good option for areas in the home that may suffer through the moisture of light. This is more applicable in the case where the bamboo floor is covered over proper underlayment or sub-flooring. 


There are basically three types of bamboo flooring i.e., Strand woven, horizontal and vertical 


1. Strand woven bamboo flooring 


This type of bamboo flooring is created from the fibres of shredded bamboo that are bonded under penetrating pressure and heat to offer the sturdiest sort of bamboo floor available in the market. 


2. Horizontal bamboo flooring 


This type of floors exploits substitutive layers of the plant to highpoint the growth joints of the bamboo. This sort of procedure dispensation for a more organic impression. 


3. Vertical bamboo flooring 


This type of floors is manufactured by the fusion of stubbles in a vertical style that produces consistent, perpendicular lines that harvest a contemporary feel and look. 


All of these types of bamboo flooring varieties available in the market can be manufactured to resemble numerous sorts of hardwood flooring to fit the appealing you have in mind for the space of your house. 


Pros of using Bamboo flooring 


1. It is Eco-friendly 


This sort of flooring is made from the natural vegetation which is known as “Bamboo Plant”. This is a renewable resource that has growth factor quicker than other types of trees used in manufacturing for hardwood flooring. The bamboo plant attains its maturity in just five years whereas another type of trees takes more than 50 years to grow as an adult. Some other type of trees like oak and maple might take ten to twenty years to grow fully-still more than the bamboo plant. 


2. It is easy to maintain 


Bamboo flooring is easy to clean, maintain and restore-if you are buying a quality one. You can clean them with regular vacuuming and sweeping and intermittent damp swabbing. One of the best qualities of bamboo flooring is that it collects no dust particle just like usual floors do. 


3. Durable

Types of profiles in Bamboo Flooring

item.title: Is Bamboo Flooring Really Green?
item.source: Is Bamboo Flooring Really Green?
item.description:
What could be more "green" than bamboo? Used in the most varied sectors, from clothing to bamboo flooring, this robust but at the same time flexible plant is characterized by its rapid growth and its robustness which allows it to do without pesticides or chemical fertilizers, in addition to making it so happy the big pandas.


Over the last ten years, there has been a real explosion of products in the field of hardwood floors. With the arrival of products from China, Europe, Scandinavia, South America and Africa, new products come out almost every month and as many disappear from the market. This situation becomes complex for both merchants and consumers.


Some time ago we talked about bamboo parquet, a valid alternative to the traditional wooden one, thanks to its particular characteristics of resistance and hardness, but above all of the renewability of the raw material. Where an oak takes about 120 years to reach maturity, bamboo usually uses 3. The ecological criteria for the use of wood are related to the entire life of the tree and the building constructed: growth, exploitation of the forest, processing of the product, its transport, its use and disposal.


Moreover, from the social point of view, bamboo is a very large source of income in China, where as many as 6 million people are employed in the production and processing of this plant, and one of the myths to dispel is the one according to which, the harvest of the bamboo used for the parquet would eat the giant pandas, already endangered. In reality these wonderful creatures, they feed almost exclusively on the shoots and leaves of only some species, which are found at high altitude and not in the plains where bamboo is collected for industrial processing.


Despite everything, recent studies published by the Environmental Building News, highlighted very worrying problems related to the unsustainable management of the bamboo plant, concerning, in particular, the replacement of virgin forests in China, and in general in Asia, with huge plantations of bamboo so as to become its exclusive monoculture. But not only that, other concerns concerned the use of chemical fertilizers and pesticides to increase their performance, with consequent strong negative impacts on local biodiversity and the soil, dangerously damaged and eroded especially in the steeply sloping air.


However, the good news is that in reality, these practices do not seem to be so widespread after all, as they initially appeared.


In fact, bamboo is not a solid material that is cut into planks like traditional wood, but, especially parquet, it is formed by thin strips that are compressed together with glue, which depending on the supplier, can be free of formaldehyde or less. And the product obtained varies depending on the hardness (which in turn depends on the maturity of the plant), on the quality, on the color (light or carbonized), on the orientation of the filaments or strips (horizontal or vertical) or the manufacturing process (laminated or pressed).


And related to the issue of certification, to affirm the actual sustainability of this plant, it is the discourse related to the management of the chemicals that are used by the suppliers for the processing, in particular, the quality of the glues, resins, binders and the quantity of formaldehyde contained in them. It is, therefore, the choice of the supplier, which has reached this point, which makes the difference between a truly green product and one that is only half-finished. But since no third party certifies this product, how can the veracity of what the suppliers claim to be verified?


An appropriate certification, not only in the final part of processing but also in the initial part of cultivation, is, therefore, the only way to demonstrate the real environmental advantages of this prodigious plant with multiple uses.


Bamboo flooring manufacturers sell it as a cost-effective, environmentally friendly choice. Often, people have small budgets to make their floors, and we would love to get something relatively cheap and sustainable. The call that many consumers have bamboo floors is quite obvious. The manufacturers have done an incredibly good job convincing the public that if you buy bamboo flooring, you make an environmentally responsible choice. It has been abandoning our reliance on hardwoods.

item.title: Benefits of Bamboo Flooring: Green, Premium Quality, Sustainable Material
item.source: Benefits of Bamboo Flooring: Green, Premium Quality, Sustainable Material
item.description:
Bamboo is a natural surface that covers the material that has many of the properties of hardwood flooring, although it is made from a form of bamboo. It incorporates many of a hardwood floor positive benefits, as well as the weaknesses and drawbacks. The more you appreciate this materials features, the more you will be aware of whether to decide to buy or preserve it.


Environmentally friendly: Bamboo is made of natural plants. The bamboo plant is a highly renewable resource which, in as little as three to five years, will grow to maturity. It is much faster than hardwood trees, which can take more than 20 years to mature.


Easy maintenance: Bamboo can be maintained relatively easily. To remove small particle debris, you just need to sweep or vacuum it regularly. You can also use a non-wax, non-alkaline, hardwood or bamboo flooring cleaner to damp it periodically or scrub it.


Water-resistant: This material, although still a problem, is somewhat more proof of water damage, stains, and warping than hardwood fabrics.


Price: The price of this item is about the same as most hardwood floors. Often you will see bamboo from about $2 to $8 per square foot. Basement products should be discouraged as they are often castoffs of lower quality.


Durability: Many varieties of bamboo can be extremely strong, durable, and long-lasting. Natural, uncarbonized bamboo that has been harvested and produced properly can be as durable as red oak. It is even harder to make beach woven bamboo than that.


Style: Bamboo is a fashionable floor material that can almost immediately enhance the beauty of a room. It has a look and feel identical to hardwood and yet is distinct and different.


Refinishing: Bamboo floors can become discolored, scratched, or weakened over time. Luckily, this materials coating can be polished, sanded down, and then re-applied to offer it a fresh new look. The quantity of sanding that may be performed relies on the thickness of the planks used.


DRAWBACKS OF BAMBOO FLOORING


VOC emission: Bamboo floor planks are processed by chopping or shredding the stalk of the bamboo grass plant and then re-sticking the parts with oil, friction, and resin-based adhesive. This adhesive may, over time, release volatile organic chemicals (VOCs) into the air in an interior space. Many bamboo floors use this adhesive, although the adhesive standard used, and the number of VOCs released can vary depending on the manufacture of the planks.


Scratches: Although a bamboo floor is fairly easy to maintain, if it is used daily, it is almost impossible to keep it flawless. There is a broad range of things on the floor that can inflict bad scratches.


Water damage: Bamboo is more resistant to water damage than the average hardwood, as mentioned earlier. It is still a natural material made of organic elements, however, and as such excessive moisture will cause it to change or allow mold to grow. A flood will severely damage the construction of a bamboo floor.


Humidity: If the floor is placed in a very humid environment, the humidity in the air can cause the floor planks to plump. The planks can shrink in a dry environment. The result will be cracks in the bamboo in both cases.


Deficiency of a grading system: There is no independent system used to assess bamboo product output. Often retailers sort lots into grades A and B. Retailers also group lots into products of grade A and grade B, but this is an arbitrary scheme and does not represent any objective indicator of the consistency of the planks you purchase. It makes it important to locate a reliable premium flooring retailer and make sure you get the products of the highest quality.

item.title: 5 Solid Reasons Why You Should Opt for Bamboo Flooring in Future
item.source: 5 Solid Reasons Why You Should Opt for Bamboo Flooring in Future
item.description:
The floor is one of the many parts of the house we are in contact with every day: every time we choose how to make the floor of the house we expect to select something that is not only beautiful to look at but also pleasant to the touch. Bamboo flooring is not only a pleasant design floor, but it also has a natural luster superior to the classic wooden parquet. This is just one of the points in favor of this material: to find out more, keep reading this article.


Below we will talk about the main characteristics of bamboo flooring, and we will see what the main types compared are.

Bamboo parquet: characteristic features.


Before going into the different types of bamboo flooring offered by the market, let us see together what are the characteristics that have made this material so popular! First of all, you have to know that bamboo is an eco-sustainable material: the bamboo plant, in fact, has much faster growth and maturation time than the traditional wood used for parquet.


To be exact, it can be used already after 3 or 5 years, against the 20 needed for a normal tree to reach maturity. This, therefore, makes it possible to help the planet maintain healthy forests: clearly, this also depends on the behavior of the producing companies and unfortunately not all behave responsibly.


For this reason, we advise you always to contact only companies with certified products and materials. 


Another point in favor of bamboo flooring is its hardness and strength: compared to oak wood it is 30% harder.


Bamboo is also ideal for renovations since it is distributed already painted and ready for installation: in this way, you will avoid running risks associated with the evaporation of sanding and painting which instead still remain valid for classic parquet.


With all the flooring options available to us today, finding the right floor for you can be a challenge, so much so that it is easy to overlook options that would be perfect for us, such as bamboo floorings. If you‘ve ever wondered why you should also consider bamboo flooring for your home, here is a list of 5 good reasons. We hope they can convince you to choose bamboo!


1. Durability


You probably would never think of it, but bamboo is one of the most durable floorings and furniture options. It lasts as long as many types of parquet, sometimes even more. This depends on the quality of the bamboo used; the low-quality one will not last as long as the high-quality one. Therefore make sure that the bamboo used is of the best quality available.


2. Maintenance


A bamboo flooring is exceptionally easy to maintain. Daily cleaning will only require a simple rag without the need for special treatments, which is perfectly suited to busy people. Over time, if the floor shows scratches, nicks or bleaching, you can feel comfortable because the bamboo floor can be easily finished. Simply smooth the floor and reapply a top coat and voila! Like New!


The benefit of bamboo is that it is much more resistant to water damage, stains, and deformations than any other parquet.


3. Cost


Bamboo flooring is not as expensive as many might think. Since bamboo is delivered pre-finished and possibly pre-colored, you will not have to pay for sanding and polishing after the floor has been installed. This makes the bamboo a bit cheaper than other hardwood floors.


4. Visual impact


The essential thing to be considered while choosing a floor is undeniably the "how it will look". A bamboo floor is beautiful and elegant and is appreciated by many people, especially fans of a modern and clean aesthetic. It is very similar to a traditional parquet, but if you look closely, you will notice irrefutable differences.


5. Environmental impact


In today global environmentally conscious context, one of the things that often comes to mind when it comes to renovating a building or home is "how can we make our living space more eco-friendly?" If you are among these people, bamboo flooring is a solid option. While for normal hardwoods a minimum of 10 years is required to reach maturity, bamboo takes much less time, between 4 and 7 years, making it a sustainable choice for those who, like you, want to use natural material for their floor.


So the next time you or someone you know is thinking about buying a floor, we hope bamboo is the first thing that comes to mind. You will not regret it.
