There is also a considerable variety in terms of colors and finishes that allow the owner to adapt his purchase to his style.


The different types of bamboo flooring


Each version of bamboo has a different level of sustainability but also a look that is unique to it. Of the three types, the densified parquet (strand woven) is the most durable it is also the one that looks the least like traditional bamboo. Bamboo is defibrated and compressed at high temperatures, which gives it a very important density, which is very appreciated for places with a strong passage.


As for the industrial bamboo, it is cut horizontally which gives it an appearance quite different from the one we are used to seeing since the stems have been flattened. It should be noted however that this option is the least sustainable in the long term.


Finally, solid bamboo flooring consists of solid bamboo pieces that have been glued together and are generally stronger than those made with a thin stripe.


Tinted decor for your kitchen


Bamboo can be found in a finite, infinite or tinted form. Yes, it is possible to have bamboo in your favorite shade! Because many people are looking for elegant and eco-friendly flooring, manufacturers pay close attention to toxic hazards such as gas, for example. This means that more and more bamboo coatings are made from low-emitting materials making them a perfect choice for family homes.


Some recommendations on the use of bamboo floors.


Depending on the design of the board, bamboo floors can be longitudinal (with the longitudinal direction of the fibers) and transverse. The floors of the longitudinal bamboo always look more elegant. Bamboo fibers on this floor are less noticeable. At the same time, the use of transverse bamboo will give your floors a characteristic rough-contrast, surface structure saturated with fine texture details. This type of bamboo floor is more suitable for smaller rooms.


If you want to give your room elegance, it is recommended to use carbonized longitudinal coffee bamboo with a hint of cherry or walnut.


If you prefer the natural look of the floor, you can use bare bamboo flooring, which, as a rule, has a light color and will look great in a low-lit or small room, creating the effect of lightness, space and increasing the width of the room.


When laying a bamboo floor keep in mind that the direction of the fibers in the bamboo plank is important. Make sure that for laying the floor in the room you have prepared in the required number of strips of the same type, either transverse or longitudinal. Combining cross and longitudinal bamboo slats is highly discouraged.

item.title: All About Bamboo Flooring: Features, Formats, Installation, Finishes, Maintenance and Costs
item.source: All About Bamboo Flooring: Features, Formats, Installation, Finishes, Maintenance and Costs
item.description:
Choosing a bamboo parquet means contributing both to the protection of the environment and opting for flooring with excellent performance, which has nothing to envy from the classic forest wood parquet flooring. Let‘s find out the features and the positive aspects.


Finishes


To enhance the characteristics of the bamboo flooring, various finishes can be applied, such as painting, with the application of a minimum of 5 to a maximum of 7 layers of varnish, oiling to make it even more polished, smoothing, to make so that the surface is completely smooth and uniform, brushing, to make the flooring rough to the touch and with a particularly rustic appearance or hand planing to obtain an antique effect. Based on how the various finishing processes are carried out, three types of parquet are distinguished:


Pre-sanded: before being set up, it was only sanded, all other treatments including waterproofing and painting with polyurethane varnish, water-based, oil-based varnish or oils of various colors, are performed after installation, with a large possibility of customization; 


Pre-finished: ready to be laid as it has received all the finishes, unlike the pre-sanded one it is immediately walkable, has a slightly higher price, but on the other hand you save on labor costs for the treatments. One point against it is that it is not customizable;


Pre-oiled: it receives an oil pre-treatment during production, and the finishing is completed after installation; it needs periodic and constant maintenance to keep the oiled effect alive.


The natural color of bamboo is very clear, on the honey shade, but can be darkened with exposure to steam jets, without using dyes; thanks to this technique, called carbonization or evaporation, it is possible to give the parquet a uniform color throughout the thickness and not only on the surface, as happens in the case of painting, so if you perform subsequent sanding there is no risk that the coloring is removed.

Maintenance and costs


The durability and beauty of the bamboo flooring depend largely on good maintenance and cleaning carried out regularly and correctly. Just follow nine simple rules to take care of your parquet in the best way; let us see what they are:


To remove dust and dirt use a common broom or vacuum cleaner;


For washing, you can use a cloth dampened only with water and well wring out, and for even deeper cleaning you can apply detergents for parquet, to be passed with a soft microfiber cloth, so as not to scratch the surface. Avoid generic floor cleaners and choose only those specific to parquet;


Although bamboo is resistant to moisture and is less prone to cracking and swelling than wood, it is still important to maintain the right level of humidity in the environment, which must be between 35% and 60% throughout the time of year, with the aid of dehumidifiers;


Bamboo needs to breathe, so it is good to ventilate the rooms from time to time, leaving the windows open;


In the event of liquids falling on the parquet it is good practice to remove them immediately and not leave them on the floor for a long time, to prevent the bamboo absorbing them and damaging them;


In order not to scratch the floor you can place a mat outside the front door where you can clean the shoes, so as not to carry pebbles on the floor from the outside; it is also advisable to place felt pads underneath the chairs, tables, and furniture, so that no scratches are created when they are moved;


Oil, ink, lipstick or paint stains can be removed by wiping with a cloth soaked in alcohol and then a soft cloth lightly dampened with water;


Never perform steam cleaning;


Never pass the floor wax on the bamboo parquet.


As far as the market value of bamboo flooring is concerned, they are certainly cheaper than many fine wood parquet floors and the price varies depending on the finishes used to treat the floor.

item.title: Eco Green Bamboo Flooring: No. 1 Choice for Households
item.source: Eco Green Bamboo Flooring: No. 1 Choice for Households
item.description:
Bamboo flooring has become popular with each passing day, as it is very much similar to classic wood flooring. Bamboo flooring looks exotic and has an inexpensive appearance which makes it one of the most attractive floorings for many people.


Knowing about the benefits and limitations of Bamboo Flooring before installation is important to make sure that your floor is perfectly matching with your lifestyle.

Why you should choose bamboo flooring? 


In short, bamboo flooring is a natural surface coating material which is produced from Bamboo. It is a great option among other traditional wood floors. Let us understand the advantages and disadvantages of this type of flooring, with the hope that you will find this information useful.


Bamboo is a durable product: 


High-quality bamboo flooring will last as long as traditional wood flooring. This situation is present in several sectors where quality is a key feature. Non-carbonized bamboo is considered to be harder and more durable as compared to red oak.

For those who are attracted by a clean and modern aesthetic, bamboo flooring lends itself perfectly to this style. Although similar to wood, the differences can be subtle.


- Colors and many styles:


One of the advantages of bamboo flooring is that it is available in a variety of styles and colors. Note: It is important to know what the different colors represent because the dark colors usually result from a heat treatment that has softened the bamboo.


- Bamboo is good for the environment:


As bamboo is a fast-growing grass; it reaches full maturity in five to seven years; bamboo is considered by many to be much more durable than traditional wood. Because the use of natural materials is currently at the heart of many people‘s concerns in building a house, bamboo flooring is an ideal choice for many eco-friendly people.


- Bamboo is easy to maintain:


Bamboo flooring requires little maintenance because it can be easily cleaned with mild soap; no special treatment is needed.


- Repairing of Bamboo floor is possible:


As bamboo flooring can dent, scratch or fade over time, it is good to know that they can be repaired if needed. Generally, the installation of bamboo flooring involves many topcoats so that bamboo can protect itself. If necessary, simply sand the surface and then reapply a top coat to give a boost to your floor.


- A bamboo parquet resists water:


In comparison with traditional wood flooring, bamboo comes out early as being more resistant to water damage and stains.


-  Bamboo flooring is not expensive:


Although bamboo is an exotic wood, it can be less expensive than a traditional wood floor.


- Bamboo flooring is subject to scratches:


A poor quality bamboo floor can get scratched easily, it is difficult or impossible to keep a completely smooth bamboo floor. Furniture, animals, and even heeled shoes can damage the surface of the floor over time, even the tiny particles present in everyday life.


- A bamboo floor gets moisture easily:


Relying on the size of your place, bamboo flooring may get worse in very humid or dry environments. For example, if the bamboo flooring is installed in a wet area, the chances are that it may get swell. On the other hand, in dry regions, bamboo flooring can have cracks.


- A bamboo floor can be toxic:


Some bamboo flooring from China may contain high levels of toxic chemicals, such as glues and formaldehyde-based finishes. Make sure the bamboo flooring you want to buy is certified and high quality based. Although bamboo is presented as a very environmentally friendly option, sometimes forest practices can be irresponsible and harmful to the environment.


Indoor and outdoor bamboo flooring: the differences


The natural characteristics of bamboo associated with processing and industrial finishes make it an ideal choice for both indoor and outdoor - outdoor environments. As regards the installation, for interiors, different solutions and installations are offered, as well as wooden parquet. Generally, the various pieces are fitted with a joint to facilitate a quick and easy installation. In addition to the color and type of installation, you can choose to use it too, in the event that your home has installed underfloor heating as it does not suffer any negative effects.


A quick overview of prices


The price of bamboo flooring is much cheaper than wood parquet, although the latter varies according to the types of wood chosen. However, it may vary depending on the company that sells it and based on the treatment and finish chosen. We advise against using it just naturally because it would risk being damaged more easily.

item.title: Difference between Wood, Laminate and Bamboo Flooring
item.source: Difference between Wood, Laminate and Bamboo Flooring
item.description:
Hardwood floors are a classic choice for the home, due to its attractive appearance, durability, and variety of grains and colors. Bamboo is another popular choice because it has a simple and elegant grain that complements modern furniture. The laminates offer great strength and cheaper prices. Buyers must take into account significant differences in the construction of these types of floors before buying.

When you are thinking about a floor remodeling project, and you desire to have a look of hardwood floor, you have the choice between real wood, laminate, and bamboo. Bamboo flooring offers a look similar to hardwood, but there are several differences between bamboo and hardwood that could influence your final purchase decision. Make a side by side comparison of bamboo and real wood to see which material would work best for your project.

Advantages of Wooden Floors

Hardwoods are available in many colors, from pale pine to dark ebony, in many different table widths and lengths and granulation styles that can provide interest and texture to the decor. Easy to maintain with simple sweeping and scrubbing site, they are more hypoallergenic than other types of floors. Wood floors can be varnished and repaired to look like new, adding value to your home in the long term. The wooden floors also provide good sound insulation.

Hardwood floors Disadvantages

Wood flooring can be detrimental to the environment not to be extracted from sustainable forests. Because gouges and scratches easily, the wooden floor may not be the best option where children play inside. Renewal of the periodic finish will be necessary, messy, long and expensive. Hardwood floors are also initially expensive and should be installed by an experienced contractor.

Advantages Laminated floor

Wood lamination is a process of creating a wood look with additional wear capabilities. The floor has a high fiber density center covered with a photographic design of high-resolution wood grain. At the top of these layers is a transparent layer, a resin that lasts for years. Laminate does not fade in sunlight just like normal wood. Its price is three to five times less than hardwood and can also be installed by doing things themselves easily and quickly.

Laminate floor Disadvantages

Wood floors increase the value of homes with a rich appearance, which stratified floors do not provide. Laminates cannot be recycled easily, which causes environmental concerns. Do not isolate sound, as well as hardwood. You cannot touch up laminate flooring to give it a fresh, new look, and excess water can damage it.

Advantages bamboo floor

The bamboo floor has a similar appearance to that of wooden planks and comes in light and dark tones. Installed with glue, nails or as a "floating" floor, which is said to be more difficult than hardwoods such as maple or oak. Bamboo grows back quickly, and it is a sustainable product.

Environment

Bamboo allows you to remodel your home by using an ecological soil material. Real wood is made by cutting down trees and modeling wood on floorboards. Bamboo is a grass and regrows much faster than hardwood trees. Growing bamboo for the soil material can help accelerate the growth of bamboo, such as ornaments of old bamboo grass to allow the new lawn to grow.

Hardness

Bamboo floors tend to be more difficult than most kinds of real wood floors. Bamboo flooring is made by bamboo grass-pressure treatment with adhesive. The advantage of bamboo is more than real wood is that it makes bamboo flooring more durable than real wood, which means that bamboo floors will last longer.

Color

Real wood comes in a variety of light and dark colors, with several shades in between. You can get real wood that has a red tinge to it or wood that has a greenish appearance. Bamboo comes in a light yellowish color or a dark brown color. Some engineering bamboo floors offer shades of color, but real bamboo only comes in two colors.

Bamboo floor Disadvantages

The processing and maturation of bamboo can affect its longevity and durability. The carbonization process that produces darker colors of bamboo can also make it less durable. Bamboo does not absorb sound, as does hardwood floors and costs around it.

item.title: All About Bamboo Flooring Manufactured from China Factory
item.source: All About Bamboo Flooring Manufactured from China Factory
item.description:
Bamboo is not wood, but a plant with hollow and knotty stems of infrequent flowering, which adapts well to the extreme conditions of the tropical climate; as well as constant temperature changes and high humidity.


Bamboo floors are as durable and resistant as those made of wood. Bamboo is considered the ecological future; since it contributes directly to preserve our forests and the indiscriminate deforestation.


This grass stands out for being the plant that records the fastest growth rate. Bamboo takes approximately seven years to achieve maturity and growth, unlike hardwood that takes 15 to 20 years or more.


Once cut, the bamboo grows and grows again until reaching a maximum height of 30 meters in just six months. 


Bamboo is a renewable and sustainable product that can be processed in 1 week after being cut. It has very strong natural fibers that allow the development of industrialized products such as the floor. It also highlights its resistance property and its ability to absorb energy and admit more flex. Bamboo contains neither resins nor tannic acids. The cut trunk is smoothed, heated and dried after separation. Below are some of the highlights of bamboo flooring:


Ecologically friendly: Bamboo is made of natural vegetation. It is highly renewable resource that can grow to maturity in only three or five years. 


Easy maintenance: Wooden flooring is relatively easy to maintain. Simply sweep or vacuum regularly to remove small particle debris. You can also mop wet occasionally or clean it with a floor cleaner made of wax, non-alkaline, hardwood or bamboo.


Price: This material has a price approximately the same level as most wooden floors. You will often find bamboo that ranges from $ 2 to $ 8 per square foot. You must avoid the basement materials of negotiation, as they are often of low quality.


Durability:  The unbonded natural bamboo that was harvested and manufactured correctly can be as durable as red oak. The woven bamboo thread can be made even harder than that.


Style: Bamboo is a fashionable floor material that can elevate the elegance of a space almost instantly. It has an appearance and a feeling that is similar to hardwood and yet remains distinct and different. This can add unspeakable quality to a room.


Refinishing: Over time, bamboo floors may lose color, become scratched or marred. Fortunately, the surface of this material can be touched up, sanded and reapplied the finish layers to give it a unique look.  


The way to locate the bamboo at the time of compacting will depend on its strength, so you can get floors of medium traffic and high traffic. The pieces have a pre-finished polyurethane; and on this, an acrylic layer with ultraviolet protection, which prolongs its duration.


According to how the rods are arranged, the following parquet structures will be obtained:


Wide or horizontal knot: the strips are arranged horizontally and glued together. In the horizontal knot bamboo floors, the characteristic knots of the plant will be very evident, and the parquet style will be broad and exotic lines.


A narrow or vertical knot: this structure makes the bamboo knot less visible, and the parquet style will be more modern and minimal, with fine lines. The strips are glued together but vertically.


Flexible: in the flexible version the strips are connected by means of a latex or fabric support. In this case, the bamboo is arranged in a kind of small piece with a thickness of just 3mm. The result will be a parquet particularly comfortable to the walkway and with excellent sound absorption characteristics but less resistant than other structures.


Density or pressed: the parquet that is obtained through this process is the so-called strand woven, where the blades are broken and then compressed at high pressure. You will get a floor with very high strength and very similar to the classic wooden parquet, elegant appearance and with irregular veins.


Speaking of formats, however, generally can be divided into three different:


Solid wood: it is bamboo of first choice of thickness between 14 and 15 mm


Pre-finished or two-layer: the thickness is around 10mm and is the most suitable for those who want to lay it on a floor heating system. Usually, it consists of a top layer of fine bamboo and a lower layer of a different type of bamboo.


Multilayer: underneath the 4 mm thick quality bamboo layer, there is another support consisting of several layers of bamboo or wood that guarantees maximum strength.

item.title: Bamboo Floors – An Innovative Approach To Flooring
item.source: Bamboo Floors – An Innovative Approach To Flooring
item.description:
These days, people are being inclined to the growing popularity of bamboo floors installation. The idea works behind this innovation is its affordability, beauty and environment friendliness. A few research and reports says that it can hold a greater amount of carbon in comparison to other woods. In this way, it significantly contributes to the environment by reducing the level of greenhouse gases that cause the climatic change. Additionally, bamboo takes maximum 6 years to mature which is rather less than those which takes more than decades. 


Flooring industry is one of the most booming industry and bamboo floors come among its latest innovations that have achieved massive attention of its admirers. Besides being environmentally friendly, their aesthetic beauty looks soothing to the eyes. People can pick out from the huge array of natural colors of it. These natural shades resulted from the proper carbonization of bamboo. Among those natural colors light tan and honey brown are the most favored one.


Requires less maintenance


Because bamboo is such a tough and flexible flooring material, and does not scratch or wear easily as other hardwood flooring, there is rather less maintenance required. Environmentally conscious people will find that, the floor which requires lesser chemicals to clean it meaning that it is much more environment friendly.


Carbonization


Carbonized bamboo is generally softer than the natural bamboo. And the color of the carbonized bamboo is much darker. It is much more long-lasting and steady than the hardwood floors. Other reasons of its popularity are that these are stain resistant as well as moisture resistant.


The flooring industry is taking bamboo to the next level to suffice various flooring needs and achieve maximum customer satisfaction. These are kept in premium category because of being high in quality. 


Types of bamboo flooring


A successful flooring company always ensures that they give their customers variety of options to choose from. This array majorly includes two types of bamboo flooring – horizontal grain bamboo and vertical grain bamboo. But horizontal grain bamboo remains the most preferred choice. Aside from these options, there are few more options that include strand bamboo floor and engineered bamboo floor. These are considered as the innovative flooring milestones that contain stiff flooring material. The main constituent of engineered bamboo flooring is shredded bamboo fibers. However, it will have similar look and feel but would be rather less expensive than other solid wood flooring.


In comparison to the other types of bamboo flooring, woven bamboo flooring is rather unique in all respects. These are made of shredded bamboo fibers and then blend with resin prior being squeezed into hard blocks that are then granulated and placed on flooring surface; it is much harder than solid bamboo.


Cost factor


Cost is the most important factor that determines the choice of a person. But here you do not need to worry about cost as bamboo flooring is rather less expensive than the other types of wood flooring. There are some other factors too that can influence the cost moderately such as labor costs, geographical location, and the extent of area that needs to be covered with a specific flooring.


The application of a floating floor is another cost-effective option for people. When you plan for renovating the existing floor, it requires further labor and other additional charges. Such kind of flooring system is developed so that people can avoid the high labor costs of removing the existing floor. It is unconnected to the floor undersurface. It is also beneficial if the subfloor is not crooked.


Cleaning


After the installation of the floor it is necessary to think about the process of cleaning the bamboo flooring. It is good to know that it is rather easy to clean and maintain such kind of floors. Timely vacuuming can clean the floor. Now you know various facts about bamboo flooring.


There are a number of things about bamboo flooring that you would love such as aesthetic value, durability, and much easier to clean and maintain. It gives your home a unique elegance that is hard to find anywhere. The bottom line is, no matter what kind of bamboo flooring you choose, the environment will thank you.

item.title: Exotic Parquet Flooring Made of Bamboo
item.source: Exotic Parquet Flooring Made of Bamboo
item.description:
Choosing the right floor for your home includes accuracy and attention to all the details. By choosing an appropriate floor covering, your house will have an increased value, and the cover will add style and warmth. Hardwood wood for flooring is always the best choice for homeowners, since this type of wood has a long period of life, an apartment with such a floor covering can be sold a little more expensive and another floor made of wood brings the character of space. 


However, hardwood has some disadvantages, especially in parts, dents and scratches, and the wood itself is vulnerable to moisture. Some people are also concerned about the environment, and in particular the green forest.


If you are looking for a floor covering that brings splendor to your home, in this case consider the value of bamboo. Bamboo is not really a tree, it is grass. Stems of bamboo ripen much faster than trees. The grass has little impact on the environment, so do not worry about it. It is necessary to say, than bamboo has a greater maturity, the weaker it will serve as a cover. 


If the strength of the floor is the main factor, then talk with the manufacturer about the age of bamboo used in the parquet board and where it was brought from. Bamboo, usually originates from China, although there are quality stems that grow in the US and Europe.


Installation begins with acclimatization of parquet


Bamboo flooring is affordable in many colors and can be painted in a shade of your choice. Just remember that before installing the parquet floor of bamboo, the panels will need to be acclimatized to the room temperature in the same way as the hardwood flooring. After the parquet board from the bamboo is delivered to the house, do not forget to leave the boards in the room where they will be installed, for 3 days in boxes and unpacked. This will allow the parquet board to adjust to humidity and prevent deformation of the parquet floor after installation.


Other factors that can be attributed to saving are that bamboo flooring can be installed without professionals - with your own hands, and you will well save on the expensive services of firms installing the floors. Parquet panels are stacked using a sound and heat insulating substrate, and the panels are installed on the comb-groove lock system, which blocks everything as a mosaic. Spill glue or perform difficult work is not required. To care for these floors, you need to regularly vacuum the floor and this is enough, although the coating can be cleaned with special cleaners designed to care for bamboo parquet. To protect the floors and ensure their durability, lay a large carpet in a place with high traffic.


What are some of its notable features?


The basis of bamboo parquet is a substance created by compressing bamboo fibers into a specific shape, in subsequent stages this form receives a certain color and texture.


Parquet from Bamboo flooring is formed in such a way that it turns out very easy. This means that the installation of such a parquet in the house will be a fairly simple process. Because the bamboo fiber is compressed during production, the parquet is durable and flexible. This parquet is resistant to moisture and scratches.


Different colors and texture of bamboo flooring is achieved due to varying degrees of carbonation. Carbonized bamboo flooring, in fact, is subjected to heat treatment in order to darken its texture and give a certain strength. The longer it heats, the darker the color will turn out and the stronger it will be.


Since, in fact, bamboo is a grass, not a tree, then when choosing Bamboo flooring, it is important to pay attention to the quality and the manufacturer (you should know that all bamboo flooring is made only in China). The main advantage of bamboo flooring is that with its low price interiors with bamboo floors look rather rich and presentable.


Care of the parquet is very important, as well as for any floor of natural wood.

item.title: Benefits of using Bamboo flooring
item.source: Benefits of using Bamboo flooring
item.description:
Bamboo flooring is a natural surface which is made of bamboo material and it has many attractive properties of hardwood flooring, even though it is produced from a certain type of grass. It can provide many positive benefits for our life, which has the vulnerabilities and drawbacks. The more we understand the properties of bamboo materials, the better informed we will be when making a maintenance decision or purchasing.



Bamboo flooring has been used as an alternative to traditional flooring because of its physical similarities to real hardwoods. Most of the Bamboo floor sellers and manufacturers promote its durability, strength, its natural resistance and its eco-friendliness to moisture and insects. The hardness of an ordinary bamboo flooring starts from 1180 to 1380. On the other hand, we can use some manufacturing techniques to use strand woven bamboo flooring which starts from 3000 to 5000 by using the modern Janka hardness test.



The Benefits of the Bamboo Flooring


As we know that Bamboo is a plant. The materials of bamboo are environment-friendly. The bamboo plant is a renewable resource that gets maturity in three to five years. It is faster than other hardwood trees which can at least 20 years to reach its maturity. It has many benefits, these are:



Maintenance



Bamboo is easy to maintain. We have to vacuum or sweep it regularly to remove small debris. We can clean it with a non-alkaline, non-wax, hardwood or other bamboo floor cleanser. It is true that most of the artificial elements are not easy to maintenance, but bamboo made accessories are easy to clean or wash. We need to use fewer chemicals to maintain it properly. 

Water resistant

All other artificial items are not water resistant. However water is harmful to some items which are made of artificial fibers, but bamboo made materials have more resistant to water stains and damage. If it is a concern of water-resistant, then we shall have to use it for our regular use. 



Use as an environmentally friendly material



Nowadays most of the people are very conscious of using environmentally friendly materials. We can easily produce bamboo made materials. The use of these natural materials plays an important trend in the construction industry nowadays. People are expecting products that reflect their values. They are looking for materials and designs that can easily fulfill their basic requirements. Thus bamboo made materials are 100% environmentally friendly. 

Price of the product

Nowadays price is a great concern for most of the people. The price of the bamboo made materials are same as other hardwood floors. It focuses on our personality as well as natural evolution. We will often find bamboo ranging from $2-$8 for per square foot. We should avoid bargain floor materials when they are lower quality castoffs. Most of the people are looking for the natural fiber made floors which are economical. Bamboo made floors can easily fulfill their basic requirements. You can use it without any hesitation. 



Durability of the bamboo products



Many people have a great confusion of durability of the bamboo made materials. They are not sure about it. It is true that there are various types of bamboo that can be extremely hard, strong, and durable. We can use natural and un-carbonized bamboo which was manufactured and harvested as durable as red oak wood.  We can use some strand woven bamboo. It is used to make even harder than other materials.



Style of the materials



Bamboo flooring can make a trendy look that elevates the elegance of our space instantly. These materials have an appearance and similar to hardwood and it is different and distinct. It can add an ineffable quality to our living room. Our taste and choice have been changed rapidly. Only a bamboo made floor can easily be changed after few years. The price of the changing costs is economical compared with others.  



Refinishing of bamboo flooring



Over time bamboo made floors can be scratched, discolored, or marred. If the surface of the bamboo material can be refinished, then we need to sand it down and then apply the finishing coats to give it a great new look. The amount of the refinishing price can be determined by the thickness of the planks which we use. We can easily customize our bamboo flooring according to our requirements.

item.title: Bamboo Flooring: A Product of Excellence for Your Floor
item.source: Bamboo Flooring: A Product of Excellence for Your Floor
item.description:
In recent decades, bamboo has gained popularity among architects, designers, builders and property owners. Although bamboo is not, botanically and technically speaking, a wood but an herb, in recent years has become the substitute for traditional wooden parquet.


Bamboo is one of the materials used since ancient times by man to increase your comfort and well-being. In the world of plastic and steel today, bamboo continues to contribute its centenary contribution and is still growing in importance.


Why bamboo?


Bamboo is called "vegetable steel", and this nickname has been acquired thanks to its physical characteristics that distinguish it, such as strength and hardness. There are several kinds of bamboo and each one is used in the most diverse fields: from eating, to textiles, from the construction of weapons and fishing rods to the production of parquet. The one used for the production of parquet belongs to the species of Phyllostachys Pubescens. Compared to oak or other types of wood used in parquet production, the bamboo wood flooring is tougher and more stable.


Advantages


In addition to strength and toughness, bamboo has other mechanical properties that make it better than other types of wood: it is light, strong and dimensionally stable. With the right workmanship and thanks to these characteristics you are able to obtain a more durable and durable bamboo flooring than regular parquet floors.


The eco-sustainability factor


Bamboo belongs to the family of grasses. It is an evergreen and lush plant; can reach twenty meters in height and 18 inches in diameter. Choosing bamboo parquet is a choice that respects nature. The bamboo plant grows spontaneously and does not need to be replenished, thus avoiding further aggravating the problem of deforestation. The parquet bamboo is preferred over traditional wood parquet because it is natural and does not require the use of fertilizers and pesticides.


Processing


The production of bamboo flooring is carried out exclusively with Italian or German production machinery; this is because they are the only ones that ensure greater precision at all stages of production and guarantee complete lack of imperfections on the finished product. In the finishing process, which involves seven steps, non-harmful and ecological wood paints are used with very low formaldehyde values to ensure a natural and ecological finished product. Parquet can be already finished and is therefore called prefinished or pre-finished bamboo parquet, available in two structures and two different colors.


1. The natural units, rods or bamboo canes as they are called, are of measures and forms that make them manageable, storable and systematized, conveniently and economically.


2. The reeds have a characteristic physical structure that provides them with high resistance in relation to their weight. They are round or almost round in their cross section, usually hollow, and with rigid transverse partitions, strategically placed to avoid breaking when bending. 


Within the concentrates on the outer surface. In this position they can act more efficiently, providing mechanical strength and forming a firm and resistant shell. 


3. The substance and texture of the reeds makes it easy to divide them by hand into short pieces (sawing or cutting them), or into narrow strips (splitting them). No expensive machines are needed, just simple tools. 


4. The natural surface of many bamboos is clean, hard and smooth, with an attractive color, when the canes have been conveniently stored and matured. 


5. Bamboos have little waste and no bark to eliminate.


The use of bamboo as a flooring material, whether primary, secondary, or occasional is common in areas where adequate bamboo grows in sufficient quantity. The importance of bamboo in any given region is usually determined by the economic level of the common people for the position of other more durable materials. 


High strength (compared to the oak floor bamboo board is stronger by 50%).


1. Antistatic (this quality greatly facilitates cleaning).


2. Resistance to moisture (on the bamboo floor there are no stains and divorces).


3. Refractoriness (due to special bamboo processing technology).


4. Low cost (bamboo parquet is much cheaper than wood parquet).


5. Possibility of coloring in any color (besides natural shades, the bamboo floor can be steel, dark and tiger).


6. Excellent insulation (natural bamboo preserves comfortable temperature and microclimate of the room).


Bamboo flooring is chosen by connoisseurs of eco-friendly style in the interior. Meanwhile, bamboo can harmoniously fit into the classic modern interiors. By many factors, it is not inferior to the usual wooden floor and the popular parquet board.

item.title: Bamboo Parquet is A Good Alternative to Wood Flooring
item.source: Bamboo Parquet is A Good Alternative to Wood Flooring
item.description:
Bamboo parquet is a good alternative to wood flooring: it is robust, durable and can be combined with underfloor heating.

The wood, especially compared to concrete, if managed with the appropriate criteria and standards is a material very sustainable. It is also lightweight, flexible, easy to find, workable, with good structural behavior and an insulator that can guarantee the right temperature depending on the season. For these reasons, more and more people decide to adopt it for the floors of their homes. But are there more ecological alternatives to hardwood? To assess the sustainability of this type of flooring (but not only), one must take into account at least three factors: the raw material used, the production process and product life expectancy.


Bamboo flooring coverings have been used in countries where it has been growing since ancient times.

Modern floors made of bamboo are made in the form of a coating of massive boards and in the form of parquet. Floor skins produce skirting boards made of bamboo.

Both these types of flooring from bamboo are easy to install, have antistatic properties, are durable. They can be given different shades, so the buyer can choose according to their tastes. Bamboo floor can also be painted with paints, which are used for wooden floors.

The floor of bamboo is more durable than wood because of its high hardness and density (770 kg / m3). It does not dry up and does not swell. Slots between massive boards or planks of parquet do not appear. 

The disadvantage of bamboo floors is the difficulty of their bending due to the structure of the fibers.

The thermal conductivity of bamboo floors is slightly lower than that of wood. Walking on it and sitting on it will be more comfortable even in an uneventful period in the off-season.

Technologies

The two main types of bamboo floors, more precisely, coverings are horizontal (flat) and vertical. 

In the horizontal type in boards and planks, the thin stems of the bamboo stem are joined in a horizontal position by the method of machine pressing. If you look at such a coating from above, the pattern of the inter-knots of the plant is quite clearly visible. 

In the vertical type in boards and planks, the stems obtained from the stems are glued vertically. On them the drawing of knots is almost not visible. 

Consumers and producers of floor coverings made of bamboo began to give preference to the vertical type in the ligature with its greater resistance to mechanical influences.

The two main types of colors are natural and caramel. Natural color is similar to the color of maple wood, and caramel is like dark amber or wood of young teak. Caramel color is obtained not in the process of staining, but also at the stage of pressing the boards. Then the result of heating the sugary substances in the bamboo darken (caramel is also obtained from sugar by heating).

In some countries in the countries of growth of bamboo floors are made in the old fashion from narrow bamboo slats of different length. These strips are obtained by cutting thick trunks. Of the short strips, the parquet is laid in the same way as from wood parquet boards. Of the long bars do shields, which then put on a solid foundation. 

But making such floors is very laborious. It requires exact dimensions of the boards and a good fit when laying them. And to find long straight bars is even more difficult because for this, it is necessary to select straight trunks. 

Because of this, shields made of natural slats and boards are more often used for suspended ceilings.

Of bamboo racks, a floor covering is made, which is called a carpet, although it, unlike ordinary carpets, is semi-rigid. Reiki are mounted on a sturdy special fabric with an anti-slip bottom surface. 

The natural tone of these carpets is neutral, it is suitable for any interior. Such a carpet can be put on the floor, and you can decorate the walls as wallpaper.

Some technical specifications

The specific gravity of dry bamboo is 0.72 g/cc - approximately like that of oak. Abrasion resistance (ability to resist abrasion) is one of the highest among other materials for floors.

The coefficient of thermal expansion of bamboo is 50% less than that of red oak. Bamboo floorboards and parquet do not significantly change their size when changing the temperature in the apartment.

item.title: Floor design - Trends in the Design of Floor Coverings
item.source: Floor design - Trends in the Design of Floor Coverings
item.description:
In this article, we want to introduce you to the fashionable and up-to-date designs for flooring this year. The use of various materials of various colors enables customers to choose their unique design at an affordable price.  

Every year at specialized exhibitions, manufacturers’ present new collections of decors, and designers analyze and highlight the most relevant shades, patterns, styles, etc. Floor coverings are not exceptions! After all, sex is a very important part of interior design. From what you choose the floor, will depend on the comfort, the general appearance of the room, its visual size and much more.

Most laminate buyers, when choosing, pay attention only to the cost and basic characteristics. But to get aesthetic pleasure from buying and enjoying the result, we want to draw your attention to the current designs of laminate and other floor coverings.

1. New - a well-forgotten old

Wooden floor has always been, and more than one decade will be one of the most topical coatings. It was not able to supersede even new items, such as flootex and bamboo floor. However, preference is given to wide boards with a pronounced rough texture. Rustic, with its knots, tangential cut and wavy figure of the rings - is an ideal example of such a floor.

Here are such uneven, undulating boards with a pronounced texture today at the height of fashion. They will perfectly fit into a cozy home interior and meet the general trend of using natural materials

Rustic is one of the varieties of a wooden floor, differs by a rough texture and looks somewhat rustic

A vivid example of how aristocratic the wooden floor may look. Especially in combination with such laconic furniture and restrained, poorly painted interior

In this case, light wood was chosen for the floor, but the texture itself remained as brightly expressed

2. We paint the floor fashionably

Designers claim that despite the wide popularity of laminate and linoleum, the painted floor is gaining popularity again. Variants of patterns and shades are available in the market and it will not be difficult and costly to update the floor.

The main trends: vintage shabby, artificially aged floor, combination of colored bright floor with neutral walls, as well as Moroccan and Greek patterns that are ideal for ethnic interiors.

3. Inserts from glass blocks

In the past, you could only admire the transparent floor in the shopping center, and now you can order such coverage home. Inserts from glass blocks, often with patterns, are widely used in home interior. An excellent option, in order to highlight the zone in the room or simply emphasize and pay attention to the beauty of your sexes.

4. Actual tile

Vinyl tiles with a wide selection of shades and patterns give a unique opportunity for designers to experiment with interior design. The most popular are the tiles under the wooden, leather and stone floor. And also it is worth noting geometric large patterns of 2-3 colors, which can be found in catalogs or fantasy itself. 

5. Parquet - fashionable classics

Parquet is considered one of the most expensive varieties of coatings. It has several ways of laying. Basically it depends on the design idea. 

However, now the most popular way of laying-laying herringbone (an attempt to reproduce the palace interiors of Versailles and Trianon). Such a floor will look beautiful, rich and respectable. And those who are bored, or do not like the French fir-tree, can try asymmetrical parquet, an unusual and modern option.

6. Combination of materials

In multi-functional rooms using two different types of coatings is an excellent opportunity to identify individual zones. For example, a kitchen area to lay out with tiles, and a guest room - linoleum or laminate. However, with this laying, there may be slight difficulties, but experienced masters will always cope.

Main trends: a combination of natural stone and wood, ceramic tiles and parquet.

7. Digital printing on the floor

The actual way of decoration for today. It is applied to any coating and imitates any of your wishes. It is possible to successfully imitate wood, stone, tile and so on.

Thus, summing up, we can say, all the fashion is aimed at using environmental materials, original accents, and natural shades with particular details. We will always be happy to help you and decide on a fashionable design for your gender.

item.title: How to Maintain the Purity of Bamboo Floors?
item.source: How to Maintain the Purity of Bamboo Floors?
item.description:
The bamboo floor is very durable and taking care to protect it from potentially hazardous elements, you can be sure that it will look the best and will last a long time after its installation. 

Perhaps these tips will be useful to you, and will help to preserve the beauty and durability of the bamboo floor. The bamboo floor must be free from dust, dirt and sand. Even the smallest particles of dirt can lead to scratches on the surface.

Care for the bamboo flooring is similar to caring for wooden floors.

Like wood, bamboo is sensitive to moisture, so you should limit the excessive use of water when washing the floor. To care for the bamboo floor, it is better to use a dry cleaning with a flat mop of microfiber daily. Do not use acid or vinegar based cleaners, as this can damage the surface of the bamboo floor.

High heels can damage the bamboo floor, so it is not recommended to walk around in such shoes, since the pressure load on such a narrow contact point may leave dents on the floor.

When using a carpet on the bamboo flooring, make sure it is made of material that is suitable for use on wooden or bamboo floors, rubber mats should be avoided, as they can cause a discoloration of the floor, because the floor is unable to breathe through the rubber.

Protective pads should be placed under the legs of chairs, tables and cabinets, preferably from dense fabric. 

If there is furniture on the wheels, it is better to remove them.

Do not under any circumstance resist the temptation to drag any heavy pieces of furniture over the bamboo floor, as this can leave deep furrows and probably hopelessly damage the floor.

Direct sunlight can discolor some types of bamboo floor. 

This can happen if the floor is exposed to high concentrations of sunlight for a long time, it is necessary to protect the bamboo floor from sunlight, using screens, curtains or blinds.

If something is spilled onto the floor, then this should be immediately eliminated if the spilled liquid remains for a long time, then it can penetrate into the bamboo floor and cause deep stains that cannot be removed. After spending a little time on caring for the bamboo floor, you can rest assured that it still looks good and continues to please for many years.

All that is required to maintain bamboo floors in order is frequent sweeping and maintaining a minimum level of humidity. In general, the methods for cleaning bamboo flooring are almost the same as for other types of parquet. To clean the bamboo will require even fewer chemicals, which is an obvious plus for the health of consumers. 

Regular cleaning of bamboo floors, of course, contributes to their long life. Such floors can be washed from time to time with a slightly damp cloth or foam mop and regularly swept and/or vacuumed with a soft nozzle. So you clean your bamboo floor from everyday dust and dirt and protect it from scratches.

Another way to prevent abrasive particles from getting on the floor from shoes and paws of pets is to put the mat at the entrance. It will contain small stones, dirt, and moisture, grains of sand, glass fragments and fragments of various objects and prevent the appearance of unnecessary scratches on the floor of bamboo. Such mats should be regularly shaken out, and transitions in street shoes on the bamboo floor should be minimized. So dirt and sand will not be transferred from the rug to the parquet.

To clean the bamboo flooring you can use almost all the tools that are used to clean parquets. Here the only exception is wax, since it can affect the coating of such a floor. In any case, when buying bamboo parquet, and then cleaning products, it is necessary to consult with sellers about the possibility of using certain cleaning products. Sellers can help you choose the right options, but do not forget to read the labels carefully when buying any products and follow all instructions when using them.

item.title: The Eco chic and Happy living- Bamboo Flooring and Products
item.source: The Eco chic and Happy living- Bamboo Flooring and Products
item.description:
Fashionable and eco-friendly, bamboo is durable and looks more interesting than many other types of wood. A rich bamboo flooring adds style and elegance to the kitchen. Bamboo floor is a hot trend for modern kitchens, bamboo is a mixture of stylish flooring and durability. Although technically it is grass, bamboo is actually more difficult than many types of wood. Bamboo is supplied in plates or boards in various sizes, colors, patterns and textures. Bamboo parquet is a real Eco-chic surface, the floor on which is quite comfortable to stand. So you can feel comfortable in the kitchen.

What you need to know when choosing bamboo flooring, and what care for the bamboo floor is required? 

Bamboo floor is durable and durable, but it can be scratched and dents remain on it, which means that it is contraindicated to communicate with the claws of pets and dragging heavy objects. Therefore, high-quality polishing of parquet is a reliable alternative to expensive repairs, and the perfect kind of flooring in your home!

The substrate must be perfectly smooth, otherwise the bamboo will show all its shortcomings. Because bamboo is very susceptible to moisture, and a waterproof backing layer is vital if bamboo parquet is installed on a concrete slab. Bamboo is produced in many colors, but natural bamboo is light, and it is an excellent choice for those who prefer an eco-friendly style in their home. Bamboo floors contain an aqueous base, and do not contain solvents, which contributes to improving the quality of the air in the house.

Bamboo is made from renewable resources, unlike wood, bamboo quickly ripens in about six years (and not 60 as trees). Collecting bamboo does not kill plants, when the shoots are cut off, the roots remain intact and young shoots can grow freely.

Bamboo flooring brings happiness

Unlike previous eras today, decorating the interior of your house, more and more often the focus is not sophistication and luxury, but environmental friendliness and functionality, simplicity and airiness. That is why many choose bamboo floors in the interior, natural or oriental ethnic styles. For these styles, the most common use of natural materials, which includes bamboo.

According to today‘s trendy ecological trends, and the recommendations of Feng Shui, bamboo products bring happiness to the apartment. The bamboo interior of the room can be very different, and bamboo can be used in many ways:

Bamboo, as a finishing material.

The wallpaper from the split bamboo gives the walls a unique look and creates a warm cozy atmosphere in the house. Bamboo wallpaper is resistant to sun rays and mechanical damage. To give them freshness, you should only wipe the wallpaper with a damp cloth.

Bamboo panels are ideal for rooms with high humidity (baths, pools, toilets). Weaving at bamboo panels, as a rule, large and multilayered. Panels are made from mats that are hand-weaved and impregnated with acrylic glue, and then pressed.

The ceilings can also be decorated with bamboo panels of finer weaving, and the slots between them are sealed with special slats, which are biscuit bamboo shoots that are easily glued. In addition, this way you can create the illusion of a two-level ceiling.

Bamboo in the interior, as an additional element.

Bamboo trunks are a unique material for creating interior partitions, decorative curtains, screens for heating batteries and decorative columns. Curtains and bamboo blinds create unusual comfort and coziness. Chinese craftsmen make bamboo dishes, flower vases, ashtrays, boxes for sweets and other items.

The convenience of working with bamboo flooring is also conditioned by the fact that this relatively new type of flooring is flat, as well as from any other wood.

With the latest technology, manufacturers are turning bamboo stems into a high-quality ultra-smooth floor to meet the rapidly growing demand for this exceptionally stylish floor covering.

Like other wooden floors, the processed reed is supplied in short laminated strips, boards or tiles, proceeding from this installation is carried out in the same way as any other similar type of flooring material. Being tough and durable, bamboo parquet will last for many years, if it is properly installed and maintained.

item.title: Various Technologies for Pressing Stranded Woven Bamboo Flooring
item.source: Various Technologies for Pressing Stranded Woven Bamboo Flooring
item.description:
Solid stranded woven bamboo flooring can be purchased in thinner, newer and shorter plank size that can complement any size, shape or style of the room. As the planks of the floor start to get thin, they acquire the essential properties for low clearance underneath doors, especially the UPVC doors. 

The stranded wooden planks are available in carbonized and natural colors. While the natural ones have golden and pale blonde tones, whereas the carbonized form of bamboo gives smoky texture as it is smoked to give coffee colored rich appearance. The smaller planks of floor provides similar benefits as any other click fitting stranded woven bamboo flooring. 

Here are some of the essential features of stranded woven flooring 

Features:

They are strong and durable, in fact twice as hard as the oak flooring options

They are compatible with underfloor heating

The click fitting system makes it easier to install them

They can be floated over an underlay or fixed on their position

They come finished with protective anti scratch lacquer

Sustainable and environmental flooring with FSC 100%

They are easier to maintain and look after

Stranded woven flooring is a new discovery into the world of the flooring and it is quite environment friendly material offering high quality. Stranded woven bamboo is a wood manufacturing process that is based on principles of processing, reorganization with a bamboo as raw material and a new bamboo floor board. The stranded woven flooring is composed of a bamboo beams which is further cracked and cross linked into cross linked long fiber and then it is dried, glued and pressed to get one log of strong woven stranded plank.

There are 2 different methods of strand woven- Hot press and Cold press. However, the preparation of pressing is same. Only drying and pressing processes differ. Here is a brief about the hot press and cold press along with their advantages and shortcomings.

The cold press requires a dip in glue once the moisture content of the bamboo strip is lowered down and then it is dried loading the bamboo strip in to the desired mold shape, pressing into the log and locking at room temperature for heat cure process. 

After this, the mold is broken and the board is balanced. Cold press, on the other hand, requires little investment in the form of equipment, gives higher productivity and efficient, good resistance to deformation and is available in a wide range. 

Cold Press

Advantages:

The cold press has a long cure time, simple process cutting, less color variations among others. Workers are labor intensive, but has a capability lesser than the hot press variant. 

Under the cold press, the heat curing takes place once the bamboo strips are loaded into the mold so that the mold gets heated which further results in slight expansion. This results in log edges not having uniform density in the middle. The edges get paralyzed causing uneven density of the board. It means the resultant floor surface will have the problem of cracks, deformities and ripples after coating. 

Hot Press

Hot Press in stranded woven flooring overcomes some of the deficiencies found in cold press. The press processing is completed under thousands of tons of pressure and there are no ripples or paralyzed edges left. 

Hot press woven strands have higher density and thus, difficult to cut. The material cost is also relatively higher. Since the heat curing time is short, the woven strands have larger color variations as compared to cold press. Hot press requires large equipment investment, single color- carbonized form, lower product efficiency and is labor intensive. However, the product toughness is commendable. 

Stranded woven flooring also has good sound insulation properties, are stable and durable but utilize higher amount of bamboo. 

Virtues of stranded woven flooring over the regular wood flooring:

Stranded woven flooring is like using renewable resources: Bamboo is a raw material, and is a perfect alternative to the hardwood flooring. The utilization of bamboo is quite high. As high as 90% of bamboo is used which is twice the traditional raw material utilization. Stranded woven bamboo flooring is not just sustainable but also helps in protecting the environment.

item.title: Engineered, Solid wood and Bamboo flooring
item.source: Engineered, Solid wood and Bamboo flooring
item.description:
Engineered Flooring 


An engineering flooring, by definition, is a base of multi-plywood and above a sheet of solid plywood. Engineering floors are often confused with Pergo, but these could not be more different. Pergo, known as laminate flooring, has only one image of laminated wood over it, usually plasticized or compressed in cardboard or recycled wood.


Engineering floors were developed in Europe because solid floors do not work well with radiant heat radiators. Because of this fact, engineering floors are more stable than solids and can be installed in certain environments that solid floors should not be installed. Taking into account the proper subsoil conditions, engineering floors can be installed from different options such as: nailed, glued, or floated.


Solid flooring


There are mainly two types of solid floors: pre-finished and unfinished. The only difference between these two types is that the pre-finished ones are polished and varnished before being installed. All these floors are protected with ceramic UV finish and are 100% selected wood, especially bamboo. 


These solid floors can be used on any surface that does not contain high moisture content and preferably there is no radiant under floor heating. The acoustics, hardness, and appearance are similar and sometimes superior to any solid wood you find on the market, with the great difference that these are renewable in the short term.


Between floors of engineering and solid floors, there are three types:


Vertical Finish


Horizontal


Fabric / Ribbed


What exactly does a bamboo wood floor mean?


Bamboo is wood with resistant fibers, flexible and ecological. This material has become the substitute of other species. Gives rise to tables for floors of high quality, excellent appearance, and indefinite duration. They are very hard and tough "woods" that offer the advantage of not having to cut down forests to make floors. And you would never believe they were bamboo. 


Bamboo flooring reviews can be of various colors, according to the processing of the poles before their manufacture. They can be as clear as beech, as pink as cherry or as dark as mahogany. The decks of many cruise ships, such as those of the "Seven Sees" are made of bamboo, as are the floors of several international hotel chains, among other floors famous for their appearance and intensity of traffic.


Wood floors are so common that one often forgets that there are other alternatives to put on its floor. Bamboo flooring reviews have proven that it works better than several kinds of wood flooring. Originally from Asia, bamboo is a flexible but very resistant plant. Sold in the form of slats, solid parquet, roller or floating parquet, bamboo often has the appearance of wood when laid as the floor. It may have a natural or charred color. 


In most cases, except for floating floors, installation requires nails or glue. It is a durable, renewable and moisture resistant material. It is suitable for all rooms of a house except those with a moisture content of more than 60%.


Cork flooring


The cork is derived from the bark of the cork oak. This material is found in the form of tiles, rollers and floating coatings. Its installation often requires the installation of a vapor barrier membrane beforehand. To install the floor parts, the special glue must be used. In addition to being renewable, ecological and durable, this material is fire and water resistant. It dampens shocks and is an excellent thermal and sound insulation.


However, a cork will tend to be damaged by heavy objects (furniture, etc.). Moreover, its soundproofing properties dissipate when it is too hardened by varnishing. The use of PVC as a protective layer corrects this problem. Beware, however, of poor quality cork, which may be too malleable, as well as plastic counterfeits.


How to lay bamboo flooring?


Laying bamboo flooring begins with the preparation of the raw material and the base for laying. Planks need to get out of the packages, allow them to adapt to the temperature of the room within 2 days. The basis for laying is the correctly made: it should not have cracks, ledges, absolutely dry, primed and without slopes. 
For the adhesive method, it is characteristic that the material is directly adhered to a concrete or cement base. This method is used less and less these days. Rely only on the professional with experience for correct installation.

Versatility

All this, coupled with its hardness and resistance , ensure that its sustainability is not only at the time of producing it, but also, at the time of performing maintenance and changing it, taking much longer than we should use to replace another type of solid wood flooring.

The large number of finishes, from natural vertical to softer tonalities in horizontal orientation, achieve an avant-garde effect on the decoration of our spaces.
