item.title: Bothbest Offers Engineered Bamboo Flooring Solutions for Residential and Commercial Usage
item.source: Bothbest Offers Engineered Bamboo Flooring Solutions for Residential and Commercial Usage
item.description:
Bothbest, a Chinese manufacturer and exporter of bamboo-based products, now also offers engineered bamboo flooring solutions for homes and offices. The engineered bamboo flooring products are basically combinations of wood and bamboo, the owners informed. They added that this kind of flooring consists of 4mm layer of bamboo and the remaining part is made with wood. According to them, these floors have wide applicability and can be used on radiant heat, concrete, plywood and many more places.


“The grain of the wear layer, which is made of bamboo, runs across the length of the plank up and down, while the inner layer, which is made of wood, runs horizontally. The backing also runs vertically in both directions. We call it cross-lamination and it actually gives unrivaled stability to the floor. By cross laminating, we ensure that the grain forces oppose each other. This gives enhanced stability to the flooring”, said a sales executive from bamboo flooring factory - Bothbest.


The sales executive also added that engineered bamboo floorings provide high value for money to the end users due to the easy installation, and the aesthetic quality and heavy-duty nature of the of the flooring. At present, the manufacturing company offers engineered bamboo flooring in two different dimensions. The sales executive added that the engineered bamboo flooring products are available in two different colors, carbonized and natural.


A media manager from Bothbest, which is also a leading bamboo decking products manufacturer, fleshed out the specifications of the engineered bamboo floors they manufacture. “This type of flooring has a hardness of 1100-1300 lbf Janka hardness. We use only Dynea European 1 standard glue for making these products. We also use Satin Aluminum-Oxide mixed UV-treated urethane as anti-scratch top coating. Also, we take pride in using the lowest amount of formaldehyde in all of our products. We aim to become the market leader in sustainable bamboo flooring manufacturing industry”, he told the press. According to him, the company offers now twenty five year de-lamination warranty on nearly all of its products, including the engineered bamboo flooring products that are suitable for both residential and commercial usage.

item.title: Four Strong Reasons To Buy Bamboo Flooring
item.source: Four Strong Reasons To Buy Bamboo Flooring
item.description:
Nowadays in the flooring market, bamboo flooring can be considered as the newly-developing flooring, in fact, more and more consumers are interested in it because of its unique features, however, lots of customers are still hesitating whether it is right to buy bamboo flooring. Don’t worry, in the following article, four strong reasons will be given to you to decorate your home or office with bamboo flooring.


Firstly, better stability than solid wooden flooring


In the past, solid wooden flooring would be people’s first choice when selecting flooring for decoration because of natural raw material. I think it will become history now because bamboo flooring has better stability than solid wooden flooring, for example, both the shrinking percentage and expansion rate of bamboo flooring is relatively limited.


Some people would have such standpoint that bamboo flooring is easy to be damaged by worms because bamboo grow under moist environment and lots of worms live in bamboo. This is the fact in the past, but please neglect this shortcoming now because advanced manufacturing technique is used during bamboo flooring manufacture to overcome such weakness.


Compared with solid wooden flooring, bamboo flooring has higher hardness, therefore it is durable.


Secondly, people will feel more comfortable when walking on bamboo flooring


When introducing the main advantage of bamboo flooring, I am sure salesman would tell you that it is warm in cold winter while cool in hot summer when using bamboo flooring for decoration at home.


As is know to you, bamboo itself has lower heat conductivity coefficient so that no matter the season, its temperature is constant. When walking on flooring without wearing shoes, people would feel more comfortable.


Thirdly, pure and fresh color of bamboo flooring


Just from the aesthetic feeling aspect, bamboo flooring is so distinctive on both its flower color and texture, at the same time, when looking at its texture, you will notice it is so unique.


As for laminate flooring, which is also mainly used for home decoration, there is a layer of paper on its surface, after a long time using, it is easy to be color fading. Compared with solid wooden flooring, there is only limited chromatic aberration, if you are people who pay more attention on flooring color, bamboo flooring would be your wise choice because of obvious advantage.


Fourthly, better performance of environmental protection


Believe it or not, bamboo flooring would be the flooring product development direction in the future due to its better environmental protection. As you know, bamboo is one of renewable resources because as usual its growth cycle is only a few years. In order to protect the environment, renewable resources such as bamboo will be mainly used.

item.title: Solid Bamboo Flooring: How it Comes About
item.source: Solid Bamboo Flooring: How it Comes About
item.description:
Solid bamboo flooring will have your interior space looking as natural as possible. It boasts of the most interesting patterns. Over time dents and scratches may appear on your flooring, you need not worry because you can sand down and have the surface of the floor refinished periodically. This will definitely do the trick in making it look fresh and new again.

It can be used in living rooms, bedrooms and home offices. It is not advisable to have in the kitchen unless proper precautions are taken. It should also never be used in the bath room because of the water and moisture. 

Let us take a look at how it is processed.

The manufacturing process

Bamboo is brittle and uneven when harvested and it is not often used raw in modern flooring applications. However it is processed in a manner that retains all the positive benefits of the bamboo as well as making it more versatile.

The first step when it comes to manufacturing solid bamboo flooring planks is slicing the plant stalks into very thin pieces. It is then followed by the removal of the skin from the material and then boiled in Boric acid. The acid is helpful in killing microorganisms or bacteria in the bamboo while also removing any starches that had remained.

The slices are then coated and bonded together into solid pieces using heat and pressure and the ultimate look of the flooring will depend on how the individual chips are lined up. Some of the common ways of pieces being lined up are;

Horizontal: Here the individual chips are laid flat one on top of the other. This leads to a floor with a more consistent look and few features. It also happen to bring out the closest appearance to natural bamboo materials.

Vertical: Here the chips are usually lined up straight up and down. They are also bonded using pressure which pushes them from either side. In as much as it has a natural bamboo look, these floors also tend to have busy and mottled features on their surface. This can be great for hiding dirt as well as making a plain room a sense of interest.

Once the adhesive dries up, the solid planks are usually planed and sanded so as to make them smooth and have even surfaces on every side. An application of UV lacquer also helps in the curing process. It is finally sanded one last time to complete the finish on the material.

item.title: How to Take Care of Your Bamboo Floor: The Dos and Don’ts
item.source: How to Take Care of Your Bamboo Floor: The Dos and Don’ts
item.description:
Bamboo is wonderful and elegant floor covering that give your interior space a great look and feel. The best part about it is that it is natural, environmentally friendly, easy to maintain and fairly inexpensive. It is similar to hardwood flooring and as such it requires attention and maintenance if you want to get the best out of it.

Cleaning your bamboo floor

When it comes to bamboo floors, dust, sand and small particle happen to be its greatest threat to its beauty. They usually cause scratching and scarring when they are pressed down as people walk across the floor. These tiny grains can make a lot of damage to your flooring over time, if they are not handled properly. Always ensure that you don’t allow them to build up on your floor and you can use mats and rugs at any entrances to the room to reduce the amount of grit particles entering the space. Ensure that you dust them regularly.

You can also ensure regular cleaning by using a number of products that have been developed and designed specifically for cleaning bamboo floors. You can also make use of hardwood floor cleansers provided that they are non-wax and non-alkaline.

Water on a bamboo flooring

Bamboo floors are more water resistant than hardwood floors, however water still is quite distractive. You should only use a damp mop when removing surface stains and picking up small debris. However you should not let the floor remain moist for more than a few minutes.  You should also make sure than you don’t immerse it in water for any reason.

Ensure that you wipe any liquid spill on the floor immediately. Because of its porous nature liquids can penetrate its surface and cause deep stains that will be impossible to remove.

If you happen to be using a bamboo floor cleaning product that requires to be used by mixing with water, ensure that you follow all the manufacturer’s instructions.

Bamboo flooring wax

When it comes to waxing, most people usually think of all the effort they will take in it. It requires periodic buffing with large complex and expensive machines. Bamboo floors are recommended to have a wax surface coating only in certain commercial applications. Once it has been applied no other coating can be used. A urethane finish is usually more popular in a lot of installations.

item.title: Bamboo Flooring Buyer’s Guide
item.source: Bamboo Flooring Buyer’s Guide
item.description:
When it comes to buying bamboo flooring materials, you need to account for a lot of things. You will need to decide on the color, style and size of the planks and installation method you would like to use. Therefore you need to ask your retailer or dealer several questions so as to know exactly what type will suit you best. That is why this guide will take you through some common things you should know before buying:


1. Strength and durability


When it comes to the strength of bamboo, the best way to measure it is to place it relative to hardwood materials. Its strength also depends on a lot of factors. If a bamboo flooring panel is darker then it will be less durable mainly because the dark hues are caused by a process known as carbonization which puts the bamboo under a high level of heat and pressure. The eventual result is the weakening of the material.


Also the time period when it has been harvested can affect its durability and hardness as the ideal time to reap bamboo stalks is five years after being planted. Premature as well as late harvesting will cause the material to be weaker.


Also you should know that the most durable bamboo flooring is strand woven materials which are made by having the stalk shredded and then putting it together into a block using pressure and adhesive.


2. Quality


When it comes to rating bamboo materials, there is no standard grading system yet since it happens to be a fairly new product. Many dealers usually group their products into grade A and grade B which are just but arbitrary. Therefore you need to find a reputable dealer who will deliver the best quality materials from reliable sources.


3. Relative hardness


Bamboo can be compared to hardwood hardness to find out how good it is.


Natural bamboo flooring = Red oak Hardwood
Carbonized bamboo flooring = black walnut hardwood
Strand woven bamboo flooring = Brazilian cherry hardwood


Usually the hardness type of strand woven bamboo is more durable than the others.


4. Surface treatment


The price of bamboo materials is usually heavily influenced by the type of UV coating which is applied to the surface. Low quality materials usually have two or three coats applied whereas the ideal bamboo flooring should have at least six or seven coats on all sides of the planks.

item.title: Bamboo Flooring Types
item.source: Bamboo Flooring Types
item.description:
There are generally two types of bamboo flooring: solid bamboo flooring and engineered planks. The engineered planks are usually installed using a floating floor method whereby the planks are laid over a thin foam rubber underlayment. Therefore the planks are not laid directly on the floor. It is a quick installation method.


Solid bamboo on the other hand is installed just like any other hardwood flooring. It is fastened down with either staples or nails. This method usually takes a lot of time, more than double the time it takes for a floating floor installation but the result is usually a rock-solid, permanent floor.


Solid bamboo comes in three different kinds:


Flat grain solid strip- This kind of bamboo is usually composed of flat strips of bamboo that are stacked on top of each other and then later on laminated. It is the most common type.


Strand bamboo- Manufacturing of strand bamboo on the other hand, is composed of super thin shredded bamboo fibers which are mixed with resins and then pressed into rock hard planks.


Vertical grain solid strip- This kind of bamboo is made up of thin bamboo strips that are stacked on the edge and then glued together.

Usually bamboo flooring comes in more than 50 different colors which range from soft cedar tones to bright reds and greens even the grain pattern and natural color are rather subtle.


Costs of bamboo floors


When it comes to the prices of solid bamboos, they usually range between $2 and $4 per square foot. Engineered bamboo flooring on the other hand costs around $3 and $7 per square foot. The general basis of prices is often on the thickness of the plank. The thicker it is, the more expensive it costs. Well those prices make bamboo a bit more expensive but you should consider the rather complex process of manufacturing it and the fact that most of it is harvested in East Asia.


Nowadays, flooring warranties are usually an indicator of their quality. Some of the most expensive and best flooring come with longer warranties against defects from manufacturing or any other problem attributed to the company on installation of it.


If you want bamboo flooring and you don’t know where to start, you can now just check on it online and choose from an assortment of websites. You can also visit a local dealer and inquire about the bamboo flooring products that they have available.

item.title: Click Lock Bamboo Flooring Reviews
item.source: Click Lock Bamboo Flooring Reviews
item.description:
Click bamboo flooring is a type of engineered bamboo. Usually engineered bamboo flooring appears like it is wholly made up of solid pieces of bamboo but it really isn’t. There is actually quite a little bamboo in each piece because during manufacturing the plant stalk is usually sliced into very thin sheets and adhered to a backing material. On the top of the plank is a wear layer that acts to protect the bamboo veneer and at the bottom is also another water proof layer for protection. Therefore the actual bamboo is sandwiched between these two surfaces thereby becoming impervious to stains and moisture.


How click flooring works


This is one of the easiest ways of installing bamboo flooring and you can even do it on your own. Click bamboo flooring has been designed to snap together thereby creating a floating floor without having to use either glue, staples or nails. You will find it exciting to install as well as easy to have replaced when a piece is damaged.


Click Bamboo Flooring Advantages


This kind of floor is usually durable, strong and easy to maintain and looks a lot like natural bamboo but without the drawbacks of it. The tiles are available in a click together pattern that can be installed by even an amateur. If an individual tile gets damaged it can be removed and replaced with another one quite easily. It can also be installed safely in environments that are wet.


Click Bamboo Flooring Disadvantages


It is usually very hard to refinish an engineered bamboo flooring. The wear layer is very durable but when it degrades the floor will just have to be replaced.


Click Bamboo Flooring Applications


Engineered bamboo when properly installed can be suitable for almost any location. If you are installing it in a high traffic environment you will have to purchase the tiles with a thicker wear layer so as to avoid quick degradation.


Even though it is not 100% bamboo, it happens to be stronger than solid wood. It is normally made up of different types of wood with the top layer having bamboo strips and boasts of a lesser expansion rate in comparison to non-engineered bamboo flooring. Due to this, it is a very good option for people located in very humid weather or very dry weather which are quite harmful for pure natural bamboo. Their prices usually start at around $3 for each square foot.

item.title: Bamboo Flooring in Bathroom
item.source: Bamboo Flooring in Bathroom
item.description:
Bamboo has become popular in the making of flooring in the kitchen and bathrooms. It is gaining traction in the market and many people are starting to appreciate the product. However many people are still wondering as to whether bamboo flooring can be used in the bathroom. Well most of the arguments are usually centered on the fact that bamboo is grass therefore its flooring should hold up at least slightly better than hardwood. Others believe that it is too volatile to be used in that manner.


Some of the properties that will make bamboo seem good enough for use in the bathroom include: it is water resistant to a certain degree, it is also mold resistant, mildew resistant as well as germ resistant.


Unfortunately in as much as they are resistant, it does not mean that they are immune. Some of the reasons why bamboo is not good for use in the bathroom are:


Swelling- if you allow water to soak the bamboo i.e. stay on the bamboo floor for quite some time, it will lead to it being plumped and may get warped and disfigured. Unfortunately this can ruin your flooring completely and you can’t repair it by refinishing.


Stains: abrasive cleansers and soaps can wear away the surface finish of bamboo floors in the bathroom and even water splatters that are allowed to sit on the floor can cause permanent marks.


Flooding: if a pipe happens to break or leak and there is a flood then your bamboo flooring will be ruined. It will plump and disfigure and may end up getting mold.


Bamboo bathroom floor finish


Well the best news about all of this is that you can seal your bamboo bathroom floor with a polyurethane based surface finish which acts as an invisible barrier against water and stain agent penetration. It will have to be applied both on the surface and also to the seams. The seams will have to be glued together to ensure that it is impregnable.


Considerations for use


If you decide to have bamboo flooring placed on your bathroom floor then you need to consider who will be using the bathroom in the first place. If it is adults, then you can carefully place mats at all the areas of water usage and ensure that all spills are cleared when made. If it is children, then this becomes a bit trickier since they love to splatter water all over. So it should be avoided in a bathroom for kids.


Warranty- one of the most important things is this. You need to read the warranty carefully before installing the flooring in your bathroom. There are cases where the installation of bamboo flooring in wet areas can void the warranty.


Also it would be better to use engineered bamboo for your bathroom flooring because it is made when a thin sheet of bamboo is adhered to a fiber board backing. The material is also sealed with a water proof layer wear layer on top and a water barrier at the bottom. This makes it impervious to moisture penetration and at the same time gives your bathroom that bamboo finish.

item.title: Tips When Buying Bamboo Flooring
item.source: Tips When Buying Bamboo Flooring
item.description:
In recent years, more and more bamboo flooring appear in the market, so that customer would be puzzled which bamboo flooring is the top quality one. As you know, made by different workmanship and raw materials, their sale price would be different. Among all these flooring, let us talk about how to select high quality bamboo flooring.


There are too many tips to select high quality flooring, and among them, the first thing you should learn its to pay attention on the details of bamboo raw material.


At the beginning of processing bamboo raw material, bamboo surface should be digged completely, for example, the yellow parts including bamboo skins should e cleaned, as a result, only the crude fiber in the middle would be retained.


Why we should remove the bamboo green? Both density in bamboo skin and its crude fiber are different, therefore it is easy to be cracked even under the same humidity and dryness condition because of different shrinking percentage. At the same time, there is sugar and other nutrient contents contained inside the tabasheer, if not be removed, bamboo flooring is easy to be damaged by worms and even mildewed.


The performance of bending resistance by bamboo raw material is better than wooden raw materials, so that bamboo flooring with 15mm thickness has enough bending resistance performance, crush resistance performance and impact resistance, meanwhile, when walking on flooring, people will feel more comfortable.


In daily life, too many customers have such viewpoint that the thicker bamboo flooring, the higher quality it is, under such circumstance, some flooring manufacturers don’t remove the bamboo green and bamboo yellow so that the bamboo flooring looks too much thicker, with 17mm or 18mm thickness, however, its agglutination condition is not very good and it is easy to be cracked. As for top quality bamboo flooring, after finish machining, all the bamboo chips are compact together, and the tolerance of both its thickness and width should be controlled at 0.1mm.


How to identify top quality bamboo flooring? If bamboo green and bamboo yellow are not removed completely, such bamboo chips can not be pressed by large scale press machine, therefore you should pay attention on the flat clamp, which should be three layers structure., if it is poor quality bamboo flooring, its inside structure and back part should be shoddy goods for high quality goods even if the flooring surface are made from top quality bamboo, what you should do is to turn over flooring to check its condition.


In addition this tip introduced in above article, you can also buy bamboo flooring when looking at its color to judge whether the raw material is boiled down or even carbonized.

item.title: China Bamboo Cultural Festival
item.source: China Bamboo Cultural Festival
item.description:
November 18, the Eighth China Bamboo Cultural Festival jointly organized by the State Forestry Administration and the provincial government, INBAR opened in Huangshan City. Deputy director of the CPPCC Population Resources and Environment Committee, Co-Chair of INBAR Board of Directors, president of the Chinese Bamboo Industry Association Zehui attended the opening ceremony and announced the opening.


The Bamboo Cultural Festival theme: "promote the bamboo culture, the development of bamboo industry, building a better village." Bamboo Cultural Festival colorful, not only visits the province bamboo technology demonstration park, visit the National Bamboo and Rattan (Huangshan) Engineering Technology Research Center and the Bamboo Germplasm Bank, also held development of bamboo industry to exchange experiences, green bamboo industry development and innovation-driven international seminars, thematic photography exhibition bamboo culture and rhyme in Huangshan bamboo bamboo planting Memorial. 8 bamboo producing provinces forestry department heads, "the Chinese bamboo township" "Bamboo Chinese characteristics" on behalf of, the UNESCO representative in China, INBAR Board of Directors and Member States diplomatic envoys, representatives of the State Forestry, scholars bamboo industry research units and more than 400 people attended the opening ceremony.


Bamboo industry is one of the top ten green enriching focus on the development of China‘s forestry industry, China Bamboo Cultural Festival is to promote the development of bamboo industry a good carrier. Abundant bamboo resources in the province, an area of 505.8 acres of existing bamboo forest, accounting for 8.86 percent of the province‘s forest area, in 2013 the province‘s bamboo industry output value 14.36 billion yuan, ranking sixth in the country.

item.title: Buy High Quality Bamboo Flooring
item.source: Buy High Quality Bamboo Flooring
item.description:
If you want to buy top quality bamboo flooring, please pay attention on this article because a few related tips will be introduced at here, and I am sure you will get useful knowledge after reading it.


Firstly, looking at bamboo flooring color


When manufacturing bamboo flooring, bamboo raw material should be processed at first to remove its bamboo green and bamboo yellow, and in the next step, bamboo cane should be boiled down if its original color is kept, and if it is already coffee color, bamboo cane should be carbonized under high temperature and high pressure environment to change its color, by this way, sugar, starch and other nutrient contents contained inside bamboo should be completely removed, as being manufactured, bamboo flooring will not be damaged by worms or other fungoid easily.


After being carbonized, bamboo will become lighter, however, its performance of bending resistance, crush resistance and water proof will be better, meanwhile, beyond your expectation, bamboo after being carbonize can play the role of purging air.


Looking at bamboo flooring color, if it is natural color and the bamboo lines are clear, its quality is not very good, as for the top quality bamboo flooring after being carbonized, the whole body should be coffee, if the carbonized condition is very good, it would be khaki.


Secondly, compare its raw materials used for flooring manufacture


When checking the raw materials, it is necessary to check the mucilage glue, which is used to connect different bamboo chips together and finally form a whole bamboo flooring. If the mucilage glue quality is very poor, bamboo flooring is easy to be out of shape and even be cracked.


Here is the simplest way to check the mucilage glue condition, just put a small pieces of bamboo flooring into water and then soak for a while, you should compare its expansion condition and deformation condition in a certain period of time.


Thirdly, pay attention on the moisture content of bamboo flooring


In short, it is important to avoid being cracked when paving bamboo flooring at home, so that moisture content is a significant factor which should not missed. For example, if the moisture content is too much higher or it is not uniform, flooring is easy to be cracked with the drastic change of temperature and humidity.


As for the standard of moisture content, please be careful that it would be different at different regions, in general, in the south region, moisture content should be about 12 percent and in the south region, it should be controlled between 8 percent and 10 percent because bamboo flooring would be accommodated with local climatic environment very well. When buying bamboo flooring, you can use your hands to touch its surface to feel its moisture content.

item.title: Misunderstandings on Bamboo Flooring
item.source: Misunderstandings on Bamboo Flooring
item.description:
Because bamboo flooring is the new type flooring which was only appeared in recent years, I am sure not all the people are familiar with it, what’s worse, some people have wrong viewpoints on bamboo flooring, for example, when talking about bamboo flooring, people would think that it is easy to be damaged by worms because it is mainly made from bamboo raw material. In fact, manufactured with modern technology, bamboo flooring has better performance on its durability compared with other flooring such as solid wood flooring, so please take it easy to make your purchase decision.


In the following article, I will mainly discuss four common wrong knowledge on bamboo flooring.


First misunderstanding, the older bamboo used as raw material, the better quality of flooring.


In people’s viewpoint, the older bamboo is more solid, so that after being manufactured into bamboo flooring, it is also solid. Let me tell the fact to you, bamboo with five or six years growth age is the best raw material for flooring manufacture because at this phase bamboo has the best elasticity and flexibility. If the bamboo growth time is below four years, it has poor performance of strength and hardness, on the contrary, if its growth time is over six years, the bamboo fiber is already aged, its tenacity is very poor and it is more fragile.


Second misunderstanding, the thicker bamboo flooring, the better quality. Compared with wood material, bamboo itself has better performance of bending resistance, generally speaking, the bamboo flooring with 15mm thickness already has the enough compression resistance and impact resistance performance, meanwhile, its texture is very good, when walking on it, people will feel more comfortable.


Third misunderstanding, bamboo flooring is easy to be cracked. In fact, during flooring production process, flooring, no matter bamboo flooring or solid wood composite floor, will be consolidated with cementing compound, then they will be bonded together under high temperature and high pressure environment, as a result, it has enough ability to adapt humidness change and temperature change. Don’t worry about so-called crack condition.


Fourth misunderstanding, bamboo flooring is easy to be damaged by worms and went mouldy. As you know, bamboo is easy to be damaged by worms because lots of nutrient substances such as carbohydrate, starch, amino acid, protein and so on are contained inside, however, this is not the case for bamboo flooring because corresponding production measures will be used to avoid such problems. For example, bamboo will be boiled under high temperature environment, which is useful for mildew proof and insect prevention, meanwhile, bamboo will be also carbonized under high temperature environment so that all these nutrient substances will be resolved.

item.title: Comparisons Bamboo vs Wood Flooring
item.source: Comparisons Bamboo vs Wood Flooring
item.description:
Nowadays, there are too many floors for people to select for home or office decoration, for example, it is common to see solid wood flooring, solid wood composite flooring, strengthening composite flooring and bamboo flooring. All these flooring have their own advantages and disadvantages, therefore when making purchase decision, people have to weigh their merits and demerits, this is the exact article about comparison between bamboo flooring and solid wood flooring, which is useful for you to make wise decision.


Firstly, about stability


Bamboo flooring has its advantage on stability because it is not easy to be shrank and expand, however, please pay attention on the durability of bamboo flooring, if you want to lengthen its working life, you’d better avoid these two aspects, on the one hand, bamboo flooring should not be under the blazing sun for quite a long time or under too much moist environment, on the other hand, it is easy to be damaged by worms, especially in south area.


Secondly, about comfort degree


I am sure lots of people choose bamboo flooring for decoration because of its remarkable comfort degree. When paving bamboo flooring at room, people will feel that it is cool in hot summer and so warm in cold winter, do you know the reason? Bamboo raw material has low heat conductivity coefficient so it can not release cold air or warm air by itself. No mater the seasons, people can walk on bamboo flooring even without wearing shoes and socks, it is more comfortable.


Thirdly, about color and lustre


From the aspect of artistic outlook, bamboo flooring is more monotonous because the bamboo raw material itself doesn’t have abundant color and lustre, it is not suitable for diversified decoration style at the beginning, however, this problem has ceased to exist because of dyeing technology used in bamboo flooring manufacture. As for solid wood flooring, which is mainly made from natural wood, there is no such problem on color and lustre. If you are the people who don’t like chromatic aberration, bamboo flooring should be your wise choice.


Finally, about environmental protection factor


Believe it or not, in the long term, bamboo flooring would be the development tendency in home or office decoration industry because of its environmentally friendly advantage.


As is known to all, the growth cycle of bamboo is too much less than that of trees, in other words, bamboo can be considered as sustainable resource because only in a few years, bamboo can grow up and then used as material. As for solid wood flooring, its raw material is the trees which have grown at least thirty years, so it will be less and less, more and more precious in the future.

item.title: Advantages And Disadvantages of Bamboo Flooring
item.source: Advantages And Disadvantages of Bamboo Flooring
item.description:
You can find lots of articles online about advantages of bamboo flooring, however, in my standpoint, it is necessary for you to learn its disadvantages because only you can accept its shortcomings, you can accept bamboo flooring completely.


This is the exact article about comprehensive analysis on bamboo flooring’s merits and demerits, are you interested?


Let us talk about its disadvantages at first


Firstly, the paste is easy to be fell off. You can full understand this shortcoming if you know the whole productive process of bamboo flooring. It is made from bamboo, and at beginning, it is small size bamboo chip, then different bamboo chips should be pasted together to form a large size flooring, during this productive steps, binding material should be used so that it is easy to be fell off if poor quality binding material was used.


Secondly, it is easy to be divided into different layers. In short, bamboo flooring is the combination between flooring and wood, because of uncertain factors such as strong sunlight or humidness, it will be divided into different layers gradually.


Thirdly, the performance of water proof is not good. Compared with solid wood flooring, bamboo flooring has the same shortcomings, once being soaked in water, it will be expanded and even out of shape, what’s worse, oil painting will be bubbled, after a long time, it will go mouldy and finally rotted.


Fourthly, it is not suitable for room at which there is floor heating. Solid wood floor can be paved at room even if there is floor heating, which is important equipment in cold northern area in winter, however, this is not suitable for bamboo flooring because it will be out of shape under too much high temperature environment.


After reading these four shortcomings of bamboo flooring, do you still have interested in it? Of course, please take it easy on these disadvantages because different floors also have their own disadvantages.


Now, it is time to talk about advantages of bamboo flooring.


Firstly, it is too much cheaper than solid wood floor


When buying decoration materials for home decoration, the first thing people have to consider is budget because lots of money should be spent on it. If you want to choose cheaper flooring with great cost performance, bamboo flooring should be your first choice.


Secondly, it is easy to be installed


When installing bamboo flooring at room, just follow simple steps and there is no need painting, in short, both time and work can be saved. Meanwhile, it will not lead to indoor pollution.


Finally, it is beneficial to health


According to research report, risk of sickness such as rheumatoid arthritis, heart disease would be reduced when paving bamboo flooring at home.

item.title: Basic Knowledge About Bamboo Flooring
item.source: Basic Knowledge About Bamboo Flooring
item.description:
When mentioning floors for home decoration, lots of people would think about ceramic tile, solid wood floor and so on, YES, in the past, they are the main floors in market. However, in recent years, one new type of floor become more and more popular and this is bamboo flooring. I am sure not every people are familiar with this new floor, let us learn it related knowledge in following article.


What is bamboo flooring?


Just as its name implies, bamboo flooring is mainly made from mao bamboo as raw material, at the beginning, it is small size bamboo board, and then connected together with strong glue to form bamboo floor.


Advantages of bamboo flooring


Bamboo flooring become most people’s first choice when selecting floor exactly because of its remarkable advantages.


Firstly, as is known to all, bamboo has low heat conductivity coefficient and it will not release quantity of heat or cold air by itself. Based on such characteristic, you will feel cool in hot summer and also feel warm in cold winter indoor if you floor bamboo flooring at home.


Secondly, according to different colors, bamboo flooring can be divided into natural color bamboo flooring and handmade painting color bamboo. As for the natural color flooring, its chromatic aberration is less than wood floor, what’s more, bamboo texture is more clear and abundant. As for handmade painting bamboo flooring, its texture is not obvious because of painted oil painting. In short, the chromatic aberration of bamboo flooring is lesser.


Thirdly, longer working life than other floors. Generally speaking, the working life of common bamboo flooring is as long as 20 years, of course, the actual working life is closely related to maintenance ways in daily life. For example, if conditions allow, bamboo flooring should be polished with wax about every two or three months, which plays important role to protect flooring. Meanwhile, it should not be under the blazing sun for quite a long time or wet through.


Finally, it is beneficial to people’s health. Some people would doubt this point, however, it is true. According to related research report, bamboo flooring is useful to guard against rheumatic arthritis, and reduce the pain of rheumatism and other illness. In addition, bamboo flooring is effective to protect people’s eyesight because ultraviolet ray indoor can be greatly absorbed by it.


As the old saying goes, there is no perfect goods in the world, so when you think about bamboo flooring’s advantages, you should also consider its disadvantages, at the same time, with different environment, bamboo flooring’s disadvantages would be different, in south area, it is easy to go mouldy while it is easy to crack in north area.

item.title: Healthy Bamboo Flooring Reviews
item.source: Healthy Bamboo Flooring Reviews
item.description:
When selecting floor for home or office decoration, lots of people would be puzzled because they don‘t know which floor would be better, the bamboo flooring or wooden floor. Don‘t worry, I think you will get your wise idea after reading this article below.


In addition to have better decorative effect, believe it or not, bamboo flooring is beneficial for people’s health.


Firstly, it is useful to prevent rheumatoid osteoarthritis. Different with other raw materials, bamboo itself has the ability to adjust and keep temperature automatically, so that when decorating with bamboo flooring, you will feel cool warm in winter and cool in summer. Living in such environment, rheumatoid osteoarthritis can be prevented effectively, meanwhile, the probability of occurrence of other illness such as rheumatism and heart disease will be reduced.


Secondly, it is beneficial to keep good eyesight. According to scientific research, the texture of bamboo flooring has function of absorbing ultraviolet ray, besides, with elegant color and lustre, people will feel more soft, warm and sweet, which is beneficial to eyesight.


Thirdly, it is useful to reduce noise. It is easy to understand such function because bamboo itself has ability of absorbing sound wave, reducing sound pressure and time between after-sounds. If there are the elderly at home, bamboo flooring must be your wise choice for home decoration, with such floor, the elderly would have top quality sleep quality, which is great beneficial to their physical conditions.


Fourthly, avoid serious injured after falling down. Different with hard wooden floor, bamboo flooring has moderate hardness, therefore even if falling down on floor, people will not be injured seriously. This is the same important if there are the elderly at home.


Fifth, the production process of bamboo floor is so strict and complicated, for example, they should be at first cook under high temperature environment, then bleached and carbonized, after these processed, all the nutrient substances in bamboo fiber will be removed and there is no any survival condition for worms and other germs. When decoration home with bamboo flooring, you would notice there is no mildew condition and it will not be damaged by worms, which is useful to prevent some illnesses such as asthma and hypersensitivity.


Sixth, it is beneficial to remove fatigue. Nowadays with fast pace of life, people will feel high pressure from both work and life, as time passes, they will feel more tired. Don’t worry, such condition will be remitted if using bamboo flooring for home decoration, as you know, bamboo raw material has appropriate elasticity, which is useful to alleviate gravity on footstep. Finally, people’s feeling of fatigue will be removed‘

item.title: Engineered Bamboo Flooring Review
item.source: Engineered Bamboo Flooring Review
item.description:
There are many types of flooring boards in bamboo. There are solid wood, strand woven woods and engineered bamboo flooring wood. There is not much difference to be seen between engineered wood and solid wood in terms of their looks while both differ in terms of their strength. Another aspect is that the engineered bamboo flooring presents a fine finish and is not knotty.


If one is interested in buying an engineer bamboo flooring for your use, then always look for flooring that has a quarter inch thick top layer to ensure maximum durability.


How is engineered bamboo flooring made?


Engineered bamboo flooring consists of bamboo strips on upper side of the board; they are then layered by other woods beneath. Engineered woods are considered to be vastly superior to solid wood floorings due to the blending of other types of woods. Engineered woods can be glued, nailed or floated to the subfloors.


Installing Engineered Bamboo Flooring


Bamboo flooring is very versatile; they can be glued or nailed to the subfloor. Floating, click on or snap lock type of installation is very popular among the do it yourself crowd. The bamboo planks are provided with cuts and grooves during the milling process. All the installer has to do is, assemble it all together like a jigsaw puzzle and once properly connected, lay the floor flat on the subfloor.


Another attractive feature of engineered bamboo flooring is it’s the best flooring for floating floor; however care should be ensured in that the one leaves some space for expansion of the woods due to its acclimatization process.


Advantages of Engineered Bamboo Flooring


Engineered bamboo wood flooring is far superior to solid wood flooring. They are much more resistant to the effects of moisture and less prone to be affected by the changing temperature.


Engineered bamboo flooring is designed to contract and expand without warping.


If sustainability is your priority, then engineered bamboo flooring is your go to wood. They can be even used in places where traditional wood flooring can’t be used.


One of the major advantages of engineered wood flooring is its non allergic properties. It does not harbor dust and mites like other woods, if you or your family members suffer from allergies, installing this wood makes breathing a lot easier indoors.


One can install this floor on any forms of subfloor; one can even install it by themselves without having to pay the labor charges for the installer thus saving a neat sum in the bargain.

item.title: Choose Quality Bamboo Flooring
item.source: Choose Quality Bamboo Flooring
item.description:
Because of promising market prospect, lots of floor manufacturers began to manufacture bamboo flooring, as a result, there are lots of bamboo flooring brands and products in floor market, as consumers, they want to know how to choose top quality bamboo flooring because in fact some retailers sell seconds at best quality prices. Here are some tips that you can follow when selecting bamboo flooring.


Firstly, it is necessary to know bamboo flooring manufacturer and related after-sales service


As for most consumers, it is difficult to judge bamboo flooring’s quality, high quality or poor quality, from its appearance. At the same time, bamboo flooring’s quality will only be reflected gradually during using procedure, how to solve such problem? The simple method is to judge its manufacturer’s strength. Generally speaking, large scale floor manufacturers have solid technical force, comprehensive testing method and high mechanized production, therefore its high quality would be guaranteed.


Secondly, compare their textures, structures and other details.


For example, compared with other bamboo fibers, phyllostachys pubescens has great hardness, at the same time, it has better performance of abrasion resistance, bending resistance and compression resistance due to high density, great toughness and small flexibility.


As for bamboo structure, it is recommended to buy the bamboo floor with three-layer structure. Because of the same thickness and breadth between the surface and ground surface, it is not easy to be out of shape.


As for other details you need to check are sandwich layer and bamboo cane. Take the sandwich layer for example, there should not be impurities in it, otherwise not only the bonding strength is not very good, but also bamboo floor’s strength will be very poor. This is the same case for bamboo cane, both bamboo green and tabasheer can not be found on it, otherwise the glue condition will be affected.


Thirdly, pay attention on the content of formaldehyde and its moisture content


After being covered with painting, as usual, the release content of formaldehyde in bamboo floor should meet the E1 standard. Simply speak, when using your nose to smell bamboo, you will not feel pungent smell. On the contrary, if your eyes or throat is stimulated, it is the signal of high release amount of formaldehyde.


Because of different humidities in different living environments, the standard of moisture content is also different when selecting bamboo floor, so it is important to know the actual situation in local environment. If moisture content doesn’t meet the standard, after a short time using, you will find that bamboo floor becomes black and its original gloss was lost, what’s worse, floor will be out of shape seriously.

item.title: Buying Bamboo Flooring Guides
item.source: Buying Bamboo Flooring Guides
item.description:
People interested to create eco friendly homes are more and more interested to use this incredibly durable, versatile and sustainable material for their flooring. Due to the versatility in which bamboo adapts to almost any interior decorating theme and due to added feature of giving breathtaking look to the entire house bamboo floors are aggressively preferred for flooring options. The best thing is bamboo after dying with different colors becomes extraordinarily beautiful either with finished or with unfinished look. Many times keeping natural look, feel and color of bamboo intact also happens to be the best flooring choice. Within everyone’s budget and with infinite choices homeowners redecorating their homes in small budget can also easily gain astonishing floor in cost effective manner.


Designs Available in Bamboo Flooring


Natural Bamboo: Bamboo stripes after initial production phase are boiled which clears it off all the impurities. With this process natural color of bamboo is enlightened that is similar to blond wood color. Avoiding further coloring or dying processes bamboo is preserved in its natural color. Now it is time to press and glue the bamboo boards together that converts them in to solid bamboo planks.


Carbonized Bamboo: Usually bamboo floors with dark colors are considered carbonized bamboo, which is carried out with pressure steaming process immediately after stripping. More often carbon is main ingredient in steaming process that helps in evenly dying bamboo strips from inside. Thus, not only surface is carbonized but also the bamboo stripes are dyed or colored from inside. Usually colors ranging from caramel to honey and from dark brown to coffee are achieved through pressure steaming process. However always keep in mind due to carbonizing of bamboo it loses its strength by almost eight percent so you have to be careful while choosing carbonized bamboo colored floorings.


Stained Bamboo: Immediately after the bamboo plans are produced using staining process bamboo planks can be colored or stained in multitude of colors. It is the job of bamboo flooring distributors to dye bamboo floor planks in almost any color according to the preference and choice of consumers. Using either panting technique or hand rubbing bamboo planks are stained in colors to meet the expectations of consumers.


Bottom Line


Due to the modern technology, it has been easy these days to process bamboo boards in variety of colors and patterns. The best thing is bamboo surface can be keep finished or unfinished offering consumers all the flexibility in selecting bamboo flooring as per their preference and needs. Therefore, you need to understand and evaluate every option you have at hand while opting for bamboo flooring.

item.title: Pay Attention On Bamboo Flooring Market
item.source: Pay Attention On Bamboo Flooring Market
item.description:
With the rapid development of economy and society, more and more people pay attention on healthy lifestyle, for example, they are likely to choose environmentally friendly building materials for home decoration. Under such circumstance, bamboo floor will become people’s wise choice. In fact, in recent years, bamboo flooring gradually comes into people‘s sight because of its better environmentally friendly feature. And I am sure in the future bamboo flooring will lead the trends in floor market.


Let’s talk about the market prospect of bamboo floor in China. According to related statistical data, the total area of bamboo forest in China is as many as 5 million hectare, and both its planting area and annual output is the Number one in the world. In other words, bamboo is the abundant natural resources in China. In addition to its quantity, bamboo’s quality is so high, as is know to all, moso bamboo is the best bamboo among all these varieties because of its high application value and better performance, 90 percent of moso bamboo all over the world now is in provinces in the south China. In the past, bamboo‘s market requirement exceeds supply, and now with fast development of bamboo flooring industry, such contradictory will be remitted.


Compared with wooden floor, bamboo flooring has its remarkable advantages. Firstly, the market price of solid wooden floor is about $30 to $ 50 per square meter, what’s more, pure solid wooden floor’s price is as higher as $70 to $ 90 per square meter, which is too much higher than bamboo flooring. Secondly, bamboo raw material itself is so elegant, therefore people will feel more high-end when using bamboo flooring for decoration.


Compared with solid wood composite floor, environmentally friendly characteristic is its advantage. Every year, there are too many fresh bamboos, after its growing period and stable phase, its texture will be reduced year by year and then become fragile, therefore bamboo should be chopped down every year but its growing environment will not be changed, it is so friendly to environment.


Compared with intensified wood floor, bamboo flooring has less chromatic aberration. As you know, bamboo‘s radius is more less than that’s of trees, and it will not be affected by sunlight, as a result, there is no obvious night side and sunny side. At the same time, due to abundant bamboo texture, its color and lustre are uniform. In theory, the working life of bamboo floor is as long as 20 years because it is more stable than other wood floors.

item.title: Bamboo Planting and Maintenance
item.source: Bamboo Planting and Maintenance
item.description:
When being asked how to plant bamboo and how to maintain bamboo after being planted, can you give the right answer? If you want to plant bamboo for enjoyment of sight, or as bamboo industry to get selling profit, it is necessary for you to know related knowledge. Let us talk about matters needing attention when planting bamboo.


Firstly, it is important to choose right variety of bamboo according to your living environment. As is known all, bamboo has regional planting feature, for example, some bamboos will die under too much cold environment while some bamboos will not grow very well in tropical zone, besides, some bamboos will be affected during process of growth if the ray of light is not suitable. In short, growing environment is the first factor you have to consider and then choose right bamboo variety.


Secondly, how to build the bamboo garden. Nowadays some bamboos will be planted in residential quarter in city so that people will enjoy its elegant appearance, this is called the bamboo garden in city. However, because of poor soil texture in city, like soil from construction site mixed, it is not easy to plant bamboo garden very well, what’s more, some bamboo will die because of rotten bamboo root. How to overcome such condition? Here is a solution you can take try, you can use 75 percent of flower mud, 15 percent of peat soil and 10 percent of sand to use as its growing soil. At the same time, if there is ponding condition in residential quarter, in fact, it is common to see such condition in new construction residential quarter, water should be drained away in time.


Thirdly, after bamboo garden built, it is necessary to water and shadow sunlight during planting process, bamboo leaves is easy to be dried up so that it should be watered frequently.


Then you should know how to maintain bamboo after being planted, here are some tips you can follow. After being planted, no matter the weather, blowing and raining, bamboo should be drenched through, and then fill into soil steadfastly. This is the same as other nursery-grown plant planting.


Every morning and every night, bamboo should be watered for a time, in addition, dead bamboo should be removed in time, and other new bamboo should be planted in this area. It is important to cover soil carbon on bamboo after being planted. About three months after plant, it is time to take apply fertilizer, please be careful that fertilizer should be in soil near bamboo. According to different bamboo shoot condition, the times of applying fertilizer is different, as usual, it should be two or three times every year.

item.title: Bamboo Growing Environment
item.source: Bamboo Growing Environment
item.description:
No matter what plants you want to plant, its growing environment is the important factor you have to consider. Take the bamboo planting for example, only with the suitable climate and geographic position, bamboo which has better ornamental value can be planted very well.


In the following article, we will mainly discuss growing environment of different bamboos, which would be helpful if you want to plant them.


Firstly, variety of bamboo


As is known to all, different bamboos should be planted in different environment, for example, if it is sympodial bamboo, it should be planted in the south region because growing temperature is over minus five degrees in full year. On the contrary, if bamboo has poor performance of low temperature resistant, it should not be planted in the north region, otherwise it is easy to be frozen to death, which is so serious.


Based on such characteristic, please consider your living environment at first and then choose right variety of bamboo to plant.


Secondly, different bamboos have different biology characteristics, so that if its growing environment is suitable, it will grow very well. In real life, most people like to plant moso bamboo because of its tall and big shape, along with too much green bamboo leaves on it, however, when being asked which environment is suitable for moso bamboo growing, can you give right answer? In fact, moso bamboo grows very well in the environment which has bigger humidness, so that if there is too much fog in the morning, it is so perfect growing environment for moso bamboo planting. What’s more, with large scale bamboo forest, it will become great tourist attractions because people would enjoy such environment.


Some bamboos grow very well in shady and cool environment, and Chimonobambusa qundrangularis is one of such varieties. On the other hands, some bamboos grow better in sunny environment, and Phyllostachys aurea is the exact variety. Believe it or not, if planting Phyllostachys aurea in humid environment, there is no arhat shape at bamboo joint.


Lots of people have wrong standpoint that bamboo are not afraid of being soaked in water because most bamboos would grow very well in humid environment. When planting bamboo in large scale, you should be more careful about such condition, if bamboo leaves roll up, it is important to drain away water in bamboo leaves instantly, otherwise bamboo will die due to rotten bamboo root.


In addition to these two factors about bamboo planting growing environment introduced above, other knowledge such as how to plant and how to maintain it should be learned too. Don’t worry, these knowledge will be discussed in other articles on my site, so please pay attention on update of this website. Thanks.

item.title: Bamboo Flooring Gaining Much Popularity
item.source: Bamboo Flooring Gaining Much Popularity
item.description:
When you are remodeling, refurbishing or renovating your homes then it has been seen that not many people are interested to change home floorings. Usually people have a misconception that changing home floorings is a costly and time-consuming job, which is not correct. In fact if you decide to change your home floorings then with the variety of options available in market and the different breathtaking varieties available in them not only you will save your money but will also bring beatifying aesthetic appeal to your entire home. Out of all the options one flooring option that has gained respectable popularity and increasing appeal is by bamboo flooring.


About Bamboo Flooring and Its Increasing Popularity


1) These days’ not only household but also commercial establishments are preferring bamboo flooring due to added advantages offered by them. Bamboo is comparatively strong and dense than other hardwood floorings and due to its string resistant to moisture; these floorings are widely gaining popularity. Furthermore, being cost effective and ease of installment is offers more and more people prefer to have their floorings made of bamboo.


2) If you are not aware then, you will be astonished to know that bamboo is actually a common type of grass that usually grows in very high and in large diameters. These stalks of bamboo are cut, split and flattened; after, which they are glued and laminated together to make bamboo floor planks.


3) Due to this entire process bamboo gets its unique quality of being durable, long lasting and remarkable stability which makes it more suitable and sustainable for 24/7 usage. Do not forget the elegance you usually receive through bamboo flooring is something you hardly get with other hardwood flooring.


4) If this is not enough then the resistance to insects and moisture makes bamboo one of the most obvious choices in areas having high moisture environment. Apart from all, the ease bamboo floor pranks provide in installing is another reason, which actually reduces its overall flooring cost that usually is not available in other hardwood flooring. Using same tools used for installing any other laminated floors, even you can install bamboo floor with ease and perfection. This might be the reason why even building constructors and property developers prefer bamboo floors.


5) Remember bamboo is the fastest growing plant and one of the fastest renewable resources present on earth. Although bamboo is found in almost every corner of the world, as of now, China is the prime country producing and meeting exponential demands of bamboo hardwood products. Being grass bamboo surely is one of the least expensive and more natural flooring products present in market. When for thousands of years our ancestors are using bamboo for different purposes it is time for us to seriously think about growing green and installing bamboo flooring in our homes.

item.title: Bamboo Flooring Buyer Should Know
item.source: Bamboo Flooring Buyer Should Know
item.description:
When you decide to change flooring of your home or commercial place you obviously have multiple choices to design and pick from some of the most auspicious and elegant floor options. However when you have liberty to chose only the best and redecorate your home with cost effective flooring option then why don’t you consider bamboo flooring. Remember bamboo at first sounds like wooden flooring which actually is not because bamboo is grass. Looking at the speed with which bamboo grows makes it all the more easy and readily available for flooring. Harvesting bamboo is speedy, easy and does not imbalance the environment. In fact, bamboos are much cheaper and speedily harvested compared to harvesting trees.  If you are interested to know more about bamboo flooring then this article will work as guide for you.


Process of making Bamboo Flooring


Once the bamboos are harvested to their maximum potential, they are cut and the hollow bamboo canes are converted in to strips. These strips are then boiled in to water containing preservatives. During this process all, the impurities in bamboo are removed and those softened strips are then pressed flat. Using urea containing resin, these flat strips are then converted in to laminated boards. Dying and staining these finished boards is final process that is carried out on selected boards for coloring or dying those bamboo boards in to different colors.


Finished and Unfinished Bamboo Flooring


When you are purchasing bamboo flooring, you usually come across two major options finished and unfinished bamboo. Unfinished means bamboo planks have square edges offering enough flexibility to attach and fir with relative ease. After installation consumer can finish such bamboo planks using sealant or protective sealant as per their choice, which further increases their durability and look.


Finished bamboo planks usually have beveled edges that are mostly sealed with polyurethane. This offers finished bamboo flooring a beveled or planked look. As these planks are sealed with polyurethane, no additional staining or sealant is required to finish the floor installation job.


Bottom Line


When you want to install bamboo flooring, it is necessary that you should possess a clear and concise idea about your exact requirements. Selecting bamboo on their finish, durability, sustainability and cost effectiveness is very much necessary. In addition, if you want carbonized or stained bamboo floors you should check out the possibilities and after care required for such flooring.

item.title: Ask Before Buying Bamboo Flooring
item.source: Ask Before Buying Bamboo Flooring
item.description:
Many people are skeptical about bamboo floorings as most of us have came across bamboo was either limited to wind chimes or the bamboo shades we used to have coffee. Well, time again it has been proved that bamboo is not only great choice for floorings but it also is stylish, elegant and durable. This eco friendly flooring has wide verities in terms of pattern, style, colors and textures so it is obvious that people buying bamboo flooring for the first time will get confused. However, if you ask yourselves three important questions then buying bamboo flooring will be easier for you.


Guide to Buying Bamboo Flooring


What Kind of Floor Do You Need?


There are two major variants in bamboo floors glue down and floating. As the name suggests glued down means either bamboo floor planks are glued to the concrete floor lying underneath or they are nailed to the subfloor, which is mostly made up of plywood. Whereas floating floor means bamboo planks are so manufactured that they have tongues and groves, which helps them to adhere in place without gluing or nailing to the underlying floor.


What Is More Suitable Solid or Engineered?


Solid and engineered are the two major categories in bamboo flooring. When solid planks are made from pure bamboo, engineered planks have a thin layer compromising about 1/8’ layer of bamboo veneer spread across composite wood. This is actually a hard decision to make because the answer will directly affect your budget. Usually solid bamboo planks are more expensive than engineered, but engineered bamboo planks are far better in heavy moisture laden localities. On the contrary, when it comes to durability and refinishing solid bamboo planks is the best choice. Therefore selecting according to your budget, preference, room where you want to lay the flooring and ease of installation to make this decision easier.


What Will You Prefer Horizontal, Vertical or Strand?


Having decides the type of planks and installation procedures it is time to evaluate and select the grain structure of bamboo flooring. As of now, there are three major options vertical, horizontal and stranded grain textures. In horizontal grains, your floor surface will get a characteristic look of bamboo showing joints of knuckles in natural bamboo. In vertical grains, your finished floor will show vertical stripes along with edges. Lastly, in stranded, which are also called as strand woven bamboo grains your finished floor will get differentiating color but the aura and natural color of bamboo will be highlighted.

item.title: Engineered Bamboo Flooring Reviews
item.source: Engineered Bamboo Flooring Reviews
item.description:
By any chance, if you are thinking to change your home flooring but you are not satisfied with the traditional flooring options then suppose this is a hint to incline your thoughts towards eco friendly bamboo flooring. Without going in to the introductory facts, let us be clear that engineered bamboo flooring is the best flooring option today. In any way if you happen to have came across engineered hardwood flooring then be assured that engineered bamboo flooring is same but the only difference is material.


About Engineered Bamboo Flooring


Engineered bamboo planks are developed from solid bamboo after multiple cross-branded bamboos stem are glued together. These planks are durable, moisture resistant and stronger that traditional hardwood flooring like red oak or maple wood. However, for further durability and health concerns it is recommended that this flooring be laid on ply subfloor. Remember the more ply you use the more stable and moisture resistant floor you get preventing its expansion, contraction, warping, cupping and fading. It does not matter whether you are laying bamboo floor or concrete floor or in basement, due to natural properties of bamboo to expand less it will stay as it is for years.


About Click Engineered Floating Floor


This is also a kind of engineered flooring but with slight difference in installation procedure. With precise engineering and breakthrough structure bamboo planks are so designed that these planks can be clicked or interwoven together to form continuous flooring. In this option, you will get two variants one having tongue and groove on the longer and aider side of the planks. Well, some planks have tongue and grove on either side so by tapping them together you will get uniform floor. Whereas some planks will have lap joints, giving them added potential to hold the end of boards firmly with one another. This option is better for people trying to install bamboo floors with DIY methods. Using few tools and simple skills, even you can install the entire flooring of your home.


Conclusion


When you are selecting engineered bamboo, flooring additional importance has to be provided to the milling of bamboo planks. Usually you get square edged, micro bevel, tongue and groove as well click milled bamboo planks each having its own specialty in installation. According to your budget and your installation preferences, you can select the best, engineered bamboo flooring that will beautify and add value to your home interiors.

item.title: Bamboo Flooring Is Increasingly Popular
item.source: Bamboo Flooring Is Increasingly Popular
item.description:
In past few years, bamboo flooring has received a tremendous applause that lead to increased sales of this flooring choice. With changing choices and increasing preference bamboo flooring is made available in different colors and in different varieties making it one of the prime choices when flooring options are concerned. One other reason that might have increased consumers leaning towards bamboo flooring is its harvesting in natural and in environmental responsible manner. Not only people cautious to preserve their environment prefer bamboo hardwood for their flooring but also people who want to bring aesthetic appeal and luxury to their homes.


Analyzing the Success of Bamboo Flooring


Gone are the days when people used to think that bamboo is not a viable material for flooring. With increased durability, resistance to moisture and insects and feel bamboo is certainly the best hardwood flooring material now. Not only bamboo feels like wood but it also looks and cuts like wood. Additionally, bamboo is said to be denser that hardwood even denser than maple hardwood, which makes it exceptionally good for flooring.


The best thing is bamboo being type of grass can be harvested in environment friendly manner. Apart from that, being fastest growing plants it can be harvested to full-grown flanks within 4 to 5 years. On the contrary, hardwood trees usually need 30 to 40 years before they can be milled for making flooring flanks. When bamboo regenerates after cutting from the same plant you need to plant trees for getting other hardwood.


Options Available in Bamboo Flooring


As of now, two varieties that are in most demand are engineered planks and solid bamboo planks used commonly for flooring. Usually engineered planks are installed using floating floor method wherein the bamboo floor planks are attached together on the thin foal rubber, which is typically used as underlayment for flooring. Due to this kind of installation in no way bamboo floor from engineered planks is attached to the subfloor speeding up the installation process in cost effective manner.


When it comes to solid or grooved bamboo flooring then it is installed like any other traditional hardwood flooring. With or without mastic solid bamboo planks either are stapled or nailed that fastens them with the underlying floor. Although this type of installation is costly and time consuming it surely produces permanent floor that is more rock solid and sturdy. The best thing is engineered and solid bamboo flooring planks come in prefinished manner so immediately after the installation of flooring you can start using it or placing your furniture.

item.title: Enhance Bamboo Flooring Durability
item.source: Enhance Bamboo Flooring Durability
item.description:
Although there are different types of hardwood flooring available in market, in this age of going green bamboo flooring is definitely major player in hardwood flooring. However not many people are concerned about maintenance and taking care of their already installed bamboo flooring. In case if you want to know about the best ways of taking care of your bamboo floor then just keep on reading.


Taking Care of Your Bamboo Floor


Compared to other types of flooring cleaning and maintaining bamboo flooring is relatively easy.  Bamboo being durable, string and relatively harder compared to other hardwood material bamboo is good water resistant providing you much flexibility in maintaining its look and color. Still, you need to undertake some regular maintenance and cleaning tasks that will help you keep you bamboo floor looking new and astonishing.


Cleaning Dust, Dirt and Grit: The only thing that can damage look and feel of your bamboo floor is tiny dust particles spread on floor through shoes or by other means. When we press or dig down these tiny particles they usually, intervene with the natural finish and smoothness of the flooring. Dents, divots and scratches are commonly caused by such particles due to which your floor might get faded look. Regular sweeping, mopping or vacuuming your floor will nullify this possibility. Although you can perform these tasks periodically if the floor is experiencing more foot traffic then it is recommended that cleaning or mopping your floor on daily basis is good. However avoiding vacuum cleaner with beater bars, sweeps with hard bristles and avoiding use of too much water will make sure you bamboo flowing looks clean and stays durable.


Cleaning Strand Woven Bamboo Flooring: Although you can use any hardwood floor cleaner to clean bamboo floor it is recommended that you prefer using non-alkaline and non-abrasive cleaning material. You are aware that bamboo is much water resistant but even bamboo is susceptible to warping if enough moisture is left onboard bamboo floors. Therefore, following all the necessary directions with utmost care when you are using cleaning agents that need to be added in the water is much necessary. Never use steel wool, rather prefer using sponge or clean rag for cleaning bamboo floors. After finished make sure to mop the excess moisture and water from the floor using dry towel or any other material.


Bamboo Floor Cleaning Solutions: With increasing popularity of bamboo flooring various companies have came up with cleaning agents specially formulated for bamboo floors. You can use any of such products or by mixing vinegar in to water; you can safely clean your bamboo floor.

item.title: Strand Woven Bamboo Flooring Is Best Choice
item.source: Strand Woven Bamboo Flooring Is Best Choice
item.description:
These days hardwood flooring is talk of town and almost every homeowner and property developer is interested to furnish their home floorings with hardwood. Say it due to the allergen free properties or due to the ease, it provides in maintaining and cleaning those floors but for sure, hardwood floors are selling like hot cakes. When it comes to natural beauty, durability and cost efficiency then one floor that stands out is bamboo flooring. However, with infinite choices even in bamboo floorings it is utterly possible that even a genius will get confused in purchasing the right kind of bamboo floors.


Of all the options, strand woven bamboo flooring is tested and applauded most by bamboo floor users. With entirely different manufacturing process strand woven bamboo floors, are created in unique manner that given their distinctive look and breathtaking color. Definitely, strand woven bamboo flooring is always best and always efficient compared to the traditional laminate floorings.


Understanding Strand Woven Bamboo Floorings


Strand woven bamboo floor planks are created from a special type of bamboo plant called Moso. After cutting the bamboo stalks they are boiled for long periods, which help in removing the sugar content in them. With sugar free residue, bamboo becomes termite and insect resistant. Afterwards these boiled stalks are dried again for longer period. Now these dried bamboo strands using low VOC adhesive are pressed and compressed using high pressure for flattening them. Bamboo planks thus produced are two times harder and double denser than regular bamboo floorings.


Advantages of using Strand Woven Bamboo Floorings


If the floor is going to experience heavy foot traffic then strand woven bamboo is good as it has highest density in hardwood flooring. Although bamboo is considered durable material strand woven type is the most durable in all of them withstanding heavy wear and tear. Do not forget the ambience and natural look it provides brings in a completely new natural and healthy environment in home.


Strand woven bamboo planks will offer you almost all possible installation options including, gluing down, nailing, stapling or floating floor. Thus, you do not have to worry about the existing floor; with any type of subfloor it is guaranteed that strand woven bamboo flooring installation will be easier and convenient.


With stunning natural color, strand woven bamboo will bring in stunning look, pleasant appeal and natural aura to your home. Usually this bamboo flooring has a distinctive grain pattern that mostly resembles to the traditional hardwood flooring like of maple or red oak wood.

item.title: Increasing Craze of Bamboo Flooring
item.source: Increasing Craze of Bamboo Flooring
item.description:
When bamboo floors were introduced in the market for the first time not many people were interested to install these floorings. People actually installed bamboo floorings back then based on the advantages it provided on cost and convenience basis. It seems that those people made right move at right time, because, today almost everyone wants to install bamboo flooring in at least one of their rooms. You might want to know, why there is so much fuss about bamboo floors and what actually it is. Well, in this article you will at least understand some of the basic but most important aspects of bamboo floorings.


About Bamboo Flooring


First, you need to know that bamboo looks and feels like wood but is a kind of grass that harvests continuously from same sprouts. East Asian and South Pacific communities were using bamboo for different building elements on wide scale including for walls, and floorings but in past two decades, bamboo floors have become much popular in other parts of world.
